nice apartment, nice park and beach in walking distance, public transport to city center was not nearby, but Uber to come back is very affordable. nice people, take time to give ideas on where to go.

Great place in the heart of Porto. A couple streets away (3mins) from the main party streets but also far enough away that it is quiet. AC was great in the heat of Summer and room was clean and functional.
This is a perfect place for 4 people. Miguel is responsive and helpful. The location is ideal!
We had a perfect stay at Joaquims place. Would 100% recommend however be prepared that the street is quite noisy during the night so bring ear plugs or something ☺️
The room was exactly as described, the area is far from the center in a weird neighborhood (Present of prostitution). The most annoying part was the presence of cockroaches

Awesome time in Proto. Luis goes above and beyond in ensuring his guests have a truly authentic experience in the city. All of his recommendations worked out great for us and he was super friendly and responsive from initial booking all the way through our stay.  Demonstrates exactly what booking on Airbnb is all about. Thanks again Luis!
Mario was the perfect host, they were so kind and accommodating to our needs. A great location with easy access to the shops, beach and city. Thank you for hosting us in your lovely home.
Great location with good coffee and a deli across the street. Photos are accurate, clean and simple. Lovely high ceilings, would recommend for a couple or lone traveler

Really nice apartment, perfectly situated in the centre. We were friendly welcomed and the private parking in a garage is very convenient. A small disadvantage is that the second bedroom is situated right beneath the attic, so it was quite warm up there, because the air-condition from the living room couldn't cool that area down that we'll. besides that, we really enjoyed the stay.

Awesome location, super responsive host, overall great value for money! The place was perfect for a family of 4 (2+2), the kitchen was well equipped.  Highly recommended and would stay there again ourselves next time we visit Porto!

The apartment is perfectly located and I was able to walk everywhere! Only needed a drive to the airport and I highly recommend the private transfer with Carlos (Sofia recommended it and is arranging it for you!)  The apartment has everything to make you feel at home! It was great to have a washing machine. There was a clothes rack, an iron and even an iron board! Sofia is very responsive when you ask a question.

Eugenia and Luis were kind and helpful from booking to check out, and the apartment was excellent. Communication was easy and prompt leading up to our stay. Eugenia met us at check in and walked us through some informative do’s and don’ts of Porto, all of which turned out to be very helpful.  The apartment itself was truly sparkling clean, with coffee maker and pastries provided. The location made it easy to access all the sights we wanted to see in Porto. We had two days in the city and could easily have stayed for several more.  Thank you both for a wonderful stay, we hope to be back soon.
This Airbnb is amazing and easy to check into with a code so you don’t lose your keys! Both bathrooms were so clean and there are enough amenities to cook. We enjoyed it a lot!!

A neat little apartment in a great central location.  Noise from above could be a problem but there are building rules and while we were there had no problems.  Rute was welcoming and helpful, very pleasant host.

Had a lovely few days in Porto. Sónia was very friendly, had lots of recommendations for us and very responsive to messages.  The Airbnb was very clean and had everything we needed. It was well located for exploring Porto.
This place is amazing!! So many fun restaurants on the street and Susana is an amazing host.
Very nice and cozy place. Close to the subway and well connected to the city center. Everything went great!

We had a last minute change of travel plans and arrived in Porto one day before our other accommodation started... I'm so thankful we found this beautiful gem of a place (and I wish we had gotten to stay longer!).  Beatrix was extremely friendly, responsive, and accommodating. She let us check-in early, which was incredibly kind, so we didn't have to wander around for hours with our luggage. The apartment felt like a luxury hotel!  Located on a quiet street in a newly renovated building, it had everything you could need for a wonderful stay. The large private terrace was an added surprise (with a washing machine!), the bed was really comfortable, and the bathroom was spacious with a great rainfall shower.  I would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat... and you should too!

It is not everyday that you find a place when traveling that truly makes you feel at home. João’s beautiful apartment was just that for us. After a very warm welcome, we began exploring the city, enjoying being in a quiet road just a few minutes walk from everywhere. The apartment is spacious, newly renovated, fully equipped with everything you need and generally just great. We will love to come back.

Clean airbnb and safe area. Very small, but perfect for one night with 3 people. Walkable from Porto sao bento train station *kinda*. The person messaging was slightly aggressive in asking for our passport information, but otherwise a nice stay.
We had a real great time. Luis and Eugenia welcomed us very warmly and the apartment was beautiful, clean and comfortable.
Fabulous holiday destination, great local knowledge on arrival, thank you Grace, quiet, comfortable, well appointed accommodation, superb communication with hosts, thank you
Miguel's house is in a great location, within walking distance of the Moru Park, the Luis Bridge, and the Porto wine district. We made many good memories of Porto here. Thank you.

Alice’s place is a great space for a visit to Porto. While it’s a little far from the main squares and the Ribiero district, it is well worth the walk! When I return to Porto I would surely book this place again.

Very well located, very clean and had all amenities for a short trip. Just unfortunate there was a lot of noise from construction around, but it seems half of Porto is being renovated. Thanks again for a seamless stay.
A lovely apartment, great for two people. A really comfortable double bed! Kitchen fully equipped. Lurdes was good about our late arrival and changed details.

Pros - place looked just like the pictures. Very clean  and modern space  - had all the basics and essentials needed for our stay  - great location  - host was very responsive and helpful Cons - I wouldn't even consider this a con as the issue was dealt with very quickly. The power went out in the morning and the host got someone in the house immediately dealing with the issue.  loved our stay here and would highly recommend!

We enjoyed staying in this villa. The villa was very clean. The location was perfect and close to restaurants and shops. The owners are so easy to work with. They had all the local information for us..  There are some stairs that you need to climb, but it is worth the climb! We really had a great time! Hope to stay in this charming villa again!   - Sarah

Perfect for us for our long weekend in Porto. Location was great for exploring everywhere on foot and the apartment was very clean and well equipped. The balcony was great for having a drink with a view in the mornings/evenings. Maggie was an excellent host, very knowledgeable about the local area and gave great recommendations on where to visit/eat. Would love to stay again.
Our host told us everything wa had to know about Porto and helped us plan our weekend. Very nice introduction to porto.
I recommend this airbnb to everyone who wants to see the beautiful city Porto. Its a really nice apartment for two persons. Its clean and has everything you need for a citytrip!

One of my favorite airbnbs of all time! Apartment exceeded my expectations. Clean, spacious, fitted with all necessities plus more. The location was perfect and walkable to all monuments and historical buildings. Pedro was very friendly and provided us a list of his personal recommendations for restaurants and bars.

We had a great time staying at the apartment. Rui was a very nice host and always helpful! Communication was super easy and always there when needed! The apartment had everything it needs and was super cozy warm in this time of the year due to the heater. The location was great cause you could reach several shops, restaurants or metro stations within 10-15 minutes. Thank you so much!  Anytime again!

Marta’s place was great for 3 friends visiting Porto! It’s very spacious and clean, in a quiet and safe area - quiet enough to sleep with the windows open, although you’re in the middle of the city. I would definitely recommend!
Fantastic apartment in an excellent location. Beautiful views, quiet after hours, and steps away from the top sites. We had a wonderful time!
The appartment is very beautiful, comfortable and well located. The only thing is that it is difficult to contact the host.

Such a charming Airbnb away from the tourist center. The house was spacious enough for 5 adults and had everything needed for a comfortable stay. The true standout is Diogo’s hospitality. He helped in every way possible and made us feel right at home. Would definitely recommend.

What a great location ❤️ First of all Cristina and Lina were so kind and wonderful, perfect hosts. The place is beautiful, clean and cozy. The bed is very comfortable. And the highlight is definitly the pool and the view ❤️ We could swim in it in May. You have to watch the sunrise - so wonderful 😍 We only spent 2 days, vould have stayed longer. Communication and check-in was super easy. We can definitly recommend it👍
The apartment was beautiful and in an amazing location in the city! The host was very friendly and easy to communicate with. I would be happy to stay again!

Great location within walkable distance to most Porto attractions , very interesting restaurants recommendations  . Last not least very nice appt well decorated and very clean. Will completely recommend . Thanks Manuela

Teresa was extremely helpful and communicative right from when I booked the apartment, months in advance! Check in was technically 3pm but we arrived at 12 noon and there was no problem with our arrival time — the cleaner had finished and was there to welcome us and show us round the apartment. Prior to arrival, Teresa sent us lots of recommendations for places to see, museums, and restaurants, as well as detailed instructions on how to get to the property from the airport. She was very responsive to all messages at all times. There is a lovely large terrace to sit on at the back of the apartment. The location is great, within easy walking distance of the centre.

The host was flexible for check in and check out.  The house had infiltration through the walls, making the house quite cold at night as well as humid and there was a stain on the floor in the hall. Some kitchen utensils were not clean to use. Other than that, the location of the house is good and quiet and peaceful.

We had a great time in Helena's apartment. Eduardo welcomed us and was very supportive. We are very glad that we took his advice to visit Aveiro. The apartment is very spacious and as described. You can easily reach the city by foot. We would definitvely recommend this place.

Ideal location for watching the river. Like another reviewer said, we were gifted with live music down below the apartment until 8pm. It was lovely to open the balcony doors and watch the sunset with the music playing! Apartment was very clean, but did have a strong bleach smell. Easy to access and great communication. Beds were comfy.

Ana’s place was perfect for our two night stay in Porto. We were surprised at just how close it was to the train station, making it so easy to access once we arrived. Despite the proximity to the station and eateries nearby, the space was pretty quiet. The unit itself was very spacious, clean, and stocked with everything we needed during our stay. The location couldn’t be better, as everything was walkable within 15 minutes. We wouldn’t hesitate to book again next time we visit!

The place is good in terms of location with a metro station 200 meters away and lidl about 800 meters away. The place looks exactly like in the pictures.  The responses can be slow, and in the start of our stay there were hair all over the bathroom but they cleaned it the next day. The toilet trash wasn’t taken out after notifying too. And when we messaged them about insufficient toilet paper, we didn’t get any response.  All in all, it was how it seemed in the pictures online besides the slow responses.

Not bad for a short stay in Porto. The location is very central, but it’s a bit seedy as it’s close to the main train station. That is really an upside too. The apartment is located in a courtyard with small dwellings that are made for short rentals. I didn’t get that impression from the pics so it’s with stating. It lacks a bit of personal love. There are signs of a leak from the shower that hasn’t been made good.

The place is exactly as advertised! Clean, convenient location, great view and superb communication on the hosts front! Bed was comfy, it had a wine opener which I believe to be one of the utmost important devices available to you! The balcony area was lovely - and hopefully you can appreciate a good cat because the lower courtyard provided a symphony of meows ;)

Very nice stay in a great location. Lots of things nearby. The street were a little noisy during night and the bedroom downstairs quiet cold during night and also during the day. Otherwise everything as listed and definitely a good recommendation to stay for a couple of days in Porto.

We were extremely happy with our stay here. The hosts were amazing, they responded to every email within minutes and were super helpful with everything. They even let my wife use their downstairs office for a few hours after we checked out. The apartment is large and the kitchen was fully stocked with everything we needed. I highly recommend.
Highly recommend staying here! Such as beautiful place in a beautiful city. Ricardo and Luisa provided great recommendations for things to do and restaurants as well.

Great location and space, very responsive management team with any issues, which we had with the digital door lock. Would have been nice to have known about workman working through the building so quite dusty and they started early. Hopefully this will be finished shortly.  A tea towel would have been great and is always valued! Overall really enjoyed our stay.
The apartment is well placed ! Near the dock, monuments and restaurants, we did everything by foot ! The flat is fully equipped with TV, Wifi and modern design. I felt home !
Excellent service and communication with the owners. The location can be a bit noisy at night especially given the thin windows. Overall a pleasant experience.

Pedro’s apartment was the perfect place for us to base ourselves for our holiday to Porto. It was a great sized traditional apartment with real character (but also with air conditioning which we needed in August) and exactly as described. It was an easily walkable distance to all the places we wanted to visit, including Bolhau market which we visited for lunch before checking in. There are lots of bars, restaurants and shops close by with a supermarket a few minutes walk away. Pedro was really flexible, storing our luggage for us when we arrived very early, and gave lots of great recommendations for places to visit. He left us port and Pastel de nata which were a lovely welcome. His breakfast tip-Combi Coffee, around the corner was our daily haunt as it was perfect with great coffee and breakfasts. Thanks for a great stay Pedro!

Mariana's place is fantastic, tucked away from main streets but right in the middle of everything. The flat has everything one would need (and more), is bright and cozy. Communication was excellent and instructions super-helpful. Couldn't be happier and would certainly return when back in Porto.

Thank you for your warm welcome and your nice adresses and recommendation in Porto. Your flat is nice and perfectly located in the center of Porto. We spend a very nice moment in Porto thanks to you! I highly recommend your apartment!!

It was the perfect apartment for our stay in Porto. Fantastic location with great places to eat around the corner. Studio facing quiet back alley. Hugo provided us with a helpful personalized map that included sights and restaurants.

We had an amazing time at this Airbnb! A lot of nice people and other guests. We would really recommend this place for everyone that loves to be around people and that loves to surfs or do other stuff.

Loved the apartment. We could walk everywhere. Close to a metro station going directly to the airport. A lovely cafe for breakfast right around the corner.  The apartment itself was spotless. Ruis kindly let us drop our bags there early so we could start our mini break straight away without lugging our bags around. Lovely to have big spacious rooms both with en suites and another half bathroom. Terrace was an extra luxury.  We would definitely stay again if we go back to Porto.

This place is beautiful and serene, well located, and easy to find.  We felt very comfortable and right at home. The staff was extremely responsive, helpful and always welcoming and friendly. They gave us a helpful map and many local recommendations, which were very helpful.  We appreciated having lockers on site to leave our things when we arrived early, and we very much appreciated having a lift/elevator because we were on the top floor. A couple of things that needed to be attention were attended to right away. The kitchen is beautiful but quite small, which is fine if you’re not really planning to do more than make coffee.  The main issue with the kitchen is it could use better lighting.  This is a wonderful place to stay and we enjoyed it very much.
Nice place, very well located, clean, beautiful terrace, comfortable… perfect for some days in Porto!
Ideal location to get to all the main sites in Porto.  Also, a large selection of restaurants was very close by.
Appartament was clean and we had nice river view.  Center was 10-15 to walk and it was ok. Hosts were helpful and friendly.

Really enjoyed my stay here, perfect location for seeing the City of Porto. The apartment had everything we needed, and the view from the balcony was spectacular. Would recommend this apartment to anyone!
Good location, the tapas restaurant nearby is the best, it’s quiet even located on busy street.

This apartment is very cool and in a great location, but definitely has a “well-used” feeling. The shower head was broken off the wall which made it difficult to use; aside from that and the need for a good cleaning this was a great place for 6 people.
The apartment looked just like the pictures, location was very good and Mariana was always quick to respond.  The only thing we didn’t like was how hot it got inside.. but it’s august in Porto ;)

We had a very good time in Porto! The apartment was so nice and clean and at a great location close to many nice restaurants and bars and other good spots in Porto. Tomas was very helpful at any time of the day.

Patricia was nice to us but the place we got needs some work done. The apartment is nice with beautiful original details but the furniture and bathroom are very rundown. Walls and windows also need cleaning. The floors were dusty. All in all, it wasn’t the best experience or deal, I’m afraid. The location is excellent, dead center, with lots of options around.

We had a very nice staying there. Everything worked and the place is really clean and like in pictures. Location at the beach also amazing. The host replied fast and she was really flexible with the check in and out times. Thank you so much!
Great apartment and amenities.  A bit loud at night and even into early morning. Super helpful hosts.
We had a beautiful stay! The hosts were so kind and responsive . The home is very spacious and has a beautiful view and Decor. And very close to all the best Porto has to offer. I highly recommend!

Cristina was waiting for us on arrival at the apartment and gave us lots of information on the locality and the main sites of interest.  My daughter and her boyfriend had very early flights home on different days and Cristina arranged taxis for them with a punctual and reliable driver, so if you want to take a taxi to or from the airport I recommend asking Carlos & Cristina to arrange it.  Everything we needed was there in the apartment which is just as it looks in the photos.  The locality was perfect for us as we were attending a wedding at the Sao Francisco church, and it is also in the centre of everything with the tram to the beach at Foz and the 500 bus just at the end of the road, restaurants on the doorstep and 2 minutes walk to the heart of Ribeira.  A really comfortable and spacious apartment with great hosts - thank you Carlos & Cristina.

Such a cozy place and lovely host! The apartment has been clean and pretty good located with everything you‘ll need right around the corner! If i‘ll return to Porto, i‘ll definitly return to Helenas Apartment!

The apartment was in a great location and had everything we needed for our stay. The hosts were responsive and helpful, and we appreciated the easy check-in process. A higher attention to detail with the cleaning would have been appreciated. However, it was a good value for the price and a great location - overall a pleasant stay.

Our stay at Sonia’s was great. The home is well appointed and comfortable despite the multiple levels and stairs. Everything was super clean so the children were able to walk around barefooted. The fact that Sonia provided us with city maps and took time to provide us with suggestions was greatly appreciated. She even had some snacks, water, and wine for us.  We were also able to find parking near the apartment which was a big plus. Overall our stay at Sonia’s was great and we would definitely recommend staying with Sonia to our friends and families when traveling to Porto. Thank you, Sonia.
The apartment had everything we needed, it was very close to the city centre and Sousa provided a very pleasant stay with lots of recommendations. Would definitely stay here again.

Very good location, restaurants and grocery stores around the corner. Takes some time to walk to the old town (15-20mins), but it’s worthy it staying in a more quiet neighbourhood. Spacious apartment, well equipped with everything you could need.
Spacious, clean apartment. Exactly what we needed for our girls trip. About a 10 minute walk from the city centre and just 3 minutes from the metro station. Definitely recommend!

The studio is lovely and very well located. We were pleasantly surprised to find fresh bottles of water and biscuits waiting for us on arrival. The location is perfect, right in the center, yet calm and peaceful. The only downside for us was the lack of air conditioning, as the apartment became quite hot during our stay. Since the window cannot be opened when the blind is down, ventilation was a bit tricky, though a fan was kindly provided. Overall, we had a great stay and really appreciated the thoughtful touches from our host.

Whoa, what a beautiful apartment! We really enjoyed our stay in Porto. Hugo was really good to us, it's easy to see that he enjoys what he does, he took the time to go through a map of Porto with us and he was very thorough showing us around the apartment. The apartment is as pictured and is in a great location. We would definitely recommend it.

We stayed a night at Cristina's flat and it was really nice, confortable and clean. Cristina was a really awesome host, easy to comunicate with and helpful. We recommend it and we are willing to come back soon :)

Excellent location,  walk to downtown along the river. Beautiful, very clean and spacious condo with all amenities. Watch the sun rise over the river. Parking, Cristina is a very charming and personable host with great tips into the Porto area. Highly recommended.
I loved the place, amazing view over porto, quiet street and beautiful apartment. The communication and check-in process was perfect. I highly recommend the place and will come again.
Beautiful apartment, very confy and quite while being very central. Perfect location for a stay in Porto !

We were on the Camino and have asked for the room just 15 min before check in.  Communication was very easy, friendly and immediately possible.  We were allowed to take everything we needed from the kitchen and the was a very hot shower. The room was perfect and looked like the photos, very nice.  We recommend this very much!
The host has an amazing hospitality. She prepared us breakfast and the place was nice enough especially it was pretty close to the airport.

Great place, location and communication. Pedro was quick to reply to messages before and during the stay and very accommodating when it came to letting us leave our bags in the place for a few hours pist check out. Would stay again.
Best airbnb ever Mariana is the loveliest woman and was very helpful with us  Will recommend my friends and family

Our group of 4 had a great stay here in Porto. The location is very central and close to all the happenings in town. The layout is perfect for two couples. There are two balconies and this place was even cuter than the pictures. Host was extremely accommodating and kind. One thing of note, the spiral staircase to get up to the second bedroom is teeny tiny, which makes it difficult to get up and down into the second bedroom especially with luggage. For us, this wasn’t a huge issue since we were out of the house most of the day. Would definitely stay here again!!

The apartment is centrally located and easily accessible by metro. The apartment was perfect for 6 people and extremely well maintained. Maria, our host was extremely warm and receptive! Would 100% recommend this apartment

This place is even BETTER, if possible, than it looks!!!  The location was amazing. The place is an huge value and this cannot be said enough! It was a very nice touch to be met upon arrival and pointed in the right direction for spectacular local referrals.

What an incredible spot Carlos and Cristina have and a lovely flat to boot. My family loved staying here and were greeted with such a warm welcome when they arrived. Thank you for making their stay in Porto so memorable
Ana & João’s place was wonderful. We had a great time in Porto, the location was lovely super easy to walk everywhere.
The apartment is great. There are many nice places to visit nearby. I would be happy to stay here again.

We were so happy to stay in Julieta house. Everything was as discribed. Her house is clean and comfortable and well furnitured. The breakfast sie served each morning was wonderful.  Julieta is a lovely and very helpful person. She had answers on all our questions and a lot of information about Porto and Duoro. We also say thank you for her assistance to find a nice restaurant serving sardinas (not so easy end of September 2014) Hopefully we will meet her again...perhaps In HH.

Great, spacious location right in the heart of downtown. We also received some great recommendations and felt that N Apartments was extremely responsive and easy to communicate with. Would 100% recommend
Great apartment to experience Porto! Easy on foot to anywhere, and great hospitality from Sven and Sandra! Will return
The apartment could not be more well placed. Directly on the principal street where there’s all the shopping to do. Only thing is its noisy at night!
I was really impressed with this apartment. It’s roomy, clean, modern and so close to everything yet quite quiet as it’s on a side street, but just a minute from the esplanade.

The apartment is in a great location! The space is beautiful and the morning bread and pastries is a wonderful added touch! Check in was a breeze and we were provided great recommendations on where to eat and what to see! Would most definitely stay here again should we be back to Porto!

We had a great stay at the apartment. We work from home and so it had enough space for both of us to work comfortably. Marco and Carla upgraded the internet for us too! It is now super fast fibre internet (100mbps up and down).  The kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need to cook as well.  The neighbourhood is great, the apartment is close to everything. Just a few minute walk away from the river.
nice apartment in the center of town. clean and well appointed. the garage is much appreciated if you are driving because parking downtown is difficult.
The apartment was really well located and super clean and stylish. Would definitely stay here again. Only thing is there was no view from the balcony
A nice place for the price. Clean and plenty of room. The street is quite loud at night.
Apartment is wonderful! Station of mento is very close. Quiet place and area. Apartment is very clean and cozy.
Amazing accommodation. I had a wonderfully comfortable stay, in a great location. If I’m ever to return to Porto, I’ll undoubtably stay here.

Nicely located to main areas. The position of the apartment let’s you walk downhill most of the way to tourist spots then you can either walk up or take another mode of transport. The parking lot was a bit expensive but conveniently located. Apartment is as described. I enjoyed my stay!

The apartment is really wonderful and lovely decorated. But for sure the best thing of our stay was our host Gerardo. He is really friendly and helpful. Gerardo helped us to bring our luggage into the apartment and gave us some really helpful tips about Porto. I would definitely stay in this apartment again and highly recommend it.
Great location. Easy to walk from the city center. The place was quiet and had clear instructions for check-in. Warm place for the winter. Will be back if given the chance. Recommended.
A very nice hotel in a familyhouse behind a gate, just in a sidestreet of a bigger street, away from the noise, in a luxurious neighborhood.

We had friends staying in another house nearby and didn't know the direction to the apartment. Julieta kindly picked us up from the house and brought us to the apartment. She gave us a tour of the entire apartment and even provided ingredients for our breakfast during the week. The patio garden was lovely to sit in with our evening meals where it was cool. She was warm and welcoming and very friendly. Very hospitable host, when we go to Porto again we are definitely considering her apartment as a 1st choice on our list!!

We adored our stay in this beautiful and charming apartment, which is very well located in Porto. Olga and Paulo were very kind and available for all of our inquiries. We would most definitely recommend this apartment for anyone traveling to Porto.  Thanks again!
This is a wonderful apartment with lots of natural light. Great location. Very nice and easy check in with the host. Clean and spacious. The air conditioning worked well.

We loved this place and only wish we were staying longer. The location is very walkable to where we needed to be downtown. Clean, comfortable and well-appointed. Nice neighborhood, quiet and peaceful space, stylish and very nice accommodations. Zero complaints. Stay here, you won’t be sorry.

We had a wonderful stay at Hugo's apartment. From the moment we arrived Hugo made us feel welcome and took time to provide recommendations for the length of our stay. He was incredibly efficient responding to any queries we had before arriving and during our visit to Porto.    On the apartment itself, it is situated in an excellent location enabling convenient walks to many of Porto's attractions. There are a few nice restaurants on the street and two cafes directly outside the apartment where you can grab traditional Portuguese breakfast. It was clean, tidy and well serviced with everything you would need for a short stay in the city. Highly recommended for anyone seeking to visit Porto.
Lovely place & host!  Everything was great, the house feels like home, the location is perfect (you can walk to any historical place in the city center) and Luis is very kind. Thanks!

Extremely nice, cozy and surprisingly spacious apartment in a clean, quiet building just a few minutes away from the city center. The hosts are responsive and helpful. The   check-in was very fast and comfortable, would recommend to anyone looking to visit Porto
everyone was welcoming. the room was really pretty, and the windows really let all the light in. the view is stunning. the breakfast basket was perfect.
enjoyed our stay. The flat was well designed and well proportioned. Situated for easy access to town. Nice to have a  small balcony.

The house is very beautiful and had everything we needed.  We felt like home and there are plenty of things to do and see in the nearby area. Nazare was very nice with us, recommended places to have breakfast. It was very easy to contact her and she answered immediately.  Thank you for everything. We'll stay in your place again when we visit the area.

The place is pretty, spacious and well-located. We had some hiccups with airport pickup and some slow responses while others were quite timely. Unfortunately the slow ones were when we needed help more imminently for the airport pickup issue. One team member from GuestReady was always fast and helpful, but her colleagues were more delayed in responding. Overall, recommend the apartment highly as it has great space, and beautiful view, an elevator and convenient location. Also had amenities we didn’t know about so a pleasant surprise. Wanted for nothing.
I think this space is very good. It is convenient from the airport. And this owner is very kind and friendly. I had a good stay. Thank you.

The location of the accommodation was perfect, and everything was very clean. Daniel provided detailed check-in instructions and helpful information, which made our stay even more comfortable. The place was incredibly cozy, and we truly enjoyed our time here. Highly recommended!  we’d love to stay here again if we return to Porto!
Excellent place to stay for our visit to Porto. Great location near a Metro station made it very easy to get around. Our host Nuno made checking in extremely easy. Highly recommended!

Fabulous location, great spacious apartment. Would definitely recommend! Only drawback is no A/C and street below can be noisy with cars and late at night with people walking out of bars and restaurants. But that’s a big city for you!

Exactly as described, easy check in. The place inside is bigger than what the pictures look, lots of space… We was quite surprised how spacious it was compared to the pictures… great location. Would stay here again. Thankyou for hosting us ❤️
The most amazing Airbnb in the most central location! I wish our stay here was longer, exceeded all expectations!

As a family with 2 kids, we had an excellent time in Porto and in Bruno´s apartment. The central location is perfect for wherever you are heading. If the weather allows, it is real quality time to sit on the balcony for a coffee or a glass of wine enjoying the fresh air and the stunning view.  The apartment itself has everything you need and is very well equipped from dishwasher, different types of toasters, hand vacuum cleaner, microwave, TV with Netflix etc. The apartment was very clean and all of the interior was in an excellent shape, all pretty new. The host was very helpful, the handover worked perfectly and we were welcome by a nice hostess and some gratuities.  Overall, I can highly recommend Bruno´s apartment. We had a great time there and really enjoyed it. The location, the equipment, the host...everything get the best grade from us.
The apartment was accurately described. The host provided a very useful overview of Porto, with several useful suggestions.

Loved our stay here! Perfect location and view! Easy walking distance to everything. We felt very fortunate to have this Airbnb. Traveled with husband and 3 kids ages 25, 12 and 15. Everyone was happy.

We had a lovely stay with Casaporto. The hosts were extremely responsive and hospitable and were also flexible with check-in. The building and apartment is well-renovated and we felt safe with the lock system. The apartment itself was very spacious and clean, well-decorated and we had a comfortable stay for our 2 nights in Porto. The building was along a main street that made the surroundings feel safer too. I highly recommend staying at Casaporto for a warm welcome back after a day of exploring Porto!

Loved our stay at Filipe’s loft in the Ribeira district! The apartment is cozy and stylish, with everything we needed. The location is excellent—steps from the Douro River, Gaia, and all the main sights, yet in a quiet building. Filipe was an excellent host, very responsive and helpful. We can’t wait to come back to the beautiful city of Porto.

For us it was the perfect place to stay but it is a 30 minute walk to the old part of the city and the river. However it is very easy & cheap to get around by bus or an uber. Irene was easy to contact and quick to respond and very helpful with advice about how to get the best out of Porto. We would recommend eating at Agusto restaurant - a 3 minute walk from the apartment. They do a wonderful set menu and a very warm welcome
The Location of the Apartment is Amazing and the Host gave us so many Insider tips! Worth a stay for sure! 5 Stars

This flat really helped make our trip great!  The flat itself was clean, stylish, and convenient. It perfectly matched our needs.  The area was fantastic, as soon as you step out you’re surrounded by great little businesses and you’re only a short walk to centre. Perfect little base for our time in Porto. I would definitely recommend!

This is a very comfortable apartment in a great location for exploring Porto. When we arrived Tiago met us and showed us round the apartment. He also went out of his way to provide many suggestions for places to eat and things to do during our stay. We hope to return soon.
Andre was very accomodating despite us being quite late. I would recommend him and his flat. We loved the area, which seemed to be very safe. By car, it is very close to Porto.
Amazing apartment in an amazing area, easy to get to many points of interest.  Hosts were very accommodating! Great internet access/speeds as well!
The apartment is great, very easy to get around to all the touristic places, just a short walk away. Communication was great, we never had any issues! Would def come back!

Amazingly central location and newly renovated apartment with stunning views! Coming by car is not advisable (navigating small streets, additional parking fee of €15/night, parking location a short walk away around the block). Washer not in apartment but communal and 4 floors down. Mattress not the best quality (too soft and seemed overused)..but definitely not a dealbreaker. The apartment is really wonderful and the location and views make up for the little drawbacks. Thank you for a great stay!

Great spot to stay in Porto. Nice and central to all there is to see. Great hosts that make sure you are well catered for. Great communication offering suggestions to restaurants and things to do and see. Make sure you visit Loja Das Conservas, next door for a bite to eat.  Good value, I would recommend.

We enjoyed our stay at Andre’s apartment. It was in a convenient location, clean and had AC. Andre and his brother were very helpful answering our questions and giving us recommendations. We recommend this place if you plan to visit Porto.
Great space and location. Only limited with 1 bathroom and low ceilings for the other two rooms but I would book again

Constantino's appartment is very nice and located in a restored old Porto style building. There is everyrhing you would need. You can reach center easily walking down the avenida, no need for cabs or public transportation. Constantino is fantastic host he welcomed me warmly and provided a lot of information about the city amd more, and marked interesting places on the map I've got from him. He also was there to wish me good flight on check out. Alrhough he said i can call any time if would I need something that was not in the appartment there was no need for that, all was perfect. Thank you Constantino!

We were very satisfied with our stay at Nuno's apartment and can highly recommend it. Great value for the price and the location is good too. Nuno was very responsive and offered us to drop off our luggage way before check in.

FLAWLESS!!! Fernando as a host and his apartment are FLAWLESS! Location is great, Apartment is perfect and feels like home. Fernando provided sooooo many little details. All kinds of supplies in the small fridge, Nespresso Cafe, slippers, soaps, shampoo, conditioner, just everything. The only things lacking were a clothes dryer, and a full size refrigerator. Neither of which mattered to us for our 4 day stay.  I cannot recommend Fernando and his beautiful apartment which I wish I could buy from him! (Seriously Fernando reach out to me). Not to mention that we fell in love either Porto. Forget the South, stick to the North!!!! Porto is a gem, Duoro Valley is fantastic, Aveiro is charming as can be.  If you go to Portugal do not miss Porto and stay at Fernando’s apartment you won’t be dissapointed!
Phenomenal location, you get to experience live music from your window all day. Walkable to everything !
Great location, good space, good host. communicates well. Some of the neighbors might be a little intolerant to tourists. Overall though, not a bad experience.

Casa da Praça is in a very interesting area. The swimming pool is perfect for a relaxing moment in the city. Be aware that the room is small and it has a small bathroom and kitchen. The living room is shared with other guests.

Excellent location for transport.  very close to luis bridge and all the Port Cellars.  River cruise. cable car and finicular.  Mini preco supermarket very close. larger supermarket Pingo a 15 minute walk.   fantastic bakery on the corner of street. General Torres tram line and train station end of road.  5 minute walk.   Very safe and secure. Super large balcony.   There is no view from apartment.  You are facing the back of other apartments.  This did not put us off at all.  I would stay again  Fillipa kept in contact all the time.

We loved our stay in Porto! The apartment was beautiful, clean and comfortable, and their instructions were very easy to follow. Having a spot to park our car was also a great perk, especially since you can walk to everywhere from this spot easily. We highly recommend this spot if you’re in Porto!

Michael's place was great. Close to everything, there are great restaurants around. I walked everywhere and it was an incredible stay. Michael was a great host, always responsive and gave tons of suggestions! The beds were comfortable, and the room was bright. I would definitely recommend it!
Everything went well. The location is very good. The host was very responsive and helpful.

Overall good stay at Maria’s place!  The location was the highlight as it was very centrally located to everything. The water at the bottom of the street and great restaurants/bars and shops every which way. Albeit, it was at the bottom of the hilly street so every day started with quite the jaunt up! Hills are to be expected in Porto but just a consideration for some.  The space was as described/photographed and spacious. Had what you needed, nothing extravagant.

A gem of a place accompanied by a gem of a host. Thoughtful touches throughout including welcome snacks and fully stocked with everything you could need on a vacation and more. There’s also an elevator which is great for carrying luggage up, even though it’s only one floor.

My wife and I had a great and romantic holiday at this place. The apartment is really pretty, clean and right in the center of town but not where all the tourists are (which is great because it’s not too crowded outside). Also, whenever I needed something and reached out, they responded in less than an hour. Highly recommend this place.

We enjoyed our stay in Porto. The apartment is spacious with a living room and separate sleeping area. The location is great to explore the city. Constantino was very helpful. We would stay here again.

Check in was very easy - we were met on arrival and everything went very smoothly. The apartment was spotless with crisp white bed linen and a great balcony to catch the last of the sun.  Everything was walkable and there are some fab restaurants within 5 minutes walk.  I would highly recommend this apartment.

I have stayed at many ab&b's and this was by far my favorite! The apartment is absolutely beautiful, every detail is well thought out, great space utilization, and very well equipped! All the details like a full wine rack and accompanying detailed description of each bottle, espresso maker with pods, and cold drinks in the refrigerator were a bonus. The host Nuno took 20 minutes with us to go through all the great details of the apartment and his multi page list of restaurants, sights, and the city maps so that we were able to make the absolute best use of our time in Porto. And the recommendations were all amazing! The location is perfect, on a nice quiet street, but just a couple blocks walk to all the beautiful things Porto has to offer! If you are visiting Porto this is the apartment where you want to stay, trust me, you will love it!
nice Airbnb in the middle of the centre. Many bars & restaurants around the area, however the balcony is not a proper balcony, but rather a communal entrance. Otherwise very nice :)

If you decide to choose this apartment it will be the best choice. So I recommend it for everybody. Pedro was very kind, helpful. He gave many advice what to visit in Porto. Pedro's apartment is very cosy, as well as in great location with amazing view.

Carmo was an absolutely amazing host. After showing me a quick tour of the facilities, Carmo sat me down and opened up several local maps. She showed me points of interests, places to eat, places to go, and made my trip so much better! I ended up taking her advice and had a great time. Accomodation was perfect, everything as described and very homely.  Can't rate this highly enough, great host and accomodation.

Eduardo's Ribeira apartment is in a great location right on the waterfront. There are lots of restaurants and bars on the Cais da Ribeira and there are 2 grocery stores nearby. It was very easy to walk (uphill) and/or take a bus to reach other areas of Porto. The apartment was immaculate and very quiet. It was the perfect spot for our week in Porto.
The flat is in a perfect location, close to everything!    Very clean, spacious and the terrace is a lovely place to start the day. We would love to come back!
The apartment is very spacious in every aspect. Catarina and Antonio were extremely helpful with recommendations and accommodation inquiries. We loved Porto and staying in this apartment!

Great place to stay. Stay in a local area in a beautiful Marina, getting to escape from the cities busyness. You can easily access anywhere in Porto by using an electric scooter for extremely cheap. I would highly recommend especially if you are traveling with a car given the free parking not easy to get in most airbnbs across Porto. A very pleasant experience.

The apartment is beautiful with old world charm. The bar in the kitchen is lovely, especially on sunny mornings as it was nice and warm. The location is perfect for exploring Porto (5-15 minute walk to lost sites) and not crowded like the Ribeira district. Very nice restaurants nearby and Pedro made some great recommendations. I highly recommend this apartment for travelers who are looking for a nice home base with some space.
This is such a beautiful place. Location couldn't be better. There is a bar downstairs and can be a bit loud at night, but we didn't care. Atmosphere was great and hosts were very accommodating.

Great apartment in central location. Our host was very quick to respond and happy to help with any questions. Nicely decorated interior. Only comment to note is it is up a few flights of stairs which is worth noting with a lot of luggage. We would recommend this apartment!

Susana was really sweet. We were really comfortable at her apartment, in the very center of Porto. The communication was fast and she even let us the apartment for the day until we left at night. I totally recommend this place: clean, comfy, in the center,... It is just as they show you in the pictures

The apartment is  very well equipped, we found everything we needed. The location for us was perennial as we were looking for sth near Casa da música and metro station. The problem that we had was the lock; quite difficult to handle.
Had a great stay in Porto at Chris's place. Was easy to get around on foot from the flat with plenty of amenities close by.  The WiFi was fast and reliable and check in and check out painless.
I had a lovely day at Claudia’s. The decor was comfortable yet classy it wasn’t up a hill which was a nice surprise and it’s very close to the train station.
Very cozy appartment. Everything was neat and clean. The neighborhood was also very cool! Thank you!

We travelled with a couple of friends and we rented the 2 flats Pink and Green. Those flats have a connecting door and are perfect for 2 couples. We were with our 5 month old baby, Eugenia and Luis provided us with a baby bed, baby bath tube, disposable baby-changing cloth... Luis was really helpful via email for the booking and we had a warm welcoming from Eugenia when arriving in Porto. For our next trip to Porto, we already know where we will stay!!!

We had the absolute best stay at Hailey’s place! It has everything you could need in a fabulous location in Porto. They were very responsive with a few minor issues that came up. Very clean, great building, charming and quiet. We stayed for a month and felt right at home. Highly recommend!

Great nicely equipped apartments in the heart of downtown and lively Ribeira neighborhood  with plenty of restaurants within walking distance . A short walk to the bridge going to Vila Nova de Gaia with more restaurants and Port wine tasting rooms. Super clean. Easy Instructions to follow for check in . We were 2 families ( 3 and 4) and enjoyed the convenience of being on the same floor (next to each other) but still with the privacy of own place.  Driving in Porto is quite difficult with the lot of constructions going on therefore I will suggest not to arrive by car. Parking is very limited, restricted . Riberia Saba Parking is a block away however super expensive@ 50 euros overnight.
Clean, comfortable apartment in a great location. We definitely recommend and would love to come back soon.

This apartment was absolutely fantastic. We were sad to leave. The views were spectacular, beautiful and the church bell chimes where beautifully sounding. Couldn’t get tired of it. Location was perfect and in walking distance to everything, including the train stations. Would recommend this place to any visitor and we would return as well. Thank you Porto city hosts for everything. Our stay was perfect.
Lovely loft apartment in a central location - a great spot from which to explore the City on foot

I really enjoyed my stay in Porto! The property is very comfortable and well located. The apartment looks exactly like photos. Priscilla was wonderful, super helpful and always ready to assist, which made a big difference. I highly recommend this place to anyone!

We enjoyed our stay in Susana E Ricardo's beautiful and recently redecorated appartement.  The ocean and harbour view, the very nice kitchen with a nespresso coffeemaker, oven and microwave, a great shower, 3 TV's and a reserved place in a parking garage. Susana and Ricardo were also very helpfull.

This charming apartment is very well situated in the heart of Porto, but very calm as it is situated in closed road, with almost no trafic. It is also very well equipped with everything! We will come back again!

Maria‘s place is perfectly located to discover the beautiful city of Porto (everything can be reached by foot easily). Also, the apartment is very stylish, spacious and safe. Maria was very helpful with the self check-in and available at all times. Would definitely recommend.

By far the best place I’ve ever stayed via AirB&B. The welcome was very personal and kind. The room and all others above expectation. Big, clean, with all another identity. The garden a quiet spot in a vibrant city. The staff without exception friendly, accurate and helpful. The breakfast lovely and complete. So I will definitely be back, when in Porto. Thanks to an excellent team… Rob

This Airbnb was the best I’ve stayed at. Sousa was so responsive and helpful. The place was clean and filled with the amenities needed. It was in the perfect location for walking and seeing everything. There were amazing restaurants around and Sousa gave us so many recommendations! It was amazing. If I come back to Porto I would love to stay here again!!
Very responsive and great location in the city. Having the parking was a huge bonus. Would recommend.

A fantastic apartment at the heart of Porto. Perfect for exploring the City. The apartment was clean throughout, comfortable and spacious. Communication with Rui was great from start to finish. Would highly recommend.
The place was great and located on a quiet street. The host gave us some precious infos about where to dine and have breakfast. Would recommend.

We stayed a weekend, it was perfect. Large and confortable bed, spacious and modern studio, bright, even a terrace ! Wifi was good. Fully equipped kitchen. very centrally located. Rui was a great host, plenty of recommendations, he did a better job than the tourist office! Fully recommended!
Fantastic and peaceful just a short walk away from the buzz! A lovely quiet and sunny house at the heart of the city.
Highly recommend! Clean, spacious, great light, great beds, all around perfect. Great communication with host,  everything was amazing.

Our stay in Porto at Sofia’s place was perfect! The location was very central for walking to everything and the people watching from the balcony was perfect. I loved the restaurants and cafes in the neighborhood. The apartment was clean and very comfortable.

The place is very cozy, well equipped and nicely decorated with a nice outside balcony/garden. Host was very helpful, communication and check-in (out) were very easy. Location, is also great very central and well communicated. Good value for money.

We thoroughly enjoyed stay in Porto at Ilan's place. The flat's location is ideal for a short city trip, with the waterfront and city center within walking distance. Everything was spotless clean and tastefully decorated.

It was a wonderful stay at Michael’s appartement, where he gave me lots of clear instructions on how to get in the apartment, but also where to get dinner the night of my arrival. His response time for me was under 10 minutes, which was amazing to have a spontaneous conversation. Would highly recommend it.

A really great stay here. Very central to all of the key sites. It was also useful that the company office is 2 doors away who were more than helpful, especially with leaving bags before check-in/out.  A really memorable stay!!

Lovely, spacious apartment in the heart of Porto. Well stocked kitchen and completely comfortable living room. Construction in area is challenge, but once we figured out our routes it worked out fine. Recommend highly!

Great location! Perfect place for one or two,  just what you need if you want something cosy with everything close by (lots of restaurants for example). We had helpful advice from the lovely host, on what to do during or trip accompanied with a map. Would definitely recommend. :)

I really enjoyed staying in this apartment. It’s located in a nice building with beautiful wooden floors. It has heater, and everything needed for a comfortable stay. The mattress is very comfortable, which is a very important aspect for me when choosing accommodation. The apartment is also conveniently located, with the old town and central spots just about a 20-minute walk away. I would definitely stay here again.
It was my third time staying here, so needless to say - I like it :) I usually stay here when I am flying out of or returning to Porto! The pickup service is outstanding.

Location was absolutely perfect. Very comfortable beds, and great communication from the hosts. There are no doors on the bedrooms but that worked out fine for us. I really don’t think you can find a better place for this price! We would definitely stay again!

We had great time here! The place is located near a metro station so you can get anywhere you want very fast. Room was clean and cozy but a bit cold. Carmo was very nice and helpfull. She quickly answered all my questions.

This is It...this is the executive premiere level of airbnb experiences.  This place was so amazing that I did not want to even leave in the evenings.  The atmosphere, the hospitality, the amenities, the location, the elevator, the black out shades, the kitchen, the washer/dryer.  It just has It all.  You are around the corner from everything, yet on a quiet street.  On my many trips to Porto, I wish this place was always available!
This was the best airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. Beautiful, clean, well located. The host was very helpful and kind, would definitely go back!
Our time in Porto was amazing and the time spent at Nuno’s condo was just as amazing ! Nuno provided us with great restaurant, places to see and where to get lost in Porto to explore !

Here’s a review you can use for your stay in Porto: Our stay in Porto was fantastic! The location was perfect, and the place was well-maintained. The host was extremely hospitable, with quick and helpful responses. The breakfast, which was included, was amazing and really set the day off right. Having a dedicated parking spot was a huge plus, especially since parking in the area can be hard to find and would easily add €20. Overall, a wonderful experience!

Amazing amazing amazing place! I am quite loathed to give a good review because selfishly we all wanted to keep this place a secret it was simply stunning, The garden was magical just under the fabulous Luis 1 bridge it was like a film set! The whole place is spacious with views from every window so lovely to live there for a few days! All the amenities are there big kitchen and everything was clean and fresh WE ALL LOVED IT! We will return hopefully again and again and again! Thank you Claudia & Alexander PERFECT!

Great location! Room looks just like the pictures. Host was able to arrange transportation to the airport the next morning. There was a little miscommunication with our early check-in at 2pm, but the host was able to to let us in early to leave our luggage and we were still able to make our 3pm appointment.
Great location, apartment was clean and had all the essentials. Will mention that the bathroom is a little tight, wasn’t an issue for us but it could be a hassle for some.

Beautiful home! Styled in a blend of old and new charm. It is furnished very well with comfortable beds and all necessary linens and utensils. The extra tips of the area and map from Diogo were great for selecting our touring through town. We had an excellent experience
Had a lovely stay at Vascos flat. Had everything we needed for a few days stay. Felt right at home. Left some wine for us too!

The location was absolutely perfect—close to everything we wanted to see and do! It made getting around super convenient. The host was incredibly proactive and responsive, checking in before and during our stay to make sure everything was going smoothly.
Beautiful space, right in the heart of the popular restaurants and bars. Host was very responsive and very accommodating. Check in and check out was smooth.

What a fabulous city apt! We loved this place so very much. It was great to be across the river in Gaia with an easy walk/Uber/tram across the bridge to Porto and also to escape the crazy business of the city. We really enjoyed eating by the river and looking across at Porto by night...it was fab! The apartment is close to amazing restaurants and shops/markets as well as some spectacular historical sites.  If we go back again we would most definitely stay at this place. We much preferred staying in Gaia to Touristy Porto (but we LOVED to explore it throughout the day). Gaia also has amazing fishing villages just a short Uber away with incredible seafood and local vibes. The last thing to mention is that balcony!!!! The photos do not do it justice. Sunset looking over the Douro River and spectacular Porto was incredible.

Sonia was amazing! She was very communicative and always available. We were a party of 8 and she allowed us to drop our luggage off earlier than check in, so we didn't have to start planned tours or dinner plans while hauling all of our stuff around the city. The place was beautiful and clean. We were all able to have our own space but also hang out together comfortably in the common space.
We had great stay at Celias place. She picked us up from airport so the check in was super easy. Thank you Celia for warm welcome!
Great location, easily walkable to everything. Not too loud at night, and being able to do laundry for a long stay was great. Would happily stay here again!
This place was beautiful and the location was great. Very responsive and super helpful hosts. Recommend 100%
Telmo was a nice host, very helpful and fast in communicating. The house was perfect for us and we had a wonderful time there.

Beautiful, clean, stylish and comfortable… we enjoyed our stay here very much. The immediate area is very residential, so generally safe & quiet. The unit is on the 4th floor with a few nice balconies, and building has an elevator.  We spent a few nights dining in, and a few others walking to nearby restaurants & bars.  If I’m being picky the only thing that could be better would be the 10 minute walk to the metro or the 6 minute walk to the nearest market, but neither was that big a deal. And, you’re a few blocks from one of the best Francesinha places (O Afonso) and one of the best shopping & dining streets (Cedofeita). Overall, location was a net positive.
Great Hosts. Made us feel right at home and very accommodating. Would stay again

Wonderful experience and stay. The condo looked exactly like the photos (maybe even better!). Breathtaking views and great location. Walkable to many attractions and great restaurants. A fully stocked kitchen - we were able to cook a home cooked meal seamlessly. Clean bathroom with a great shower and cleansing products. The bedrooms were also comfortable. Quick and reliable communication. Really friendly too. If I’m back in Porto, I would love to stay here again.
Lovely apartment in a very good location of Porto. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it. The welcome basket and personal introduction by Rita was excellent!
Great location, and Claudia is very responsive/easy to communicate with! Very walkable area, would recommend this apartment for a stay in Porto.
Perfect place for a short stay in Porto! Communication was very smooth. The place was clean. We’ll be back next time we’re in Porto!

This place is fabulous! The house has lots of space and the garden is really brilliant. Our kids spent hours in the pools and playing...there's big gates on the property so it's very safe. Jose and his family are so friendly and helpful. The area is lovely. We had a great time here

We had a great stay at this place for a group of 8 friends. It was spacious, clean, and quiet at night. Alexandra was very helpful at check in and throughout our entire stay. We would definitely stay there again and recommend to our friends. It was a short and easy walking distance from the center of the city and felt very safe.
Alvaro is a very friendly and helpful host. The apartment was very clean and cosy and the kitchen was very well equipped. Everything was great and we absolutely recommend this place to stay in Porto.

Great apartment with a great view in a great location - just 2 mins walk from metro  Host was so helpful - even picked us up from the airport and showed us where things were in the area. Much appreciated !

Our stay in this property was wonderful. The house and the garage are very spacious, and nicely renovated. Communication was very easy, and the location is convenient for exploring Porto as well as exploring other places outside Porto by car. Fully recommended.

This is my second time coming back to this beautiful place and it felt like coming back home.  This place provides such a relaxing atmosphere including a beautiful backyard where you can do outdoor yoga or just chill amongst fruit trees surrounded by ivy and camellia-covered fences. Despite its location on a busy street, you can’t hear any cars in the garden or indoors. I could not wait to come back to the apartment after a long day of walking in the city.  And the communication with the host was prompt. They are very friendly and quick to respond to any questions I had during the stay.  ( Thank you Mellisa and Joanna!) Highly recommended!

Cristinas flat is a GEM in the beautiful city of Porto. It’s located in a busy shopping street, but totally silent during the night. Shops, cafés and supermarket on your doorstep and a perfectly silent night to sleep well. The metro station (with all major lines passing) is at two minutes. But I actually never used it as the best thing is exploring a city walking it’s streets. And it’s all in walking distance. The flat is tastefully made up / decorated and everything is brand new and stylish. I also loved the balcony for having a coffee and watching the people passing by. I absolutely recommend Cristinas place for your trip to Porto!

Great stay. We are family of 4 and was more than comfortable. We walked to a lot of the main areas. Also has pretty sunset down the block. Owner was very sweet as well and helped us get free parking on the street.
the apartment very clean and nice and it is located in the city Center, all tourist attractions can be reached by foot

Amazing place to stay for our short 4 day visit in Porto! Definitely recommended to others but be sure to bring earplugs as it can be loud in the evening outdoors and the soundproofing doesn't cut out the noise enough. Ana and her husband were very quick at responding to our questions and amazing hosts who provided us with some greta places to check out.

The apartment had a verry intens mould smell. At first we thought that the problem will go away if we open the windows but dis not go away and we then foud lots of mould at the entry.  We announced the property manager but did not get a answer for 2 days and before leaving they offered to bring us air fresheners.  In 2 days, at 5 am there where some shouting and fights between the neighbours that made it impossible to sleep.

In Porto you can't do better than staying at Yves' apartment. The hosts are young, nice,friendly and helpful. The apartment is specious, modern, clean, airy, sunny, with its own garden. The decor is tasteful, contemporary, fresh. Nothing is missing. We love cooking so we appreciated the great kitchen. The location is quiet, out of the centre but a pleasant walk to everything. We never took a cab or public transportation. Supermarkets and shopping are nearby. To anybody visiting Porto,we strongly recommend Yves' apartment.

This was a great property in a great location with easy access to Porto’s public transport network. The property in spectacular inside and really is something special. Our host was very personable and provide some great recommendations for our short stay in Porto. Would certainly use again and would recommend to any friends looking to visit Porto. Many thanks Diogo

The flat is beautiful and very accessible with close metro and walkable distance to attractions. Even though it’s beautifully decorated the cleanliness was lacking. The bathrooms were dusty, with mould and rusty/dirty bathroom accessories. Dinning table was greasy.  Alice is very responsive and very easy to communicate. Instructions for everything were also provided and easy to follow.
Lovely spacious apartment in a very central location. The place was very clean. Everything was very easy. Car park is pretty tight but we managed with an Audi A3.

We had a lovely time staying in this beautiful getaway in the city. We felt like we could have been nestled somewhere in the countryside. The hut was well designed and felt really cozy. All in all, we had a super time and would recommend faux sho. Thanks João + Achilleas
Amazing apartment, highly recommend for a group trip. Perfect location and the host were super helpful with any questions. They also helped us with airport transfers!
MIGUEL’s information for parking and easy entry to the apartment was greatly appreciated. Well situated with all amenities close by. Apartment very cosy and very clean. Thank you for such a nice day.
Great stay for a family trip! Apartment was spacious, fully stocked with the amazing ocean view :) highly recommend!
Definitely the right person to give the best tips in and around Porto. Really enjoyed my stay at Pedro's flat. Close to the centre, just the perfect location. Loved the balcony! :)

Staying in Sofia’s apartment was a pleasure. Not only was the apartment as advertised and in perfect condition, all of her suggestions were spot on including restaurants, things to do, and local transportation (Carlos transport to and from airport was very enjoyable and full of helpful tips and tricks). Sofia, Carlos and Fatima are very genuine people…such a pleasure. Would we go back? A resounding YES, YES and YES! Obrigado x 10 Pam and Marc (Canada)

The apartment was gorgeous - exactly as described, all very new and has everything you need. The location is great for exploring Porto and there is a metro station 5 minutes away with a direct line to the airport. The check in and check out process was very straightforward, and there was a great list of local suggestions. We had a wonderful stay and wouldn’t hesitate to stay again.

The place is super clean and very well equipped. Sónia is a great host. She helped us plan our visit in Porto, was very helpful. The house is very spacious, and walkable to most places in Porto. One of the best airbnb’s we stayed at so far. Would highly recommend this house to anyone looking for a clean and spacious place .
The apartment was great, exactly how it is described. Close to supermarket and restaurants. About 20-30 drive to the 516 Arouca bridge.  We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you again

We had great moments in Portugal. Beautiful country, great people. Miguel was a perfect host since our first contact.  My family felt like home the whole time. The place is incredible, well localized and very cozy. Definitely it was a right choice! Thank you Miguel!
This is a stylish apartment with a great view in an excellent location for exploring Porto. Note the sunken bed is not the easiest to get in and out of if this could be an issue for you.
Very good location and charming apartment. The street was just a little noisy so we had trouble sleeping the window open.

This was an awesome place to stay! The apartment is right in the heart of Porto. It's superclean, neat and the hosts are really friendly and their English is fluent. Cheers to the guy that welcomed us (sorry, I forgot your name), we thank you for the warm welcome, your amazing drawing skills and the elevator experience that made our lives complete ;) We could not get enough and will definitely be coming back!

A beautiful apartment at an amazing location! I would definitely recommend it to anyone. The apartment was super clean and cosy. Joana was really helpful and there was always fast communication. All the nice restaurants/shops/spots were at walking distance.

Communication with the host was great, we received clear instructions for the self-check-in (very handy). The location of the place is very convenient to walk around Porto. The apartment needs a bit of TLC, it should probably be aired a bit before guests arrival and a bit of general cleaning wouldn’t be a bad idea.
Superb host !! We could get an uber and Mr Alvaro was kind enough to help us and pick us from the train station. His home has everything top class . I would definitely give nova de Gaia 5 star .

We had a great time at Juliana’s place. The communication was super easy and quick and the place looks exactly like it does on the pictures. The neighborhood is very conveniently located and the apartment is very quiet! Would absolutely recommend to stay there!

Great spot on a side road, so quiet but still very close to the city center with many things in walking distance. The apartment can be a bit damp but Vítor provided us with two dehumidifiers - just keep them running whenever you can and clear the water out every day 😉

We chose the place based on location and size and we’re not disappointed - it’s a large apartment convenient to the Porto sights.  The difference between a perfectly acceptable experience and a great one is usually in the details, however.  We would have appreciated enough supplies like bin bags and toilet paper to get us through the length of our stay, and some extra towels would have been nice.
A very pleasant studio with complete facilities. Marco is very handsome and warmhearted. He provided much help. Also, Check-in is easy. We really had a nice experience in Porto. Thank you Marco.

If you're looking for a beautiful and romantic place for your vacation in Porto. Then you came to the right place. The place is absulutly stunning beautiful, and elegant. And Carla is just amazing. She is so attentive and nice,and even helped us to send something we accidently took from the airbnb in another city, with no extra charge. This is your place for sure.
The apartment was clean and was in a great location. This is a really good base to explore Porto from.

Fantastic place to stay just outside of the busy city centre. Great for having private outdoor space as well as a pool and very simple to get into the centre. Very responsive host and would thoroughly recommend

Lovely apartment in excellent location. Short walk from train and beautiful views from balcony- very central yet peaceful. Roomy apartment comfortable for our 3 person family; tidy layout and beds very comfortable. Welcome included a bottle of wine! I can’t imagine a better place to stay in Porto- highly recommend!
Marco’s apartment was an important part of our trip in Porto. A well located apartment with lots of amenities and impeccable cleanliness. I would stay there again for sure!
This is a comfortable apartment, and I really enjoyed the location. If you want it they’ll deliver breakfast to your door, and you have a kitchen!

We really liked the apartment, spacious and with unique decoration. Staircase to the second floor rather tight, but marvelous terrasse. Very convenient location in the center, a few minutes walk from all main spots; we did not even need public transport.

We really enjoyed our stay at the apartment.  Carlos met us on arrival and gave us a very comprehensive briefing on local amenities etc.  We later had a couple of queries which he responded to very quickly.

The appartment is really great, it looks amazing and has the perfect location to visit Porto!  Do mind that the appartment is next to a very busy road. There is good isolation  but sound will get through. Despite this we still would recommend it! Advice; It is hard to open the front door of the complex, don’t put the key completely in when you open it!

We loved our stay here - the flat was very spacious and clean and also has a really nice terrace. Has everything you need. Patricia was such an amazing host - she met us outside the flat and explained everything to us in great detail, and she also went above and beyond to give us recommendations of things to do in Porto which was super helpful. Would 100% recommend!
We spent almost a week at Marta’s place and it was perfect for our needs.  Plenty of room to spread out.  Kitchen was well equipped.

I can confidently say that my stay at this place was truly above and beyond. We were greeted by a friendly host who gave us a tour of the amenities and was always willing to answer questions and offer help. The breakfast was really great, more than we could ask for given the price. The place was kept very clean throughout the day. To top it off, the metro station is just across the street. No complaints whatsoever!

Perfect spot to explore central Porto. Exceptionally clean. Florinda was available for recommendations. Beautiful terrace. Beds are firm, but that's a matter of preference.  Would definitely stay again.
Pros: location, true to picture, clean, air-con, bright room with good view. Cons: house is shaking every days, sound block is really bad, room door seems not very safe.
The room was very nice. We really felt liked we were in a expensive hotel :)  The bed was very comfortable and the linen was very nice.

Luis is a fantastic host who is super responsive and communicates clearly and proactively, providing lots of local recommendations. The place is super cute and is in a convenient location (15-30 min walk to key places). Be aware that there is construction in the area (and in many places around Porto).

Carla and Marco are very friendly and have very good advices (ask them about the best pasteis de nata in the neighbourhood you will not be disappointed). The appartment is clean, well furnished and very well situated. The 2 single beds are not recommanded for people taller than 1,70m. A very good stay, we do recommand the appartment.

The apartment is very nice, clean and well equipped. It is bright,  with a lot of light. Location is near to many cafes,  shops and a short walk distance to the center. The host was pleasant and very helpful. Could not asked for more! Highly recommendable!
Great area to be in for Porto and Gaia. Comfortable flat that was clean and adequately stocked. Good value for money

If you want an authentic Porto experience, this is the house for you.  This home has character and history.  It's a beautiful house with a lovely garden and a spectacular view.  The beds are very comfortable, kitchen is spacious, living area is the perfect size.  It's also very clean.  We stayed in February and the house was nice and comfortable because there's a heater in the bedrooms, living area and bathroom.  It's in a great location because it's walking distance to the many attractions in Porto.  We'll definitely stay here again if we are in town.
Perfect place to stay in Porto, you will not regret to book this place. Perfect for 4 persons.  Walkable to almost every place you want to visit in Porto.

Vitor welcomed us with his great hospitality and with a ‘sweet’ surprise. Staying at Musas was really nice. Quiet area, close to the city center, a 15 min walk. The apartment was bigger than expected and very clean, also an excellent shower. You won’t regret booking this apartment!
