The spot of the apartment was really beautiful, though the bedroom was located right above the glass container on the streets. Between 11 and 12 all the restaurants dumped their glass there, and between 3 and 4 am (really crazy) the truck picked it up on each night. This caused us to wake up multiple times during the night. Too bad, because the apartment is really tidy and well-located.
The apartment is great, exactly like the pictures. Got everything I needed. Great location also. The host was super, 5-star
Our stay was awesome. We loved the balcony so much! Apt is pretty spacious, with all the needed amenities. Recommended!

We enjoyed staying at Florinda's place, a unique spacious apartment with a great garden space that over looks Porto, The Douro River and Villa Nova Da Gaia.  Very rare to have a garden/patio in Porto.  Florinda is a great warm human being she made us feel very welcome.  The location is surrounded by a great variety of restaurants for breakfast, lunch and Evening Meals and local convenience stores are 20 metres away for the front door.  Plenty of space for up to 6 people so great for a family or 2 couples with 2 full bathrooms, with  all you need for a comfortable stay.  We would 100% recommend and would stay again.

My partner and I had a great stay at Hugo's place during our time in Porto! The apartment is really well located, within walking distance to most main attractions and has many great restaurants close by. The check-in process was smooth and the apartment was clean and comfortable. We would definitely recommend it!

This location is perfect. Your own personal oasis. Located on a central and busy street but with large windows/doors to an inner courtyard which had a small balcony and great natural light. A small grocery store is just a short walk away if you want to cook a meal, but if you want to go out, there are many options for restaurants.
It was a great experience meeting Paulo in person.  He is an amazing personality,  who helped us with many tips.

Such a beautiful spot to stay while visiting Porto! So close to walk to downtown areas and beautiful views from the balcony of St. Idelfonso church. Bottle of champagne was a nice touch to welcome us!

We loved this apartment! The location is just perfect, the apartment is spacious and the apartment is very clean. It had evening we needed for our stay in Porto. Check in was very easy and the hosts are very sweet and easy to get in touch with. Would definitely book again!

The house is very newly refurbished, very clean, every room has has double bed and an en-suite bathroom. There is a common living area with a big sofa, and TV with streaming services (Netflix). The neighborhood is very quite, 20 minutes walk to the city center.  I definitely recommend if you are a big group.
we loved our stay here! it looks even better than the photos, Paula was super helpful and responsive, the place is perfect for a getaway from the city
Clean and spacious apartment in a great location - 2 minutes walk from the beach and plenty of restaurants/bars. Would recommend to anyone staying in Foz.
Ana's apartment is really in one of the nicest streets of Porto, close to the oldest parts of the city. She was a very nice host, even helped us to find parking for our car. Lovely stay altogether.

We had a great stay, very central but surprisingly very quiet for the city center.  The possibility to leave the luggage before/after checkin/checkout is a great plus. We'd definitely come back again in our next trip to Porto.

Had a great stay here and would definitely recommend! The place itself was really clean and easy to find, it's spacious for 2 people (seems like it would be spacious enough for 4 even). And bed was really comfortable and large, it all felt really homely. The WiFi was good for me to work remotely and the kitchen had all the essentials to cook a proper meal. It's close to restaurants and supermarkets, and a short distance to the centre too. It's really peaceful outside and was always quiet waking up in the morning which was nice. Would recommend for your stay in Porto!

Really lovely flat. Amazing balcony and location. Great advise on local restaurants etc on arrival. Early check in really helped too. Only very small improvement could be to provide a little coffee or tea as no supplies are provided. Easily rectified as there was a shop right next door. Thank you

The apartment is amazing! We received the apartment very cozy and clean. Pedro is the best host I have ever had on airbnb, he welcomed us on the first day and was always available for any questions and requests. Definitely recommended when visiting Porto!!!
Modern flat, very clean and organised. double glazed windows . Price and quality was fair . Host always communicative and attentive. I strongly recommend this property.
Beautiful space, right on the river. The views were amazing. The location was perfect for our stay. Would definitely recommend this place to visitors.

The place was amazingly clean, 10 min walk to the main bridge and good restaurants on flores. Host responded very quickly, a little noise from building works if you like the windows open but also AC so shouldn't be an issue. A great place..would definately stay again!

Great host who met us personally at the property & communicated & visited us to make sure we were settled & happy. Fab location with a short walk to the sea front & a further 10 min walk over the river to the other side of Porto. The apartment was clean, spacious & the beds were very comfortable. We would definitely recommend this property & host

Great place to stay, as long as you are prepared to climb the ladder to the 2nd room. Top tip from previous guest - pull the ladder out, it makes all the difference! Great situation, good cafes & restaurants locally. Easy check in & out. Would definitely recommend

What a gem of a stay in Porto! ✨ The apartment was spotless and stylish, clearly put together by someone with a great eye for detail. Each morning we woke up to the most stunning Douro River views, and every evening we got front-row seats to the sunset—pure magic. 🌅 The location couldn’t have been better: right in the heart of the city, so exploring was a breeze. And our host? Absolutely amazing—when we accidentally left things behind, they even helped ship them all the way back to the U.S. Talk about next-level hospitality! 5/5 stars without a doubt.
We had a great stay !! The appartement is so beautiful, comfortable and really well situated. We basically walked everywhere. Maja was very welcoming. We were 7 and definitely recommend this place !!
Really enjoyed our stay as a family of four with two young children. Lovely arrival, everything was clean and was just what we needed and hoped for during our stay. Thanks again!

A really great space that has all you need for a few night stay in Arouca. We needed to cook at lot at the apartment because of dietary issues and the kitchen is incredibly well equipped for anything you need to cook. A very clean space overall! We appreciated the extras the hosts had left us for check-in. Would recommend.

The major downside of this rental is the horrible smell coming from the downstairs bathroom. The smell made 1 of 2 of the bathrooms completely unusable and for a group of 6 people, this made our stay less comfortable & not ideal. The host was responsive and they did come by to do an extra clean of the bathroom & hang air-freshens. Ultimately, it did not help and we ended up keeping that bathroom door closed all week. Additionally, the host does not offer free extra towels which was inconvenient for a week-long stay. Otherwise, the rooms were comfortable and the location was ideal.
Stefan's place was ideal for us. It's really spacious and in a great location. Stefan's communication was great and the apartment was very clean.
Loved the location next to the Bolhão Market. Was a very simple but clean and comfortable accommodation.

The apartment is clean and nice and is located directly next to the centre of porto and you can do everything by foot. We loved it there and had a great time in porto. Daniel is a great host who is always available if needed and gives great tips and advice.

* Nice location on a quiet residential area with Mercadona and some coffee houses 10 min walking * Nice placed on the building communitary garage * Interesting flat door that locks up automatically * Nice areas with all the appliances e.g. equipped kitchen glued with living room with big smart TV * Comfy room also with a big smart TV * Fast Wifi (used on a laptop for a 2h video meeting) * Big bathroom with heated towel holder, good water pressure and temperature * 10/15 min walking to the nearest subway station (so we let the car at the garage and used public transportation to get around)

Location was very convenient, within walking distance of the river, Sao Bento train station, and numerous restaurants and bars. Cristina received us warmly and shared helpful tips on how to best enjoy the city.
We had a fabulous stay in Porto. The apartment was clean, comfortable and well stocked, and exactly what we expected. Beautiful views in all directions.. We would definitely stay here again.

Very nice location, walkable to all tourist attractions.  Clean and spacious apartment, classic and elegant high ceilings design.  Bedroom is not a real separate room, but more like an area separated by glass door.  It worked well for us, only 2 guests. There seem to be multiple Airbnb units in the building, ours was facing street, not with the best quietness at night.  But it did not bother us anyways. Marta is very responsive to all our questions. A pleasant staying.

Very clean new apartment. Walkable to everywhere. Located on a busy intersection , so great people-watching from the wraparound balcony. Once the balcony doors are closed, very quiet inside. Several interesting bars and restaurants within a couple blocks. I recommend a dinner at Olume a few doors down, great cuisine and service.

What a fabulous apartment! The location is great, right in the heart of the city centre, the main sites and close to the metro if you need to go further. The studio is perfect for a solo traveller or couple and there are lots of great restaurants, rooftop bars, cafés and supermarkets within minutes.  I'd also like to say Thank You to Paulo who was incredibly helpful from booking to check out. I will definitely be back! 😊

Florinda’s place was in an ideal location — tons of restaurants and grocery stores nearby. We were close to the river, but the apartment was very quiet and lovely. The view was incredible! We would definitely stay again.
We had a lovely time in the comfortable, cozy apartment in a good location, close to everything and with good food option. Absolutely recommended place and host!
I had a very pleasant stay there,  would highly recommend it to other guests as well :) from all perspectives: the location, the apartment itself and communication with the host :)

First time experiencing an Airbnb plus. A really warm welcome, Ines even made a cake and gave me a bottle of red wine, port, cheese from the region and have given me a lot of tips via Whatsapp and an personalized map on google. The place itself is also very clean, comfortable, and modern. The apartment is within walking distance of the city centre (~5min) and nearby the metro station (apartment to airport ~30min).

We had a really pleasant stay at the apartment of Miguel&Ilze. The communication and the access/leaving was super easy, we could park our car for free. The apartment is brandnew, greatly equipped and super clean. Strongly recommended!

The best Air BnB we have ever stayed at! Stunning interior with everything perfectly thought through in terms of design and luxury. We felt we were in an expensive boutique hotel.  The gardens were lovely and peaceful to relax in after a day of sightseeing. Close to a metro and very good supermarket. Alice was a great host with clear instructions and helpful when we had questions. No complicated rules or instructions which made us feel at home. Highly recommend this apartment , it’s the best apartment we’ve ever stayed in and we have stayed in many over the years. Thank you!
The appartment was as good as expected. Clean, modern and in a good locality. Thank you for a great stay at Porto!
Miguel's place was a fabulous base to explore Porto from. It was close to the buzzing restaurants on the river, walkable to the old town and was very stylish.

This beautifully remodeled, spacious and light-filled apartment is in the heart of Porto's very old and charming historical distract just one block from the river. We were greeted warmly and graciously and Eugenia took the time to introduce us to the neighborhood and recommend many restaurants, cafes, shops and interesting sights to visit. Each morning during our five night stay, we found a bag of fresh rolls hanging on our doorknob! I cannot imagine a more perfect place for our family of 5 to spend our time in lovely Porto.

Pedro and Ines home is nothing short of beautiful. The architecture and interior design was a dream. My husband and I never wanted to leave! The location was fantastic with easy access to everything we wanted to do. Some amazing restaurants we found nearby were Alto and Gruta (seriously one of the best meals I’ve ever had - get the bisque and raviolo. Right across the street from the apartment are two great brunch spots recommended by Pedro—Hakko and Rosi. Pedro was very communicative and check in was very easy. Can’t wait to come back to Porto and stay in this apartment!

We had a very nice stay in Porto. The appartment is perfect for a small group of friends or family: it's well located, well equiped and clean. At our arrival we got a warm welcome with a small bottle of Port and Eugenia was enthousiastic on explaining the highlights and history of Porto.

There were so many reasons we loved this place! Here are a few: Fantastic location with a beauitful balcony overlooking the street.  Extremely clean.  Complimentary port.  In-unit washer.  Very quiet considering it was on a public street (we did stay in the off season, however, this may vary).  Tons of restaurants right outside the front door or within walking distance.

Don't hesitate visiting Ana's place! It is very beautiful and big to stay there with your friends:) Also it has good views being on the high floor. Very nice way to organize an evening dinner on the terrace and listen to the sound of night Porto!  Have a great time there!
This was a fantastic, good value and very spacious apartment, easy to get to everything in Porto. We would definitely stay again for our next visit to the city!

Amazing location, super bright and welcoming apartment. Rute was a very accommodating and helpful host. We had an amazing time in Porto, the whole city felt walkable from our location. We miss it already!

The place was really cute, the area is fantastic, the river is really next by (scenery was beautiful) it’s so easy to go anywhere from there ! The hosts were nice, gave us some recommandations and were quick to reply ! Amazing stay

Beautiful apartment, in a good location making it very easy to get everywhere. Plenty of space for 3 of us. The communication and flexibility of check in was very good as we arrived very late. Highly recommended, can’t think of anything to improve. Thank you
Great place. The location is very good and the appartement is lovely ! It is a shame that we came to visit the town and go out because it is a great house to stay at home and chill
Lovely apartment and hosts. It looks just like in the pictures, is very well located and it was very easy to check in and check out. Overall it was a great experience.

Carlos meet us at the apartment and all was as described in the listing comfortable modern apartment in an old building very close to all the attractions of Porto parking difficult in narrow streets but the same for all of this area, great affordable place to stay Thanks again Carlos

I would highly recommend. i stayed here for just under 2 months - the apartment is newly renovated and had everything i could possibly need. Catarina is a very attentive host - she'll drop you a message to check up and see if you need anything at all. The location is great too - far enough from downtown for some peace and quiet but also close enough that you could be there at the drop of a hat. There's a good selection of cafes, bakeries and supermarkets nearby. I'd definitely stay here again next time I'm back in Porto.
Tiago as a host was great. He was very flexible and the house was cosy and very good for a couple. The apartament was very clean and the location is close to the city centre. I recommend it 100%.

Booking process nice and simple. Apartment is in a lovely block, full of the character of Porto. The apartment is a bright, stylish and clean and perfect location for exploring. They recommended a great restaurant too. If you're a very light sleeper I'd suggest earplugs but it's not excessive and no different from any other city centre apartment on a Saturday night. I would thoroughly recommend staying here!

It was a great place to stay, convenient location. The room was very clean, nice scent and the most comfortable bed ever. I slept very well.  Thank you for the host and everything. The host even helped me to get my suitcase to the top floor. Amazing time here and absolutely great value to stay.

The flat was in a decent spot to many attractions. Exactly like the photos, and very well equipped for all culinary needs if required. Daniel was super helpful and always quick to respond. Thanks for a great stay.
Nice and spacious apartment, it was 15 min walk to most central areas and the neighbourhood had lots of restaurants around but still very calm. Would stay here again.
A top notch place.  Really great for 2 people.  Loved the balconies and it was easy and super comfortable.

Definitely the best place I've ever been to!  Amazing flat, exactly as advertised. Beautiful furniture, great outdoors space, small pool but enough for 4 people to cool down from hot weather.  Joana is an amazing host, even all the instructions were on the flat, she was really proactive and gave us great recommendations. One evening we  accidentally got locked outside (we were clumsy 😅) and literally 5 min after text her, another person came and let us get in.  Great value for money, we will definitely be back and recommend Joana's place to our friends and relatives. Thank you very much Joana!!!
I was very happy at Marco's place. I would stay there again and hope to do that sometime in the future.  Wonderful bakery/cafe just opened right across the street!

The appartment was great, it was exactly like in the pictures and very well situated. We've been very well welcomed by the Home Me team, they provided all the informations needed and have been really reliable. Thank again, we had a great stay :)

This was a gem of an apartment. Large windows with sunlight streaming through them, beautiful stone lintels, and gorgeous original old wooden interior shutters (good if you want to sleep in!). The space is thoughtfully furnished, with everything you might need in a spacious studio apartment. I should also add that the bed, with cotton sheets, was extremely comfortable. All communications and the checkin were easy and pleasant, as the hosts are so friendly and accommodating. I would recommend the apartment to anyone seeking a spacious pied-à-terre in Porto.

It was the nicest experience on this year's holidays. Alex is the best host. His house is the most beautiful place, situated in historical part of Porto. The view from our private garden was breathtaking. He even arranged for us to be picked up from the airport. Claudia drove us to the house and was very helpful with all the information we needed for our short stay. I would love to stay there again.

Susana’s place was so cute and clean. The patio was an extra bright bonus, we wish we stayed longer to enjoy it more. The location is incredible, but somehow still quiet at night. The mattress is on the firmer side. Susana was easy to communicate with and very accommodating.

We were 6 Croatian students who spend 3 nights at Joao apartment. Apartment is very clean, comfortable and good equipment.  Its located very close to the city center. Unfortunately we have not met Joao but people who welcome us were nice but they didnt speak english, so we coudnt get more informations about thing we wanted to know.

We personally met Christina and she was amazing. She met us right at our check in time and welcomed us into the first floor apartment. She made us comfortable with the place and gave us dozens of local tips on what to see and do. The place is in a FANTASTIC location, right by the river and bridge. You are steps away from incredible restaurants, and a hop skip and a jump away from the amazing places to try port wine. We would go back to Porto and stay at Christina’s in a heartbeat. The bed was so comfortable and the rooms were nice and big. The bathroom and shower were a nice size too! The windows on the side of the apartment open up and let a great amount of sunlight in which is perfect in the morning when you are getting ready. We didn’t spend much time in the apartment because there is so much to do! But, it served its purpose and exceeded expectations. Stay here!

We had an amazing stay in Oporto all thanks to Luis! The apartment was my 50s mod dream, updated yet retaining some of the unique architectural features. The furniture was simply beautiful, complimented well by his original artwork! I wish he could decorate my home! The windows and balcony looking out to the trees and other buildings in the back was such a wonderful surprise and our favorite part of the apartment. Luis provides you a very extensive map with suggestions of where to eat and what to see. My only regret is that we didn’t have more time to explore! This place is perfectly located and  we could walk to pretty much everything we wanted to see. I think this neighborhood in particular was just right. Quiet yet lively and in the middle of everything. When returning to Porto I would 100% stay here again!

Loved everything about this place! It was exactly as described, such a beautiful place with a stunning view. Directly in the middle of everything. Would highly recommend staying there!! Hopefully I’ll be back one day.  Thank you so so much for having us!! We had the best time and would’ve stayed so much longer if we could!
Perfect location in old town, great views, quiet house and street! Only problem to us was, that for 2 persons there are one shared bed with one shared blanket.

Célia is a wonderful hostess - kind and welcoming, and she cares for the comfort of her guests.  The room is as advertised, very cozy and warm.  It's also clean and comfortable, and contains a coffee maker and microwave, so if you're tired or just want to go out, you don't have to. There are chairs on the patio to enjoy the peaceful backyard. Although it's close to the airport, the room is quiet and peaceful.

The place is in a very good location within walking distance to all interesting places. There are restaurants nearby with good food and a supermarket if you need it. Easy to get to and from the airport, less than 10 min from Trindad metro station. The apartment is clean and quiet, good for resting after a long walk.

Pedro is an amazing host! He is very helpful, and his flat is clean, organized, very well constructed, also centrally located. Staying at his place makes our whole Porto travel experience so much better! We will definitely come back again if we travel back to porto and it’s definitely recommended to my friends as well, it’s probably the best air bnb experience so far 🤩
The apartment is really nice and really well located. You can reach the main attractions of Porto by feet. The airport ist connectd with the metro station near the house (ca 40-50mins).
great place to stay,. friendly and attentive hosts. easy access, quiet for those who like to walk and great views of the beach.

I highly advise you to book this house when you can. It's two minutes down the road to the best city vista in Europe. The terrace is lovely and you can feel the vibes and mood of Porto in the right way. =)

Filipe's place is amazing! It is fully updated and the design/decor is beautiful. The location is also perfect for exploring the city. I highly recommend Filipe's place during your time in Porto. I will def be back!

The property is in the right location, very clean and comfortable. There are plenty of restaurants downstairs and not far from the attractions. The only bad thing was that there was no lift to the ground floor, which was not very friendly for us travellers with big luggage.
Great place to stay, great location. Slight issue with a leak on the last night but nothing that the host could have anticipated or done anything about.

We had a great time in Porto! The apartment was very clean and cosy. It had everything we needed for a short stay (three nights). The location is great, a little outside of the city centre, but still at walking distance, and close to the beautiful gardens of Palácio de Cristal. Hugo and Dyhia were very responsive and helpful. Agradecemos-vos por tudo!

Absolutely perfect location - very close to the water and many restaurants.  Excellent views from the living room and all modern interior!  It was perfect for the 3 of us!  One word of warning - there are a lot of stairs so if you have bad knees you might have a hard time (but we loved it)!

We loved our stay at Diogo’s apartment. The apartment is very central and in a fabulous location. Felt safe and private. Check in was easy. Decent sized apartment, great for two people. The stay would have been even better if there was things like shampoo/conditoner/washing powder/ enough coffee pods to cover the entire stay (i.e 6 for our 3 night stay instead of 2). Otherwise, amazing airbnb. Would recommend if visiting Porto! 😊
Nice apartment, completely new and situated in a good position.  The home have all you need , washing machines included too. I strongly suggest this apartment !

Wonderful location, just a stone’s throw away from a lot of the scenic spots in Porto. The place was also very clean and well designed. A bit of noise from the upstairs floor but if you’re not a light sleeper, it’s fine. Bed is also super comfortable!
Everything was great! They place is near a metro stop and very close to the historic center, convenient to the airport. It’s a nice and comfortable space. The host was communicative.

We had such a relaxing stay at Susana and Ricardo's rental. It was spotless, and they were so accommodating and responsive.  The location was close to the beach and restaurants. Obrigada Susana and Ricardo!
The house was clean and in a great location, but the stairs were a bit hard to go up with luggage and The rooms had no doors but still, overall it was a good stay
We were very well looked after by the team managing the flat, who were responsive  and extremely helpful.

If you are looking for a beautiful place for your family or friends that gives you a quiet neighbourhood with a true Portuguese feel - thinks it! The host Sonia is one of the kindest host ever! She has everything you need and the backyard was a lovely way to end your nights drinking port wine.

great location! walking distance to bars and restaurants. also close to the metro, but i didn't need to use the metro as i was able to walk to all the touristy sights. apartment was clean and outside noise was very minimal. felt right at home here. host was very friendly and informative. would stay again if i came back to porto. 100% recommended!
Pedro and his wife have created a masterpiece in Porto.  From the stunning home to the historic location, one could not ask for more. Thank you both so much for hosting Kevin and I.

Absolutely stunning apartment, with such attention to detail! Felt like we were staying in a luxury getaway. Alice was a great host and extremely communicative and responsive. Would 100% recommend to anyone staying in Porto. Our favorite accommodation of the trip.

Location, location, location! I would highly recommend this place due to the location next to the cathedral and the beautiful view on the river and bridge. From there you can walk to and from all major city highlights, cafes, restaurants. Beautiful apartment. The house next door is currently being renovated (large building site) and it can get noisy due to construction.

Loved our stay in Porto thanks to Sofia’s place. Bang in the center, easy walking to all the sites in Porto. In spite of being on the pedestrian street, it was quiet at night. The apartment is well furnished, with great mattress and amenities. Sofia was super helpful with recommendations that helped us enjoy Porto to the max. Very responsive host for any questions we had. Obrigado!
Beautiful clean Airbnb. Felt so at home, smart tv so can watch Netflix etc whilst getting ready to go out. Very modern and stylish!

Thank you very much for the nice stay in this lovely little apartment - Highly recommended. Tastefully decorated, great located and super comfy bed - even using limescale-repellent shower head:) All in all a great place to discover Porto from.
Bruno was a very friendly and helpfull host. The location is good with a bakery 1min away and also the beach and the supermarcet can be reached by foot. We really enjoyed our time in the House.
Great stay! Booked at the last minute after our previous lodging fell through and was grateful this place was available. Exactly what we needed.

Luis’s place was gorgeous, comfortable and in a great location. It was walking distance to everything we wanted to see in Porto, but away from the highly populated tourist areas. We enjoyed the quiet environment and the many restaurants and shops just steps from the building. Luis was very responsive and accommodating during check in and we would definitely rent from him again if we return to Porto.

Teresa is a fantastic host - friendly . responsive, and helpful. The apartment matches photos and description. Only setbacks were building was full of mosquitos on arrival, which Teresa dealt with quickly after complaint. Also, sofa in sitting room and bedcovers are full of dust and need cleaning.
Brilliant place in the city centre of Porto. Lots of restaurants and shops in walking distance. The apartment was bigger then we expected. Check in was super easy and João was a great host!
A nice apartment with central location and close to metro station. Be wary, there is no AC, just a fan. The owner is very supportive and welcoming

Had a great stay at Tina’s Airbnb. Tina was very friendly and sent us great recommendations about what to do in Porto. It’s a 50 minute walk to the Porto city center, but it’s by the river and scenic.  I can recommend!

The apartment is in a great location - it’s easy to walk to all the main sights and there are plenty of restaurants and bars nearby. However it is also very quiet and peaceful, and so comfortable. We had a warm welcome on Sunday evening from Eugenia who shared lots of ideas for restaurants and places to visit. Breakfast rolls and pastries were provided every morning which is a welcome touch. We loved Porto and hope to return one day, and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended.

Eduardo is so lovely and kind! Replies to whatsapp. Place is super clean and quaint and right at the riverfront. Bathroom super updated w a nice shower. Wine & water waiting for us. He helped us get a reservation :) no issues w the place  There are parking garages around apt -- if you're driving make sure to. Heck the location and park there as parking / finding the apt can be difficult if you're driving. But it's in such a cute location I wouldn't want you to joy stay - just come prepared! Love Portugal!!
Great location and views from the apartment. Overall would recommend. The only downside was a bit of an “old house” smell and lots of small black spots (mold?) in the shower.
We had a great stay with Pedro. The communication was quick and super easy. We loved our stay. The place was clean and very well located.
Perfeito! The apartment is very well located and very thoughtfully outfitted. Joana is a perfect host. It is apparent that much thought and care has gone into creating this wonderful space.
We had a good stay Ricardo's place. It was convenient to everything we wanted to do.  The communication was excellent and timely.
While I was there, I was really comfortable. dino &lnes is very lovely and kindly!!!!
Ricardo was very responsive and helpful. The apartment is in an excellent location and Ricardo gave lots of helpful recommendations. The apartment was incredibly clean!  Thanks for a great stay!

The apartment is really lovely. The vintage decor makes the apartment really cozy and welcoming. There's a variety of stores in the neigborhood and getting around Berlin was easy with the metro station so close. Communication with Bartolo was really easy and he was arranging with the arrival and departure time. Me and my friends we recommend this place! :)
We had an amazing stay at Duque de Loule. Nice and quiet appartment very well located. Thank you to the entire team for everything, including Sergio and Ruan Carlos !

Mariana's place is a perfect appartment to discover Porto. It has everything you need: comfortabele bed, nice shower, a kitchenette with fridge etc. You can walk to the city centre or take the metro. Extra plus: the busterminal is very close by if you want to take a trip to another city (we went to Coimbra one day!) Mariana is very welcoming and helped us to find a place to eat the first night and said we could always message her if we got lost. So, if I go to Porto again I would definitely choose Mariana's place again :)

Very friendly and welcoming host  Good communication and availability  Smooth checkin and out  Stylish and pretty apartment with beautiful walls  Located well  We were happy to be able to cook in the kitchen  The dishes and the fan in the bathroom weren't clean though  A bit shame that it was hard to see the TV from the bed  Nevertheless we've had a good stay. Thanks for having us.

Amazing location. Very walkable from Ribiera, Dom Luis bridge and close to the Sao Bento station. The unit was comfortable and very nicely furnished. Prior to our arrival, there was a problem with the AC. Joao let us know before check-in and provided portable heaters instead which did a decent job of keeping the place warm. It was a nice & comfortable stay !!!

Maria is very nice. The apartment looks as described. The apartment is very clean. The problem is a very strong smell of mold / moist. It is overwhelming. And there are no windows, but only two doors on the same side that do not circulate the air. For us it was very hard to stay there and we shortened our visit.  Also, from the little we saw, the immediate area is not interesting, but a rather boring suburb of porto.

This is a lovely apartment with comfortable and quiet bedrooms, a light and open living room with plenty of seating, and a well-stocked kitchen. We were met at the door by Luis, who helped carry our luggage upstairs. He provided a map and a listing of restaurants and shops in the area. Our group enjoyed the bustling neighborhood and found it convenient to sights and services. Nice touches: towel warmers in the bathrooms and a bottle of port on the dining table!

We had a great stay with Sendme2Portugak! The apartment was clean and nice with a cute welcome gift and plenty of recommendations in a secure building right near the central train station, the ribiera, and plenty of bars/restaurants. They even had AC for when it got hotter and was pretty quiet considering that it is so centrally located. Would definitely stay there again, was great for me and my partner

Breakfast is very delicious. For us, we had a separate toilet so there was no issue to use toilet and take a shower. All the furniture, tableware and interior design is lovely! We’d like to visit Porto again because of this accommodation! Jose and his wife are kind and considerate. I hope many people will know this place. Thank you for hosting us. We really loved this place. We will definitely come again. See you soon😊

This is a lovely apartment near the train station/main area. Very clean, nicely decorated, appreciated the amenities—wish there was laundry, but otherwise well stocked and appreciated timely communication and local recommendations like the massage place!!
Amazing apartment, great size for 4 people. Clean with big bedrooms and a nice terrace. Would definitely recommend
The apartment is in a great location, very close to the river and other main attractions. The amenities were as described and we had everything we needed.
Really nice place in a neighborhood with plenty of services but not touristy. Walkable to the tourist highlights w/out all the noise and chaos

José and his family made us feel very welcome in their house, being really friendly. The place is great and the facilities exceeded our expectations (really clean, tidy and quite spacious). This is a perfect place to spend some days relaxing while visiting the surrounding areas (e.g. Passadiços do Paiva).
great place to stay for a couple nights as a single traveler on a budget! Miguel was very responsive and let me store my bags there prior to check in.
Big, clean and comfortable space. instructions for checking in were clear. Centric, with a nice brunch place right downstairs
This was an excellent stay. When returning to Porto, I don’t need to look farther than this stay!
The room was in a perfect location close to everything. Filipa were great hosts that helped tremendously with my stay.

A great apartment.  Minutes from Sao Bento station and close to all the main attractions o Porto.  Very modern apartment and very clean. Had everything we needed for a couple staying four nights. communications with host excellent.

We were really happy staying here. Location was excellent. Kyle was really welcoming and helpful. The 'attic' bedroom was comfortable but a tight squeeze getting cases up there and a steep descent to the bathroom at night, if needed. Better for younger couples. Good value.

This place is a Gem.  Absolutely beautiful, sparkling clean and has everything one could possibly want or need.  Joanna is a pleasure to work with and responds immediately.  This was a last minute booking as we had just arrived in Porto and the original place was  terrible.  We found Joanna’s place and were amazed.   Lovely place and great location to fabulous restaurants and the sea.   Will definitely come back!
Great communication, very nice apartment, close to my favorite part of Porto. Host was very willing to help make my stay as comfortable as possible. Would recommend!

This was a fantastic Airbnb and I wish that I was staying longer. I will definitely be rebooking the next time I visit Porto. Everything was clean and spacious, communication was excellent, and the airport pickup and breakfast was above and beyond expectations. I highly recommend!!!

The location is great for seeing the city. Plan on walking a bit if you get dropped off or drive as cars do not have access to the narrow street that the apartment is in. Besides that, location is great for exploring. As listed, no AC and I did find it a bit warm when sleeping. But overall fine a fine place to rest while exploring Porto.

"I had a lovely stay—everything was clean, comfortable, and well-organised. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the atmosphere was peaceful. I’d definitely recommend it and would love to return!"
Very nice stay with beautiful garden! Quiet and cozy, but for max 3 persons - I can’t imagine being there with more.

The apartment was really nice and the best part is the stunning terrace. It is perfect to explore Porto since it is located super central so that it is possible to explore the city by walking. We can recommend this apartment.

One of the best airbnb experiences - we cannot recommend this place enough!! We stayed at this property with a baby and a 3 year old and it was perfect for our family. The farm and all the activities felt like paradise for a toddler and Carla and Antonio went above and beyond to make sure we had everything from making sure we had baby gear, to giving local recommendations, and more!  The nature was beautiful and the accommodations were clean, modern, and comfortable. It was easy to go into Porto and drive to the Douro Valley. We would love to come back again one day!
An excellent place located on a quiet street within walking distance of everything! We had an excellent stay and would rebook if given the chance! Thanks to Pedro!
The place is comfortable and big enough for 5-7 people easily, great location near every big landmark. Friendly hosts. Overall really good stay!!

The apartment was really clean,  nicely decorated and well equiped. It is in walking distance from the city Center and all the sights. Communication with the host was easy, nice and welcoming. We really enjoyed our time in Porto!

Porto was in general a very pleasant and colorful city. The appartment is located in the heart of the old city in proximity of everything.  2 min walk to the river bank with astonishing views. It was clean and had everything necessary for a short 2 day stay. Cristina was nice and helpful. Enjoyable stay!

Great house with a wonderful pool, large bedrooms and a bathroom in each one. We went with family members from all across the world for a wedding that was taken place nearby and it was simply perfect because we were all together but had our privacy at the same time. We would definitely recommend Valter’s place!

Susan and her son Bernardo are native to Vila Nova di Gaia. The guest cottage I stayed in was comfortable, beachy, and peaceful. I walked to the beach each morning for coffee and breakfast at Ar d’Mar— thank you, Rui. Susan recommended terrific sights (Janet Echelman’s Anemone and the Eiffel Bridge) and restaurants: Brasao and San Valentim. We had terrific conversations about interests in common. Finally, Bernardo has established a well-organized instructional program for surfing (!) Yes, I need to take lessons next time. Thank you!
The place was very welcoming, close to the city center. Had everything we needed, both Marisa and Mario were very helpful. Would visit again without a doubt!
A fab apartment with a beautiful view. Brilliant hosts, very quick replies to our questions and really flexible with our timings. Location is perfect too!!
Nice apartment, clean, in good location. Hosts are very friendly and helpful, provided all necessary information. Highly recommend!
Great spot. Really clean and convenient. It was my first Airbnb experience and Carlos has set the bar really high!!

We really enjoyed our stay at João’s apartment! He was always so quick to respond and very helpful. We asked for an iron and he brought it over almost straight away, which we were grateful for. The location is amazing: can recommend the wine bar across the road and the chocolate shop up the street :)  We didn’t cook in the flat at all so can’t comment on that, but the living room is beautiful and the beds are super comfy.  Thanks João
Well located; few minutes walk from the beach and a short drive from Porto. Beautiful little house with everything you need, and the host was very helpful.
Fantastic place, especially when you’re coming from Lisbon. Really good for vacation and around 15 minutes’ walk away from most tourist attractions.
Your house was really clean and comfortable. There is 5th floor and no elevator so a little tired to go up. But everything but that was perfect!

We had a wonderful stay in Miguel’s home! Everything was super clean and the house has everything you need for your stay ! The location is fantastic and extremely walkable, nice quiet neighborhood and great restaurants. We loved our time here and will definitely be coming back !

Marcia is as lovely as the other guest already described.. Waited for us as we were delayed .. She even provided a crib for our little baby which was lovely! The terrace is great and huge ;) our son had a lot of fun with the cats from the neighborhood.  Even the place is central (just 2min by foot to the city hall and main square) it is absolutely quiet! Everything is new, lovely decorations, and it's a bright place where you get up with sunlight on your face.

Claudia’s apartment was very clean. The use of the space is very clever.  Yes you have to climb a ladder to get to the loft bed and yes you have to crouch down, and can’t stand up straight but the bed was very comfortable and we were glad to have two separate spaces. Since I didn’t spend much time up there except to sleep and change, it was fine. Mariana was very helpful. Great location, quiet street, checking in and out was a breeze. I would stay here again

Casa da Alegria felt like we were truly at home in Porto. In fact, we decided to extend our stay by a day because we loved it so much. Beautiful apartment, perfect location and the very best host. Fernando was warm and gracious. We will be back and will definitely refer friends!

We loved the apt, it had all we needed and the welcome basket of fruit and port was a lovely touch. Rosa and her companion, who greeted us were very welcoming and informative.  One very small thing I would suggest is to have non slip mats on shower floors or a grab rail and perhaps another hook for towels.  We did so enjoy our stay in the apt and would happily recommend it or stay here again if we return to the great city of Porto. A big thank you to Andreia and Joao.
Amazing location, terrific host  and very clean apartment with a great view from the terrace. Would definitely recommend the apartment to others.
We had a great time in Porto with our group of friends! Would definitely recommend this apartment 🤩

Eduardo’s place was 5 star all around and a perfect spot in Porto with our kids.  Check in was easy (and he arranged a taxi from the airport for us) and the apartment is in the heart of the lively and beautiful Ribeira neighborhood.  The apartment layout was perfect for kids.  We love being able to walk around the city and would definitely stay here again.

Excellent location, close to everything in Porto. The apartment is impeccable in every aspect (decoration, cleanliness, furniture, etc...) in an entirely renovated property. Manuel couldn't have been more helpful. Important fact: we traveled with a baby and everything was ready to receive him. We feel that he was also treated as a welcome guest. I highly recommend this apartment.

What a wonderful stay! The host from the very beginning  was beyond accommodating. So responsive from the beginning and incredibly helpful. Even though our flight was delayed, they met us and let us check in early- even greeted us with a glass of port! Comfy beds, modern showers, and gorgeous terrace. Couldn’t be happier with our stay and would definitely recommend!

Daniel´s apartment is very beautiful, comfortable and located in a great location. However, our check-in experience was a bit complicate; the cleaning was not done on our arrival and we had to wait one hour until the cleaning was done and we could enter the apartment. This was a bit frustrating.
It was great experience. Good location. Spotlessly clean. Nice place to stay. Thank you for your kindness.
I had such a lovely stay and Luis was an incredible host! I loved the natural wine bar and pizza shop down the street - 10/10 for the proximate location.
It was an amazing stay! We loved Porto, and you are part of it! I would definitely come back there. Thank you again and thanks for the flexibility at the end.  Have a lovely summer.
The location is great! And, the fresh bread each morning is a nice touch.  The hosts are quick to respond, which is great.  It's a bit noisy but great walkable location.

Catarina's place near Espinho is a vacation dream come true! Waking up to an ocean view from the window was amazing. The room was cozy, and the spacious balcony was a highlight. The shared spaces were always clean and well-equipped. The real gem was the sea-view balcony - perfect for relaxation and her friendly cats. Highly recommended!
I had a very nice stay in Marcias apartment. The terrace is a perfect place to relax. Marcias responds quickly and everything function in the apartment. I will recommend this place for everyone.
We really loved the apartment. It's beautifully decorated and the location is perfect. Marco replies really fast if you have a question. We felt very comfortable and safe.
Beautiful apartment in the perfect central location. Plenty of space for the five of us. Great communication and accommodated an early check in. Highly recommend!

We had a great time in the apartment. it was very clean and amazingly located, everything is a walking distance and the surroundings of the spyware beautiful. The hosts were very nice and gave us all we need. Highly recommended!!
On top of being a cozy and clean apartment, it comes with an amazing view. There are plenty of things nearby and the river is only a short walk away!

Very comfortable room. It feels like coming home. The location is convenient. The neighborhood is quiet. The landlord is very nice. Communication is timely. If I come again next time, I will choose this place!

Just the best stay at Susana’s place. It’s in a great part of town - with many restaurants and bars around and all major tourist destinations within walking destination. A less than 5 minute walk to the Trindade station with a direct metro connection to the airport. Despite the central location, the flat is quiet, spacious, bright and felt like a real haven in a bustling city. Porto was such a welcoming, friendly and exciting city!
We had the best time in this apartment. It's cozy, comfortable, stylish and well located. The hosts are really kind and available. Highly recommended!!

beautiful,  wide open, wooden staircase to access apartment on the 2nd floor. would not be good for someone with mobility issues. the only thing missing was a washing machine but we had clear instructions for local laundry services and could easily hand wash and there was a drying rack. Would highly recommend this apartment, local groceries and restaurants and easy access to  Portos sites. Our hosts son, Mateus was very responsive to our communication.
We loved the apartment.  It's in a great location and has wonderful natural light.  There are lots of good food options close by.  It was also great to be across the street from a park.

My Mom and I stayed at Pedro’s place before heading to 3 other destinations. The only downside of this being our first stop was that nothing else compared after this! Not only was the apartment spacious and immaculate, but Pedro is the sweetest, most helpful host. He really wanted to make sure we had everything we needed and that we enjoyed our stay. Not only did he provide amazing recommendations for Porto, he also sent recommendations for the other cities we were visiting. The apartment is located within walking distance of everything we wanted/ needed. Great restaurants and cafes nearby but not right in the middle of all the hustle and bustle. I would recommend this place to anyone and everyone. Thanks, Pedro, for being one of the highlights of our vacation in Portugal!
Joao's is a nice apartment in the very heart of Porto, an ideal base to discover the city. Joao gave us all the informations we needed to make it to the apartment.

Firstly, this is an excellent location from which to explore beautiful Porto. Secondly, the apartment is very smart and clean, with all the amenities you could hope for. And lastly, the communication was helpful and our welcome immaculate. I simply recommend this apartment to anybody wanting to spend time in this wonderful city .
Loved our stay in this beautiful flat ☀️☀️☀️Would highly recommend! Thanks a lot ❤️
Beautiful appartement, the location couldn't be more perfect and the communication went quick and nice. I would definitely recommend the appartement of Paula & Rafael!

All was good, except the internet. Staff were friendly, helpful and available. The place was clean, and on good location. Fixing the internet on my floor took 4 days. There were available internet on the ground floor, but it was often noisy.
Great location. Apartments could have been cleaner (showers had a bit of mold) but location was the best

Overall, the location is great, but there were stains on the couch and the place wasn’t thoroughly cleaned. We stayed for 5 nights and were only provided with 2 towels. Extra towels came at an additional charge of 30 euros, which isn’t ideal for a longer stay. That said, the host was responsive, and the location is very central, you're close to everything

We have enjoyed our stay in the nice and clean appartement of Rafaël. Thanks to his friendly advise we found al we needed in the area. The appartement is suited close to the river Douro, walking distance to the centre of town. We loved everything about is, Jan & Eva

Marta’s place was beautiful, very much like a boutique hotel.  Everything extra chic and high tech.  Codes to elevator, nice microwave and fridge built in smartly.  Marta was helpful when I asked questions about the area and any other questions I had.  We had an issue with the Wi-Fi as it was recently changed, however after calling I got someone who quickly explained the matter and provided the newly changed password. Beautiful apartment in quiet part of town.  Would love to stay there again in the future.
Had a lovely time in Porto for the weekend! The apartment is perfect as it is very central - we could walk everywhere! It is clean and comfy.
Great apartment with stunning view! Brilliant location for exploring Porto. Hildebrando is a very attentive host with great communication and hospitality :-)
Eugenia and Luis were responsive, friendly and had a beautiful apartment for our stay in Porto!

One most exquisite, warm and welcoming flat we have ever been. Dino and Ines were the best ever hosts, made a great effort to make us feel informed and ensured our comfort without been intrusive. As it was my  wife’s surprise birthday- they played into this too, making it the most memorable ever! There was a birthday cake, a bottle of bubbly in addition to the lovely flowers on arrival. We enjoyed our stay so much that we woukd love to return and as much as possible, recommend this accommodation for all else. This place is actually far better than what is on the website.

Great host and apartment. Very well located. Luis give us all the information we needed and even a huge list of places to visit and restaurants, shops, etc. He's the best Airbnb host a I have ever met.

We stayed 3 weeks at Pedro's place. Great location - very central to walk everywhere. We loved the living room balcony and the second floor bedroom with balcony.  The two bathrooms was a extra plus and very important - a comfortable bed.Pedro greeted us and gave us a nice tour of the neighborhood.  Pingo Doce full grocery two blocks away. We walked everywhere from our apartment. Nice restaurants, bakeries, (favorite Molete Bakery) cafes,  blocks away. Perfect stay for our first time in porto.
The apartment was bright and clean.  The settlement went quickly.  A negative impression was left by large stains of mold behind the bed.

Highly recommend this cute 1 bedroom in Porto! The location was fantastic and within walking distance to most tourist places, shopping, groceries, and laundry. The apartment was clean, airy, and relaxing. Thank you for the great accommodations during our stay in Porto!
Very spacious and clean  house in the old part of town. At walking distance from supermarket and the beach and also from the metro station.

Well located apartment, just a short walk to Livraria Lello. Lots of cafes and bars nearby. The apartment is fully spacious and fully equipped. Downside, no service elevator and located at the 2nd floor, but very minor compares to accessibility of the location.

The house is in Vila Nova de Gaia, about 30 mins by bus from the center of Porto (about 10-15 mins by car). It's calm and our hosts were extraordinarily nice, explained everything to us and were always available if needed. Would definitely choose the Airbnb again! :)

Filipa's apartment is located on the second floor of a building right on the Ribeira. The balcony gives an amazing view of Gaia and Douro River. We would pull the chairs up to the french windows and enjoy our coffee/tea/wine. Filipa also owns the wine bar on the first floor, although they only serve simple bar food, but they are very high quality and yummy. Filipa was very friendly and helpful. This place is a true gem, so much larger and better priced than the hotels in the area.
Despite being situated next to the train station, the apartment was so quiet and peaceful! Absolutely zero complaints, probably the best airbnb i’ve ever stayed in :)
Really nice place. The bedrooms are large and spacious, and there is a terrace along with a small balcony. We enjoyed having two bathrooms across four people!

We had a great stay. The apartment is exactly as described with a beautiful view of the river.  It is very close to the sights of Porto including the Ribeiro district. Tatiana was.a great host on behalf of Thierry and Nastia. She was very responsive and helpful with local tips. Thanks for a super stay.

Miguel’s condo was excellent. The location is perfect to walk anywhere among great restaurants and cafes, super close to the river. Kitchen is well equipped  to cook if needed, and the bed was very comfortable. We had a great stay.
This was great for me. I like to walk. So I could walk to tourist places and come back to the peaceful space. There were nice restaurants walkable as well. All great.
This place is in a great location. Decorated nicely. Newly remodeled. Great communication. Would stay here again.
The hospitality provided was exceptional. The space itself and location are perfect for couples and families visiting Porto. We had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend to others.

The stay at Teresa's place was perfect in every way. The host met us on arrival and walked us through everything about the apartment and surrounding neighborhood. The apartment is a quick walk to the city center but not too close to the tourist mobs. All the shops are close by and a little jazz collective is just up the block. We hope to stay again someday soon.

Jerónimo was such a great host, very friendly and obliging. The apartment was clean with the perfect location in Porto's historic centre. We will definitely recommend it and hope to be able to come back soon!

Good location - away from centre so quiet but easy to walk into city or get tram. Hosts were very responsive and helpful. Diogo gave us great restaurant recommendations as well as places to go and booked us an early morning taxi for the airport to catch our flight home. Would definitely stay again.

Great hosts and facilities, responded quickly with any questions and requests and very helpful, lots of cafes and the beach close by, tramline right outside which is convenient for travel if a little noisy at times.

Staying at Paulo’s apartment in Porto was a fantastic experience. Its central location allowed me to effortlessly explore the city on foot. The apartment was exceptionally clean, offering all the comforts needed for a pleasant stay. Paulo was quick to respond to any queries, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable visit. I appreciated his attention to detail and readiness to assist. I highly recommend Paulo’s place for anyone visiting Porto. It’s perfect for a comfortable and convenient stay. Looking forward to returning!
This apartment was a gem in Porto! It was very clean and the host was super helpful and kind.
The place and hosts were great! Very nice location,  and the noise from the party street below is very managable.  We had a fantastic time and will be back!
the cinema luxury house was perfect, exactly as described and Claudia was really great with communication. ideal location, can't recommend enough!
Ana Sofia’s place was just what we were looking for, and she was extremely helpful. We’d definitely stay there again.
One of the most beautiful place in Portugal  and Pedro is exceptional as a host. Great to know you Pedro and thank you for all the support provided during our stay in Porto 😊
One of the greatest view on Porto and the Douro river direct from the bed ! Such a great welcome, from Filipa and her husband. Don't miss the Quay Wine bar on the ground floor !!

The perfect week! Beautiful surroundings, lots of good places to eat nearby, very nice people all around. It was the perfect place for us, since we were taking surfing lessons and also wanted to go to Porto for the turistic activities. The hosts were amazing as well, super responsive, and they let us have an early check-in and a late checkout. 10/10 recommend.

Great flat in the perfect location as long you’re ok to walk up 4 flights of stairs. Really enjoyed our stay and the view is gorgeous! Love the fact that they’ve included a portable WiFi dongle with the flat so you can walk around Town without eating into your data.
Everything was almost perfect. Just the curtain on the upstairs bedroom needs to be fixed. except for that, the check in was very smooth and the appartement is great
I had a fantastic stay. The place is very close to the airport and the host is super kind, she came to pick me up very late and also offered a nice, unexpected, breakfast!

This was an amazing Air BnB experience.  The process was smooth and attentive.  Local tips were really appreciated and the location of the apartment could not have been better.  Possibly my best Air BnB experience to date.  Thank you for all the thoughtful details to make our stay perfect.

We want to say biggest thanks for the host! The place of apartament are located more than good, because it takes just 2-3 mins of walking to reach station from-to airport, city center, sightseeing bus. The apartament is clean 100 %, thry even meet us with Porto wine :) They helped us with tourist things etc. Likewise, you can feel 100% safe even in the middle of the night in this neighbourhood. The apartament is also ready for cooking at home or woth the kids :)Thank you once again!
Recommanded. The flat was clean, calm and nearby Porto city center. We had a very nice trip.

Overall the stay was fine, Isabel was really friendly and nice. The only caveat to any newcomers is to be aware of the humidity. Though there’s a humidifier it is extremely humid and the host let’s you know about it.

This apartment is modern, clean and very well equipped.   The kitchen is exceptional, and the apartment is bright and airy.   The location is great, with the downside that is located on a very busy pedestrian street with lots of people, street musicians, cafes, etc.   It is very noisy well into the night, and you cannot escape the noise in the bedroom.   It is quieter in the living room, so we slept on the fold out sofa.   Otherwise the apartment would have been perfect!

Couldn’t recommend this property more. The location was central and quiet. We came with a 1 year old and it was the perfect home from home. The property was very clean and we were surprised with the small added extras, a small outdoor balcony, wine and coffee, some toiletries and super helpful staff

An absolute gem of a place and location. Although we were visiting family/friends in the area the Sergios house made us never want to leave. The addition of the pool was also a great touch. We hope to be able to stay here again very soon.

Wonderful well furnished apartment located very conveniently. We travelled as a family of four and thae apartment offered a great space for all to read and relax. The kitchen was well stocked and the view from them living room was amazing. Close the windows and all hustle and bustle of the street disappeared.  Wonderful stay.

Wow. This was our favorite stay in Portugal. Everything was perfect - the location is so charming, I felt like I was in a romantic movie just sitting on the terrace! Within distance to wonderful local seafood restaurants and the riverfront, a short drive to the ocean coast, a short drive to Porto. Absolute perfection!!!! Stay here!

We had a great time with our stay here. Everything was exactly like the pictures en was all nice and clean. Marco and Carla were easy to contact en they informed us about nice places to eat nearby the apartment. I would recomment friends and family to stay at this apartement during there stay in Porto.

Well located, nicely designed, super clean, great communication and check in, parking solution within 3 minutes walk. All lovely…The only cons: not much space for suitcase… still we will come back without a doubt!
Such a nice place. Quite confortable. Close to a metro station but relatively near to the city centre.
Everything perfect. Really nice apartment in the city center. Sofia gave us some great restaurant recommendations. We hope to come back some day.

My friend and I had a great stay at Luis' place — the location of the apartment is fantastic, within walking distance to many attractions but also removed enough to be peaceful. The surrounding area itself had many nice stores and restaurants as well. The apartment itself was pretty much exactly as described and pictured in the listing, and we enjoyed the perks of having laundry in the building and a small balcony/garden in the back. Thank you to Carolina for your responsiveness during our stay, and for allowing us to store our luggage before and after check-in/check-out!
Fantastic spot in a perfect location. Brunna was even nice enough to give a list of recommended restaurants and activities that were all amazing!
This Airbnb is well located, super clean and the host where there to meet us and give us information on our first day in Porto. I really recommend this place.

A nice apartment in the middle of touristic part of the city with all upsides and downsides it brings. A lot of things to see around and I was able to return to it without any map multiple times because of how prominent the location is. A good place to stay for a few days while visiting the city.

Clean apartment, good communication with the host. The location of the apartment was great, lots of Cafés and close to all the sights. Nevertheless it was very noisy, especially at night. We couldn’t sleep well, because we heard music from a club all night.

Mario and Dulce are amazing hosts and people, lovely couple with a lovely apartment. You can really feel like you’re at home. Apartment is right in front of the beach, you just need to cross the street, station is around 4-5 minutes away (by foot), walkable everywhere and for me personally, their place is the most peaceful place I’ve ever stayed before ❤️❤️❤️❤️
Great apartment with a nice terrace (that we could not use, unfortunately, but that wat because of the bad weather), centrally located. We would always return! Thank you!
Nice flat lovely vintage flair. 10 minutes walking from the centre. Pedro was a great help with lots of hints. Some parts could have been a bit cleaner

Romain is a great host, the communication was clear and on time. The place was very beautiful, cozy and super clean, the location was very central with many restaurants around. We felt really comfortable during our stay :) I would definitely go back!

We had a lovely stay in Porto thanks to Márcia - very quick responses throughout, kept in touch to make sure we had everything we needed and gave a list of recommendations on places to see and eat. The apartment was exactly what we wanted - its a busy street and there are plenty of buskers but all were finished by or before 11pm, and all very talented! The window seat is a perfect spot for a coffee with a view. Perfectly located - would highly recommend!

Luis is the Prince of Porto, gave us lots of information and was very welcoming, excellent host, apartment was all you needed, great location, we had a fantastic 3 days and 2 nights (shame about the weather, but we will be coming back

We loved our stay at Miguel’s place!  It was beautifully appointed with 2 bathrooms and an upstairs loft bed ! Miguel greeted us and made us feel completely at home!  We would love to stay there again. Also centrally located  to all sights !!!

Great flat. Alaina & Jimmie were lovely hosts and very helpful. There are some good value restaurants nearby and a more pricey little hipster area just round the corner as well, if you like that sort of thing. The town centre is really close and it's very easy to get there from the airport. The upper terrace has great views and the lower one is a pleasant quiet spot for morning coffee, etc. The guys downstairs have some great wine as well.
Claudia is super helpful and willing to help us. The heater is a bit noisy though (even set as quite mode) but overall is a great place to stay and enjoy Porto.

We loved our stay in Porto, Eduardo and Helena were very friendly and welcoming and the apartment was spacious, comfortable, immaculate and had everything we needed for our stay. The location was amazing, 10mins walk to the city centre, quiet and with a few great restaurants nearby. Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Porto!

Thank you so much for letting us stay at your place. Everything was great. Great location and super clean. Great host that accommodated my family with a crib when needed. Also super great host that contacted me after I left my purse behind and ensured I got it back ! Thank you so much for everything ! Will be looking to stay again am next year !

The place's excellent location was incredibly convenient, within easy walking distance of the city center. There were plenty of restaurants in the area, and the property's cleanliness and orderliness made my stay enjoyable.
Hugo is a very accommodating host.  His place is in a great location with all the amenities you could want/need.  As well, his restaurant recommendations are pretty great.

We had an excellent time in Porto and a great stay at this beautiful apt that had an underground parking lot.   Had a few questions upon arrival and received timely responses.   Apt was nicely decorated and very comfortable.   Thanks..
Great location and great place to stay. Actually is bigger than it looks in the photos.  Would definitely recommend
Small but really nice place to stay. It has everything you need. There is no heating, however, the house counts with a heating device that it's enough. I would recommend this place to my friends.

Loved staying at this place. The beds and pillows were super comfy. There was a total of 6 people that stayed here with me and having a bathroom for each room was super beneficial. The balcony off the living room and private terraces in the back two rooms was also a nice treat to utilize in the mornings while sipping espresso or the evenings drinking beer or wine. The place is centrally located and is only a 15 min walk to the waterfront. We enjoyed the walk as there are beautiful architecture along the way as well as it gave us a good workout. Couldn’t be more happier choosing the place

Everything went well, Andre was very polite , communication was easy, checkin was very easy, apartment was very clean .  Location was a little far from luis bridge (30 minutes) but i was walking by foot so it is not big deal . I recommended

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb, it’s in an amazing location right on the river, a beautiful flat, and surrounded by many great bars and restaurants. Although it could sometimes get a bit noisy, everything else was absolutely fantastic and the host herself was great. Would highly recommend!
A great place to stay, simple with everything that you need! It is close to the Metro which makes getting into the city super easy. The hosts were very responsive and communication was great 😊
Do not hesitate to book Pedro's place. The location is super convenient and walkable to all the good to see places , and he keeps the place impeccably well.

It was my 3rd business trip to Porto so I've seen a few apartments in town. The toctoc studio was by far the best "home" I've booked in Portugal. Hugo is a great host and the description says it all. Actually it's even better!

This spot was so stunning it was hard to leave. It was bright, airy, comfortable and had a great and expansive view of the river. Hosts were great when self check in was glitchy and solved the issue within minutes.
We had the most wonderful stay. We will absolutely be back to Susanas place. The location in particular was incredible and she was such a fantastic host!
Alaina&Jimmie's place is in an amazing location, close to all the sites and a short walk from the major metro station. We had a lovely stay, and would recommend their place any time.

This place is in a great location!  Everything we wanted to see was within a 20 min walk. It was also very clean and a beautiful space. We were allowed to check in early to drop off our luggage.  Only one bathroom for 6 people was a little bit hard. The rooms upstairs were warm while downstairs was cold. Also not well stocked.  No paper towel and only one kitchen towel.  When we asked for dish soap we were told they weren’t allowed to stock that. Host did not always respond very quickly.
It was so nice to stay with kids.   My family spends a pleasant vacation in a spacious and comfortable environment.  thank you💛

Tiago is very responsive with the mail, it's very pleasant, thank you ! The accommodation is cute and matches with the photos. The location with the metro is really very convenient especially to go to the airport. However for the winter it is a little cold, because there is no real heating, so towels are hard to dry, and the sheets are a bit damp... For a romantic weekend, it's lovely and perfect, i recommend !

Luis was a very helpful host,  he gave us tons of infos about things to do in Porto and places to visit. The apartment is very well located and the surroundings are very quiet, especially when you’re having a meal on the balcony (which is very pleasant). I would 100% recommend this place to stay in Porto!

Very nice apartment close to the beach and restaurants. Toilet and AC on all rooms is a big plus. The hosts answered really fast and was helpful! Only minus is that there was neighbours that where very sensitive to noise that complained about us only talking after 22, but this is not the hosts fault but still annoying. Would still recommend.
Jorge was an great host and the place was very clean and looked as expected. I would definitely recommend for the price and location.

Florinda has a lovely place in Porto. Amazing views of the city and we had a very pleasant stay. Florinda was an awesome host and gave us superb recommendations about where to eat in the local area. Highly recommend staying here when in Porto!

Overall the place is nice and the communication was easy. The open space was very nice and the AC worked great. Only thing I wish they had was an iron. For people traveling and having wrinkled clothing I feel this is a necessity for Airbnb hosts to provide. Especially with the price paid for this place.
Although i never had the pleasure of meeting Susana her place was fabulous and exactly as described. The location was perfect and we will miss the apartment and just lived Porto.

lovely accommodation, very central next to Sao Bento station. Air-conditioning and balcony a definite bonus. very small apartment but fine for a single person or couple for a short time. please note there is an elevator which mat be beneficial to guests with mobility issues aa the apartment us on the 3rd floor (almost 60 steps!!!) Things which could have improved our stay: a handle in inside of bathroom door (it's difficult to slide open and shut)  another comfortable chair in the living room area a tea towel to dry dishes more plug points in the kitchen more pillows however, these are only suggestions. we enjoyed our stay,  recommend and would stay again. thank you

Everything was just PERFECT. Super nice with amenities, comfy bed, kind host and literally ASTONISHING view.  I highly recommend this apartment who visit Porto, and I booked here again for my next travel to Porto, right after I checked out for this staying.

Great location located on the third floor of a central building in the middle of a historical area. The style of the apartment is quite welcoming and inviting despite the small space all amenities are immaculate and sparkling clean. Upon checkin,  the host was quite responsive and met us in person. We were provided with a manual of local tips. The wine and sweets upon arrival were excellent touch especially after a long flight. The host is really responsive. I cannot find the place I highly recommend it we will definitely be back. The fan was sufficient for air circulation in  addition to the windows being left open at night, and it was quiet not noisy. The coffee pods were really good quality and the tea. I would give this stay 100/100

My first airbnb experience and Celia raised the bar very high for my next airbnb experience. Very close to airport and public transport. Clean room and bathroom.  Celia is a caring host who helps you out and makes sure you are fine.

The positives: Very quiet cute flat in a nice area of Porto. Good check in. Lovely building. Wonderful to have such a good shower and great black-out blind! TV. Amazing restaurant only two doors away (try the sardines!). Good transport links. Clean. The negatives: Very stuffy as only one window in the whole flat and that doesn't open fully for ventilation. Probably some of the blankets could be refreshed or washable as I don't like using anything that has been used by previous guests. Mattress not very comfortable. Hob difficult to use to the point we couldn't actually cook at home.

this was overall a great stay! super close to city center and very modern with all appliances you would need for your stay! there were some minor things that needed to be cleaned before we got there, but it was nothing major that ruined our trip! highly recommend this airbnb for couples or single travelers! :)
Great apartment, great location, great host !! Not much else needs saying. A++ stay, can recommend :)

I was there for a month and this was one of the best apartments I've stayed in with Airbnb. All the appliances were top quality and seemed brand new. The AC works well and the TV is particularly huge and set up perfectly to watch from the bed. There were a few small issues during my stay, but these were all resolved quickly and professionally. My only gripe would be the sound of footsteps coming from the apartment above. I was particularly aware every time my upstairs neighbour started moving around.

We loved this wonderful studio apartment.... Well situated, very clean and inviting.  Hugo met us at the apt and made us feel welcomed - showing us local attractions on the map . We would highly recommend this wonderful apartment...

Gustavo welcomed us late at night, took the time to show us around the flat and gave us some tips on places to go/eat! The flat is really clean and located about 20 mins walk from the centre. The bed is super comfy and we slept really well but if you are not used to city noise, you might find the traffic a little distracting.
