My stay at this Airbnb in Porto was absolutely perfect! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and beautifully set up, offering everything we needed for a cozy and enjoyable visit. Its central location made it incredibly easy to explore the city’s iconic spots and hidden gems. What made this stay truly special was the host. They went above and beyond to ensure we had an amazing experience—super communicative, accommodating, and always ready with helpful suggestions to make the most of our time in Porto. Their attention to detail and genuine care made us feel right at home. This was hands-down one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable stay in Porto!

We had a great stay at Paula & Rafael’s. The apartment is in a perfect location with many great brunch restaurants nearby. We were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. The kitchen was well equipped for cooking and the bed was quite comfortable. We’d recommend the apartment!

Beautiful and simple home comforts. Isabel is a wonderful host and has a lovely young family, which are a joy to be around. Excellent location - easy walk to Santa Clara metro. Close to beach, River, swimming pool, shops, cinema, cafes- everything you need. Would definitely like to stay here again

Great location and views.  Old historic house with charm as described.  Owner was helpful for checkin snd suggestions.  Biggest issue was lots if ants in kitchen.  We kept it spotless and still had them and could only use the kitchen to make coffee

Highly recommend this place! The hosts are very kind and responsive and accommodating (they made check in easy for us even if we were arriving late). They also provided a small guidebook of recommendations that were AMAZING!  The place itself was amazingly clean and very cute!! It was in a fantastic central location and easily walkable to a bunch of sites. Bathroom was cute and clean and stylish and the stone wall in the apartment was very nice.  Checkout was also easy! Loved this place!

We had a very nice stay in Porto. We briefly had problems checking in, but help came quickly. It was very helpful for us that the check-in was possible very late. very good location and good communication with the hostess! Thank you!
Everything was perfect , especaily the host Nuria who gave quick intro in everything we should see in Porto
Formosa was very kind & attentive. Her accommodation was very clean & located in a convenient location. I would definitely stay again!

This apartment was great for our group of four! It was clean, spacious, had modern amenities, and a great AC. It was located close to several restaurants and monuments. The check in instructions were clear and finding the apartment was simple. I would highly recommend staying here!

Isabel's place is a great located and well equipped place to stay in porto. Isabel was very welcoming, kind and very helpful giving suggestions for places to eat and to sightsee. I can not recommend enough.
It was a 5 star house, close to the city center, I would like to stay in the same house again when I come again.

The apartment is in a very central location with a lovely view out over Porto. It has a nice balcony on which to relax with a glass or two. There are also a couple of small grocery shops just up the hill from which you can get the basics of what you need. There is also a nice little bar about 10 mins away, again up the hill to the left with a nice view down the river. Everything that you would probably wish to see, sights, etc, is within in walking distance, although, for those unfamiliar with Porto, you'll need a strong pair of legs !!!. I would recommend a tour of at least one of the Port Lodges, otherwise just wander and take in things as you go.  David and his staff are just a couple of minutes from the apartment in scooter rental shop, so, if you need advice, etc, it's on tap so to speak. Would I use this apartment again ?. Yes, without question.

Very good host! We enjoyed our stay at Alvaro’s. The apartment had everything what we needed. The location is a bit outside the city center and it’s quite steep to walk around. He had a car, so it wasn’t a big deal anyways.  Thank you Alvaro, for your hospitality!

it was second time we stayed here. and everything was good as usual. Just some minor things that would improve experience: there was no salt, pepper, or sponge for washing dishes, although this was indicated in the description of the apartment. Also second time there was no kettle but it was pointed out at check-in and Diogo fixed the issue momentarily. One more thing to note though: the apartment comes without central heating (as it correctly stated in the description) so it might be a bit chilly without AC (apt has it) running on (привет ребятам из стран с центральным отоплением).
Lovely apartment.  Central location to the port  .  Would definitely return and loved our time there.   Thank you Maria
Perfect location and host for visiting Porto.   The appartement is great and include everything you need. I would comeback anytime ! Thanks João for everything.

We had a great stay at Marco and Carla’s place. The apartment is easy to navigate to from the train station and located within walking distance to all of the major sites. Carla welcomed us when we arrived and provided us with a map and guide. Highly recommend this place for a couple or solo traveler!

We stayed at Pedro's place for a long weekend and it was a pleasant stay. The room was quite nice and spacious, as the whole apartment is. It is well located near the metro and in walking distance to the city centre with the main sights. Pedro is a cool host and doesn't hesitate to give advices if you need. Only thing I would criticize is the cleaning frequency of the kitchen. But all in all a very recommendable place to stay.
Nice place! Happy to stay here again some time. Right in the city centre so no problem getting anywhere.
This placewas exactly what we were looking for in Portom it's a great location and great apartment.  despite being on the top floor, it stays very cool
The apartment was in a fantastic location - very walkable and close to the river.  It was clean and we were very comfortable staying there.
We really enjoyed staying in this apartment. Very beautiful and close location to the city center. Margarida is a very kind and friendly host. Highly recommended.

Majestic and beautiful! We had an amazing stay at the Manor house. Our host was so accommodating  and gracious. We couldn'thave asked for a better arrival and adventure in Porto. The 3 bedroom apartment was extremely spacious with the best view of the entire riverfront. The terrace was the best terrace in Porto, perched high above the city, we never needed to leave. We can't wait to go back!

This is a beautiful and convenient place to stay -- away from the hustle and bustle (and touristy nature) of central Porto.  Foz is a great neighborhood right by the sea and by the mouth of the Douro and a great place to be.  If you want to spend every moment of the day at one of the tourist attractions in central Porto with other tourists, then you probably want to find a different place that is more centrally located.  But if you want something more Portuguese in flavor and more relaxed, this is the place to come.  The apartment is beautiful and well laid out.  A well-appointed kitchen, great bathroom, very nice living room/dining area, and a private and cozy bedroom with a very good bed and lots of closet space.  Worked very well for us as a couple and would be fine for a couple with a child. Highly recommended.

A really great place to stay. It's central, spacious, clean, lovely decor and very comfortable. Lots of nice extras like bread and pastries delivered to your door every morning, coffee, jam ,butter etc all in the fridge. Great views from our top floor flat and plenty of exercise getting up to it! Our lovely hosts were very helpful with local tips and nothing was too much trouble. Highly recommended.
Beautiful apartment very close to the center of Porto. Comfortable and with great amenities. Host was helpful and responsive.

It is what you see, beautiful and private. It’s really in the center so if you visit uptown you’re halfway up, and if you want to visit downtown you’re halfway down! Really close to all public transport to airport and others.  The supplies were limited, and  communication with hosts was quite impersonal. You don’t see or interact with hosts at check in nor check out.  We were there with 4 people for 5days… and we had 3toilet paper rolls. When we asked for more, they said even those 3 were courtesy…  There was no household paper, and there is a dishwasher but no soap for it… So if you’re traveling, expect to do a full household grocery run. Airbnb used to be more personal, about vacationing in someone’s home… this was an impersonal experience but all in all still a good location, facility and experience :)

Excellent location, several minutes walk from metro station. Close to many attractions of the city center. Clean appartment with a very clean bathroom and kitchen. Excellent communication with the owner. One of the best places I've ever stayed.

Great place for a city break. Perfectly located in the central area of Porto this flat is so well designedand has everything one can need during their stay. Every detail is fine and convenient for a traveller.  Terrace is a pure treasure! Bed is very comfortable. Kitchen is very well equipped.  Susana is a true SuperHost and deserves that status 100%. Never met more helpful and caring host, although we travel a lot. Thanks a lot for making us feel like at home.
Nice little house, very comfortable and very clean. Equipped with everything you need. Great location.

Beautiful best area located apartment, the view is beyond imagination to the old Town just like a fairytale like you went back to medieval times.. Bed is super comfortable and worth the price for sure!

This is a nice and comfortable place and the hoste(Teodoro) is someone very nice, always willing to help ;and I recommend this ofcourse.I'm looking forward to be in Porto again and will be in the same place for sure.
We enjoyed the time at Joao's apartment. The apartment is cosy, clean and includes everything you need.
Would definitely recommend this place. We received lots of wonderful tips and helpful info on getting around. The place was super comfortable and spacious.

Thank you Daniel and Maria for hosting us! Although the stay was short, I was given many useful tips and information about my stay! This apartment is very private and quiet and the bonus is that you have two toilets which comes very handy when you have many Travelers loving together!

Great location with lots of things to do and beautiful scenery. The apartment is very close to the Metro but also close enough to walk into the main town. The shower was amazing and the apartment is exactly what you see in the photos.
would recommend if you're wanting to party, can be loud in the early hours if you're wanting to get up early!
Great host,  They made our trip special.. a great welcome and a lot of advices to enjoy our trip.  The place is nice and close to the city or the ocean! Will definitly recomand!

I think everything was as described and just right for me.  I would have liked somewhere to hang my clothes even though I was only staying for a couple of days and a mirror in the room.  But I managed.  I travel quite a lot and usually find my way to the metro/buses fairly quickly, but I guess as it was a holiday when I arrived 15 August, everything seemed dead..  But nowhere is very far with an uber.  Teresa was super helpful about everything and I would highly recommend it.  Peaceful and quiet at night, good night's sleep.  Good bathroom and kitchen facilities, basically a home.  Thank you Teresa, Im sure I'll be back!
Beautiful place! Excellent view and amazing space. Bonus if bringing a car as there is onsite parking. Will definitely return!

We loved our stay here! Very close to public transit and popular Porto attractions like Livraria Lello. The place was clean, spacious, and exactly as described, and the hosts were incredibly helpful in letting us check in early. We would definitely stay here again!
Joana's home is nothing less than amazing!!! She was the best host I have ever had on Airbnb, so kind and very understanding! We would love to come back again!.

Wonderful house set away from the road. 5 minute walk to the river downhill, cafes restaurants etc. or 5 minute walk uphill to the Jardim do Morro and the best sunset views. The famous Port Wine houses are on the doorstep.The house is just perfectly sited. After a day walking up and down the alleyways, the house is a peaceful haven at night to return to.  Spotlessly clean, comfortable beds, well equipped kitchen, powerful shower. Nice balcony to enjoy the views and sunsets. Breakfast is included at the local Mercrearia do Bernardino, where Paula and her staff just can't do enough for you. Croissants, bread, cakes, yoghurt, cheese, ham, coffee, tea and more, sets you up for the many hills and steps of Besutiful Gaia and Porto. We will be back soon.

Tomas' place is in a great location, within walking distance of the Ribiera and all the shopping, eating and drinking locations in Porto.  A supermarket is  just around the corner and a pharmacy is across the street. His communication was great and there were refreshments and a bottle of wine waiting for us on arrival. The apartment is really nicely decorated and furnished and we felt at home right away. Tomas' office is also located in the building so he is always on hand if you need anything. Trasca, the tapas/wine bar next to the front door has great food and wine, highly recommended.

This place was our favorite Airbnb we have ever stayed in. The place was impeccable and host was super helpful and responsive. Place was so comfortable and well situated. We have only positive things to say about this apt and Hailey.

If I could give more stars I would, it was the gem of our time spent in Portugal, only regret was that we didn’t book for the whole time instead of hopping around. The home owner Grace was very kind and helpful, the street parking was a worry as we had many stressful issues with parking at other stays, but home is situated on a dead end street that is wide enough to accommodate 2 wat traffic, we felt extremely safe both inside the property as well as leaving the car on the street. Was very walkable to the ocean front where we spent every day at, would come back to cook meals then head back out on foot to see more sites. Such a memorable stat, can’t recommend enough, thank you!
Wonderful place with the best location in Porto! Maria Julietta is wonderful host! She is really in love with Porto! Thanx!

Wonderful apartment in Porto. The apartment has everything you need and is located in the arts District close to downtown. The apartment is comfortable and is bright and sunny which is important. I had a great day and will return.
Great to experience authentic Porto architecture in such a beautiful space! And the location was perfect! Easy to walk pretty much anywhere but lots of great places nearby.
Smell was bad, window to allow smell out was too small to vent effectively or cool the room. Host was rather mean in her responses

Very very very nice apartment. Fully equipped. Located in the city center. Very quiet place. One stair down to get access. Grocery store around the corner. We were welcomed with Port and fruits :-). We recommend highly.
It was a really nice neighborhood and Maria is such a sweet lady. She's very hospitable and showed us where to go.

Great place close to Trinidade metro station with direct connection to the airport. We explored Porto on foot for two days. Many attractions, restaurants and grocery stores are within walking distance. The street is quiet at night even though there are bars and restaurants close by.
This place is even better than it looks in the photos. The sun is on the balcony all day and the views are amazing.
Very well located. Space itself is comfortable. Florinda (host) is very kind and responsive. Although we've had some problem with hot water due to the storm it has been fixed very fast

Lovely 5 night stay. Diogo was a great host, helpful with local recommendations and kindly offering for us to leave our luggage in the house until our evening flight home. Great space for our family of 2 adults + 2 teenagers.  15 min walk to the city centre, 30 min walk to the beach. We loved the layout and decor of the house, very well thought out and comfortable. We had a wonderful time evploring Oporto!

Carla's apartment is perfectly located in the center of Porto.  It's within walking distance to all the major sites and half a block from tbd metro. The apartment is brand new and stunning.  Very clean and the perfect size.  The photos do not do it justice.  I really enjoyed my stay.  Definitively the best air b n b apartment I have ever rented.  If you are visiting Porto then stay here!
The place is very well located in the city centre and close to the tube station and great restaurants and bakeries. The apartment was super clean and the host was super friendly.

Célia is a kind person and pro active to know what guests wants in advance. Added she has great tips to roam around Porto and things to try. The place is awesome for a small family and vey near to Metro station. The property is extremely clean and we felt like home. Would definitely recommend the place and I have decided this would be place to stay , whenever we visit Porto.

I spent one night in Alexandre and Sonias apartment with my boyfriend on the way from Portugal to Spain. I will recommend the place highly to every one. Very good value for the money! The apartment looks even more amazing real life than on the pictures. Also very clean and tidy,.Alexandre was also very helpful with our check in and all other questions we had during our stay. Very convenient if you are passing by porto like we did, since the train station is just a couple of minutes away.

It was a very nice stay in a stylish loft. Even though we did not meet the host personally, we were in constant contact and were able to contact Belina with all the questions. The location was also good - quiet but not far away from all the sights.

This airbnb was very charming! It was extremely comfortable for 3 people, had all accommodations and was very clean. The only tough part was walking up 5 or so flights of stairs with heavy luggage, but in my opinion, it was well worth it! Definitely would note that the airbnb itself is two floors, with one bathroom being downstairs. Nice living area and television on the first floor too. Tomas was easy to communicate with and was able to allow us to check in early when we arrived in the city before check in time. The location is in the main hub of Porto which was good for us (being tourists), but the airbnb itself remains very quiet and you cannot hear any pedestrians on the street below. Would recommend staying here!

The apartment is absolutely perfect. Centrally located but on a quiet street. host is nice, accessible and helpful. very easy check-in and check-out. The apartment is newly refurbished, really nice ,cozy and with all the facilities you need. I would love to come back myself and highly recommend to everyone else. Thanks a lot to Carolina for a really enjoyable stay

We had an amazing time at Carolina’s, she was very helpful and responsive and the appartement had everything we needed! It didn’t take much walking around for us to realize how great the location is, nearby all the different attractions of Porto and with a beautiful view from the balcony! Was worth every penny!
Nuno’s place is well located and it has everything you need. He was very nice and responded quickly, and we were able to enjoy our stay because of this great place! Highly recommend!

Beautiful apartment, well located for walking into the centre and to all the amenities. Loved the style of the space and was well equipped with lots of extras such as dishwasher and washing machine tabs. Would definitely recommend to friends and family visiting this fabulous city.

I spent a lovely weekend at Ana’s place and it was great. Location is Central, the apartment is clean and you have everything you need close to supermarket, cafes, restaurants, the touristic spots. The communication was fast. I was allowed to check in earlier than planned as my flight was early in the morning. The apartment is highly recommended
Nice place. check-in was good, but a little late, which wasn’t really a problem for us

Great place to stay and a really well designed space. We stayed with our 5 year old. The bed is comfy and the sofa bed was great for him too. It’s a short walk into central Porto. The communication was easy, clear and fast. I’d recommend it to all :-)
The house is located in a nice area but has little lighting due to no outside facing windows. The room was clean.

The apartment is located in a really strategic area of the city, from where you can move by feet to reach the most important monuments and churches. Inside it is confortable: the owner agency is really well organized with a phone service that gives you assistance until 2am. The boy who welcomed us in the apartment had been really kind and ready to give us really useful advices to enjoy the city in the best way

Wonderful location! The metro is right down the road and the view was spectacular over the river. Clean, great space for 3 of us. Bruno and his family were helpful and so kind. Would very much recommend anyone to stay here!
Great view to both sides! Super clean and comfortable! Awesome customer service! We‘d come back for sure!

I stayed a weekend at Isabel's lovely home. The location is perfect, right in the middle of the old part of Vila do Conde, close to the restaurants and bars. The room and bathroom are clean and bright.  The wifi was strong and the bed was very comfortable. Isabel also gave me a lot of privacy. I would highly recommend staying in Isabel's home!

This place is one of the best airbnbs I've stayed in.  The location is central in Porto, the hosts are lovely, beds were comfortable and appreciate all the little touches they've put on the place like a home gym, welcome bottle of port, etc.
Just far enough from night life to enjoy a great rest but close enough walking distance to all of the fun.  Super host with great recommendations and above and beyond service.
Lovely lovely hosts who provide you all the information you need to know, even before reaching the city. Thank you Dino and Ines for sharing your beautiful home with us.
Great location, clean and lovely apartment, right next to all restaurants and main attractions.  Pedro had great ideas about where to go as well. Loved it

The check in was smooth and prompt communication throughout. The location of the place is amazing! So close to everything and great for exploring Porto. Rui was such a friendly host and glad to have stayed here!
Beautiful flat, very clean and well located  at a 10 minutes walking distance from the city center. Fernando is very nice and the communication was easy.  We had a perfect stay!

We moved to Portugal and lived in this lovely place for 3 weeks while we looked for a long term rent in Porto. Claudia and her mum Laura are very helpful and polite hosts, always willing to help in all matters! The house itself is endlessly lovely - it's fresh, clean, everything you need is available and the terrace is gorgeous! It was comfortable for 2 of us to work and rest here. We were with our 2 gentle pets, special thanks for being pet friendly♥️ When looking for a long term flat, we unintentionally raised our bar of choice because we wanted the same level of comfort as Claudia's home. Thank you for reducing our stress of moving to a new country through the cosiness and beauty of this house🙌
Wonderful place to stay great location, lovely loft. A little noisy from the street and quite dark but neither bothered me. I liked having the doors open :)

Great experience both checking in and our stay with Goncalo. only regret is not staying longer. wonderful location. well situated to many great restaurants and the beach but also quiet and serene enough to get a good night's rest. This host clearly knows what he's doing. I have nothing to offer in terms of criticism.

Maria’s apartment is in a fantastic location with a beautiful view of the sea.  It has all features that we could have asked for. Parking is also quite easy outside.  Maria and her husband are very friendly and made us feel very welcome!

A nice flat in a very small and quiet road, in a very authentic neighbourhood.   Comfortable for 5 people, it is on the second (top) floor of a small building with charm, overlooking gardens at the back.  Very close to a good supermarket, and not too far from the centre.  We had a good stay!

Amazing place in a great location. Well decorated and every detail has been thought about—from bottled water in the fridge to a carafe of port! On a quieter street, very clean and Hugo was a great host!

Lisa’s apartment was in an excellent position to enjoy Porto!   It was walking distance to the Ponte Luis 1 and the bustling Ribeira area for all a tourist could want - restaurants, bars, boat hire, bike hire, port tasting and just at the top of the furnicular for when you need to get back home! The only draw back was a very strong mouldy smell so we had all windows open, but with no screens on the windows we had a serious mosquitoes problem!   But position wise it was just perfect.

We had such a great time in this wonderful appartement. The flat is exactly as it looks in the pictures. Very comfortable and has everything you need. The district is very good and you can reach the city centre by walking. Ana is great hosts - Top recommendation!
I loved the location and proximity to all the attractions. Daniel's place is very clean and well stocked with so many items.

The apartment is lovely, pretty clean, and very well located.  The common space was big, the beds were comfortable, and it was nice that there were so many bathrooms for a large group (although we found it odd that three of the bathrooms located directly in the bedrooms lacked doors and were transparent!).  It should be noted that his apartment is listed as accommodating 15 people, but it really shouldn't be for more than 12 adults.  There are only two sofa beds, not three (as listed), and they are not very comfortable -- certainly not for 2 people!  Also worth noting is that this is not run by an individual host, but a rental agency.  Which has it's perks, since they are on the first floor of the building and quite available.  But sometimes communication can be a little disorganized. There was also a broken window pane in the living room, but I'm sure they will get it fixed soon!

Very stylish, clean with high end finishes.  Bottle of Port and some Nata pastries on arrival were a welcome touch.  15 minute walk to the riverfront.  Just be aware there are 4 flights of stairs and no elevator.

Nice location and great restaurants nearby, Monteen is a definite recommendation. A nice fruit shop and bakery with friendly owners on the square. A short walk to transport and to city centre. The apartment is as described although the shower did leak each time it was used, and as others have noted there is a damp smell common to these older buildings. Otherwise a nice stay to enjoy a lovely city.
Highly recommended for its location. The communication with Victor’s great, he was very helpful with everything we needed. Next time we go to Porto, we will definitely stay at Victor’s.
Great location close to many attractions, restaurants, bars and supermarket.  Apartment was very cozy, clean. We enjoyed the balcony with city view.

The home is beautiful with an amazing garden all to yourself. We thoroughly enjoyed the home and Porto. Great location. It is a bit noisy but you soon get used to that. Other than that we adored staying at Casa Amarela.

We had a great stay here! The location is really nice. It was easy to walk to everything we wanted to see in Porto. There is a wonderful view from the apartment as well as a fantastic viewpoint right around the corner.

Everything about this trip was perfect but what really made it was the accommodation and the service provided by Cristina. Her place is in the most perfect location. Walking distance of... well everything really, in a very popular (but quiet at night when needed) and had everything you need for a your stay. Cristina was fantastic with suggestions of things to do and her friendly show around check-in process added that extra touch. Already looking to go back for NYE!

Beautiful building and apartment; I don't have any issues with the place itself, it was quite nice, but the checkin procedure was difficult.  It seemed like there was no communication between the person letting us in and the host, which was pretty stressful.  The person letting us in didn't seem to know when we were planning to arrive, and our messages to the host didn't seem to be relayed.

The place was clean and comfortable and it answered perfectly our need while visiting Porto. There are private parkings in the area that you can use as the streets are narrow.  The check in felt a bit rushed as the internet malfunction can sometimes be an issue with opening the door and the host didn’t mention this in the instructions.  At checkout, the cleaning lady came before the checkout time despite us saying that we would message the host when we would leave.  Despite these miscommunications, the place was great, functional and quiet.

Location was amazing. Room was spacious with lots of natural light.  Family of four no issues.  Many great locations to eat. Parking was 1min away under ground at 80euro for two nights. Tuktuks right around the corner. A must do to explore city and get to know the locations and hot spots. 1.5hr 80euro but well worth it.  Walking distance to The water was 15min walk. I would stay at this place with my family again.
Perfect appartement in the historic center of Porto. Really nice interior, everything you might need (even an umbrella 🤞🏻). We felt right at home! Maria was a really friendly and courteous host!
This was the best spot in Porto. Close to everything, clean and host was so helpful!!! I highly recommend!
Márcia’s apartment is a nice studio on a great street in the heart of Porto. It was very convenient and we had a great stay!
Great location, beautiful view and the most peaceful night. best sleep ever.  really enjoyed the view from the balcony.
Great apartment centrally located.  Nice sized space, clean and well kept.  Would certainly stay here again.

Great location with areas of interest in close proximity. Host was very responsive and offered immediate assistance when we reached out to them about drainage issues in one of the bathrooms. Overall, enjoyed our stay!
The location is super good, close to the port , we were able to walk everywhere. The apartment is clean and tidy. Host were kind and informative! Had a pleasant stay in Porto

Thank you for having us. The appartement is very well furnished and decoration was made with very good taste. The place is quiet even if located in the city center. Would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone.

Beautiful, elegant and well equipped apartment loft. Fantastic location, easy to find, very easy check in, walkable from metro (8 min). It is next door to Casa Guedes which has out of this world Bocadillos de Pernil, make sure you try it! Lots of great restaurants and cafes nearby. The apartment is quiet, it has lovely soft pillows and very comfortable mattress. We had a perfect night sleep!

Great flat in the centre of Porto! Daniel is also super helpful. The flat is modern and spacious. It also comes with parking which is a great advantage given  its central location. Would not hesitate to recommend!
This place was really beautiful, the bed was confortable and the apartment was very clean! My friend and I had a very nice stay at this place :)

I've booked over 40 airbnbs in 10 countries and this is one of the best. Not only because of the amazing hosts, but the apartment is comfortable (great beds and couch, equipped kitchen, a convenient neighborhood with markets and restaurants, near the main sites, AND parking in the building with an elevator. Sunset and sunrise views, and quiet neighbors despite being in the city.

The place is very close to the inner city. Check-In and Check-Out was easy, the place itself was clean, lots of natural light and a good atmosphere. The only thing that bothered us was the constant showering of other people- but that is to be expected with a shared bathroom.  Mario is very friendly and gave great recommendations for the city. We stayed as a couple, which worked fine but we recommend the place more as a stay for friends.

Gorgeous listing in the HEART of Porto. Irene’s listing is just as described and she was fantastic with communication and expectations. If you have a car, you can park at Praça Dom João parking garage right by the listing for a fee. However, staying at Irene’s - you won’t need a car to explore the gorgeous city!
Antonio's place was exactly as it was described. Paula , the housekeeper is a very nice and helpful. We recommend the place.

We stayed here as a group of 7 and it was amazing! So spacious, beautiful set up and location, the easiest check in and out process! Honestly couldn’t recommend more, it was the perfect spot to see Porto and our hosts were so quick at responding and so helpful with local recommendations!

Wonderful place with an incredibly helpful host. Susan’s small hotel was superb, clean, stylish and comfortable. We had the entire place except for the rear villa and it worked great for our group of 12. The rooms were spotless, the beds comfortable and the shower the best we’ve encountered while traveling. The staff was friendly and helpful and made us a wonderful breakfast each morning. Easy location to explore Porto. Almada 331 is a small restaurant just down the street with a warm and engaging host. This property is obviously very well run and it was a delight to stay there. Our group agreed we would enthusiastically recommend it to others.

I've stayed at Home Me in a business trip and enjoyed it a lot. The photos are super accurate and the apartment couldn't be better located. Also, very enjoyable stay with all the amenities and super friendly host that wouldn't mind waiting after a flight delay. Also, very soundproof house, if you want to sleep well this is your place!   The only thing to point as less positive was that the house was a bit dusty. Either way, I recommend it without a doubt in mind and I'll definitely stay here again if available. Thank you Home Me! :)
Everything was clean and nice, location was good as well. The hitting didn’t work well, but they fixed the problem immediately

Exactly what we needed! Super location, near the best restaurants and bars but quite during the night. Cozy and very well equipped. Flat was warm and very clean. Great bakery just on the corner 👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻highly recommended 🥯🥐🥞  Would definitely comeback 🌼☀️🙌🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼
Really good guesthouse with comfortable and clean rooms the host was super nice and friendly would definitely recommend it
A bit noisy at night but orherwise perfect, the location is excelent, easy checkin, private parking right across the street. I would stay there again.

My mom and I had a positively memorable time in Porto and it’s a huge thanks to our host! They were responsive, helpful, and enthusiastic. We felt right at home despite being miles away from home. Very clean, organized, and welcoming space.
The apartment was very clean and located perfectly for exploring Porto. Communication with Rute was swift and she provided us with nice tips for interesting places around.

This apartment was a gem, good value for money, great location - very central, clean and lovely flat! Mateus was an amazing host, very communicative and was always ready to help if we needed anything. We would 100% stay again and we really enjoyed our time in Porto :)

The place is very cool! Everything is very walkable. Tons of restaurants and historic sites right out the door. The apartment itself is surprisingly quiet even though it’s in the midst of of so much constant activity.

The place was perfect for our trip. Always clear and detailed instructions from the host. Lots of information provided and shuttle service available for early flights. The place itself was spacious, well equipped and a great location. Very easily walkable for us. Would definitely recommend it overall!
Great location, very close to the metro station, restaurants, stores. Lovely place, very clean, comfortable, you feel like home. Perfect for 2 people. Good communication.
Great studio apartment. Close to a supermarket and metro station. Very easy to get around. Nice area with park nearby. The inside of the apartment was well kept and has everything you need
Our stay was good. The location was really great, close to nice supermarkets and restaurants. Sven and Sandra communicated well and quickly, which was really important. Thank you

Absolutely loved our stay at Miguel’s place. First solo holiday and we were a group of young girls, felt very safe and secure. The place was clean, spacious and comfortable with everything you’d need. The apartment was within walking distance of the port, local shops and metro. The beach was only about 30 mins away by metro and there was a lidl close by too. Miguel was very responsive to our questions and left a lovely planner full of amazing activities to do in Porto. The only downside to the place is that the hot water in the shower ran cold after a few minutes. Apart from this, the apartment was practically perfect. Would definitely recommend and love to come back again soon.

Jorge and Olga was very responsive. Apartment was clean and like pictures. If you walk to the Beach and turn right you head to Espinho. The beach is absolutely beautiful and there are lots of great restaurants, bars and things to do. Surfing is great. Thank you Jorge and Olga x
Courteous and smiley host, amazing view, awesome big bed, perfect location.  What more could you want?

The location of this stay is perfect! In an area that feels more local than touristy and is away from the density of the city, while also having easy access to the attractions and city. The place itself is perfect for a family or friends, lots of space to move around and good areas to lounge. I recommend this place for any large group!
The flat is really nice and comfortable and perfectly located. Francisco's welcome was great and made us feel at home. His tips and indications were great.
Claudio's place was exactly as described! He was very communicative and helped make the stay very enjoyable. We would definitely recommend!
Great and central place to stay in Porto, elevator in the building and very clean and tidy. Comfortable beds and a nice bathroom. I can definitely recommend this place!
Francisco Conde and the Conde Surf Camp were wonderful! He’s an excellent host and was very helpful!

We really enjoyed this neat and well equipped house. The patio was great to relax after a busy day and we really appreciated the aircon! Very quiet and walking distance from all the places we wanted to go as tourists.

We loved the location of Luis's apartment - close to shopping and restaurants, and feels like a place that locals live instead of the touristy Ribeira. Apartment was exactly as pictured/listed, very clean and comfortable. Bedroom was extremely quiet for an excellent night's sleep (besides a rooster we heard a few times!), and the bed was very comfortable. Excellent automatic window shades in the bedroom keep the morning sun out. He's got a nice balcony unfortunately it was a bit too cold and rainy for us to make use of it, but it would be a lovely place to eat breakfast in nice weather. Luis went above and beyond to provide recommendations about the neighborhood, and answered my questions about buying football tickets. He was always easy to reach. Great host, and great apartment. Recommended!
The location of this place is absolutely amazing! So much better than I had expected. And I expected a lot. The place is super clean and modern, AC worked great, views are spectacular.
Pauli’s place is super clean and spacious. It has a great location, close to everything. Highly recommend!

The apartment is large, comfortable and has a balcony with a really nice view despite the construction just below. It is especially perfectly located, in the middle of Porto. It was perfect to visit the city during the weekend !

Unfortunately, the automatic ventilation which switches on from time to time is a little bit annoying. Besides that it‘s a beautiful and sunny apartment, nicely decorated and well equipped, with lovely details and a nice balcony. Really close to the historical city center.

What a nice place metro is 1 min walking so in 7 min you are downtown Porto . The place is super clean in a neighborhood with plenty of restaurants. Maria answers quickly to your questions. Porto is a marvel .
We were very satisfied. The apartment is within walking distance to everything, restaurants, groceries, coffee shops, shopping, churches. Host was very responsive and friendly.

Our family had a great time staying at Liana's place.   Lovely apartment, very convenient location, an option to park the car nearby, and breakfast at a local market - all this made our trip very special.  Thank you for your hospitality, Liana!
Great appartment, we could stay there every day in our life.  Location is perfect.
This room was very clean and the view was amazing. The staff was very friendly and responded promptly to questions.

As described there are stairs without a lift.  Once you walk up two flight of stairs to the unit once in the unit you need to walk up another set of stairs.   There was a heat wave when we were there and the air conditioners worked great!  So welcoming after long days.   The unit was large an spacious.
Host was very responsive and location was great! Main tourist attractions were walkable distance from the location and area overall felt very safe.
We have a great time. Mateus was very attentive and kind.  appartement as description, good for a few days. Well located.

Maggie is a great Host, very talkative and helpful. The apartment is exactly like in the photos and very well located in the city center. The view from the apartment is beautiful and makes it worth the price. The only issue for us was the hot water that would end very quickly making it impossible for two people to shower one after the other.

Pedro is an awesome, responsible and a very friendly host, who will give you only the best recommendations while visiting Porto. The accommodation is located just near the center. Thus, one can explore Porto very easily from there. Moreover, the accommodation is very authentic creating a unique atmosphere right from the beginning of a trip to Porto.

This is a lovely comfortable apartment. Like most of Porto, an old building outside but refurbished to a lovely modern standard inside including the shared entrance. Great wifi and comfortable bed and great shower. Located in a small alley behind one of the main streets in the Historic area just a short walk from Sao Bento metro from the airport and the great vibe of Ribeira waterfront. The safe and quiet locked alleyway also leads the other way towards the Cathedral so a great location for exploring Porto and still a short walk to go back for a rest! Just make sure you confirm before hand with the hosts where the location of the keybox is as there are 10 of them! Accessed via R. da Ponte Nova next to Starbucks. Happily stay here again.

Ines could not have been more helpful and responded very quickly to all our queries. The flat is very comfortable with amazing views and  lots of space. Two of us stayed and had a double bedroom and bathroom each which was a real treat. It is situated slightly away from the busy tourist spots so lovely to come back to some peace and quiet and a tucked away garden where we could could sit under the orange tree. Everything was clean and air conditioning a real necessity!

yes yes yes. Really good accomodation on a short walking distance from the centre of Porto.  Communication: the hostess was really Swift to reply to all inquiried we had. Ussually within 15 minutes Arrival: we received detailed information how to get in the appartment  Cleaness: Appartment was sanitized and clean upon arrival.  Furthermore, the appartment contains all amineties you need for a short stay.
Kinga and Antonio are super nice, for the house, u will get whatever you want, love this place!

The Apartment was absolutely fantastic! You can walk to the beach in just 10 minutes, and it’s a long way along. Since Uber is so reliable in Portugal, the distance to Porto (which is about 15-20 km away) was no issue. I love to go to the beach in the evenings, so it was the perfect place for me. Catarina was an incredible host. I had an amazing time staying here and I’d love to go back again this summer.
Susana was a fantastic host and we really enjoyed our stay in Porto! The apartment and terrace are done in extremely well and we’d love to be back!
Great place to stay, overlooking the city form you bedroom. Great place, well designed - everything you need for a citytrip

Filipa’s apartment was perfect for our stay in Porto. The view from the balcony was amazing - the best view of the city and the location was perfect for walking, exploring and eating. The apartment was spotlessly clean, the bed was comfortable and the windows filtered out any noise from the river outside. The welcome drink from the bar below the apartment was a lovely touch. We love Porto and will book here again next time we visit.

A perfect stay right in the centre of Porto! Susana's communication was prompt and helpful (incl. detailed instructions for check-in). The apartment is nicely decorated, well maintained and very clean. The high-speed Wi-Fi was ideal for a day of working home office from abroad. The apartment is within walking distance of a lot of sights, restaurants and cafés.(lot of very good options in the street and surrounding streets). We highly recommend this apartment for a lovely stay in Porto!  Thanks, Susana!
We had a great time in Porto. The apartment is great and is located nicely. Marco and his wife are great hosts. We would come back in the future.

This place is amazing! I liked everything and it looks just like in the pictures. There is absolutely everything you can need - washing machine,  hair dryer,  oven, pots...I even can't name everything.   The location is perfect- right in the center of beautiful Porto and near to everything  - shops, food, sightseeing points, the bridge. The apartment is very quiet despite its central location.  The beds were very comfortable and we slept very well! Thank You for the great experience! I recommend this apartment!

The apartment is so lovely, clean, and in a great location for exploring Porto. We did have an issue a few nights into our stay with smoke coming into the apartment, which we think came from a chimney close to the bedroom window. It carried on for a few nights and was very unpleasant. The host said they have never experienced this issue before, so it may have been a one-off, but we checked out early due to the smell and having difficulty sleeping.

Perfect location and the accomodation looks exactly as on the pictures. True is that the bathroom door would deserve to be fixed as it is almost imposible to close it and you can indeed hear the neighbours. Overall this didn' impact my stay and I would stay again at the same place.

What an incredible place! Nice house, nice people, nice dog, nice swimmingpools, nice terraces, nice soccerarea, nice gamingroom, etc etc. We really enjoyed our stay. The surroundings are also very beautiful and Arouca itself is also worth a visit. We recommend this place to everyone!
We had a great stay at Paula & Rafael’s! It was a perfect location, and the place was beautiful.

I recommend these apartments. everything was clean, there was everything you need. We really enjoyed. And the owner is very accommodating and will always answer all questions. Thanks Nuno it was wonderful time.

Luis was an incredible host. He brought Porto to life for us by bringing the history and sites together. His suggestions were helpful and knowledgeable. The apartment was spotless, modern, very comfortable and beautifully decorated. It was also very centrally located so that we could walk almost everywhere.

Exceeded our expectations. We were very warmly and graciously received by Cristina. Both Cristina and Ricardo responded promptly when we had any questions.  The apartment was extremely well furnished . Everything impeccable. Abundant supply of great towels and bed linens. Kitchen was very well stocked. The pictures do not do it justice. Incredible ocean views from every room.  We had a great month and are looking forward to returning

Joanna’s place was amazing! It looked exactly like the pictures! It was very clean and in a perfect location! It was very quiet and comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.  When we needed extra supplies she was very accommodating. We also needed to extend our stay by one day and Joanna made it easy to do this. Tara

The place and how it’s is located is simply wonderful. We had an amazing time enjoying the city and after long walk around the city we had a place to rest and recharge batteries. Highly recommend this place and I am sure me and my family will come back :)

Cristina is an amazing host. We drove up from Faro and she was there within a few minutes of our arrival to let us in. Her apartment was perfect for 5 and the balcony private. Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a relaxing time in Porto!

Pedro is a great host!  The apartment is brand new, lovely and very comfortable.  It is in a perfect location, you can walk to all the sights and also walk a few streets over to be out of the tourist area which is also a very nice experience.  Highly recommended.
This apartment is in a brilliant location with a fantastic view from its garden. We were a family of five who thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Porto. Alexandre was an excellent host.
This is a great place to stay. Comfortable, very clean and in great location. Eduardo was very helpful and accommodating.  We had great time. We would love to visit again. Thank you!

We had a fabulous stay in Carla's apartment. locations was ideal to explore all parts of the city easily by foot. The apartment was spotless and spacious, we couldn't have asked for me. we would highly recommend Carla's apartment for your stay in Porto

Mario was very thorough with his information on how to find and access the apartment. We had everything we needed and more! Very well located and nice surroundings. Apartment is even nicer than pictures and the terrace is amazing! We were 3 couples with 3 children under 2. Very comfortable and spacious. Will definitely return. Highly recommend this place. Thank you Mario!
Great place and location. The adminstrator was very helpful and advised on a lot of things to see and do. Great hospitality- in overall, everything was much mote than we were expecting.

it was such a perfect appartement in porto. superclean, it really smelled quiet fantastic and the furnishing was supercute and comfortable. i've found everything what i needed - even more than that. i felt like a queen : ) mateus was also really nice and friendly. thank you so, so much for this wonderful place!

Great location in Bonfim, close to the Metro and walking distance to many good restaurants and attractions.  The apartment is impeccable—nicely appointed, clean and quiet.  Oh and the balcony was perfectly tranquil. We worked remotely a few hours and internet speed was good.  Highly recommend this place.

this apartment is in a great location, you can walk to everything. There are 2 great cafe's for coffee and delicious pastries right down the street. Daniel the host was always quick to respond to our messages, for example, one of the kitchen chairs was a bit wobbly and within hours we had new chairs. Our Porto experience was fantastic.
Best location with many local food restaurants, cafes. Flat clean, comfortable with big windows and a nice view. I recommend it fully. We will come there back for sure when possible.

I cannot recommend this apartment enough! My partner and I stayed here for 3 nights and it suited us perfectly. The location is superb. The apartment is in walking distance to everything. There are lots of  great brunch places and restaurants within a 5 minute walk of the apartment. Literally everything you’d need/want is so close by. You are also provided with lockers to store your luggage after you check out which was so useful on our final day in Porto. Sousa is a very friendly, responsive and accommodating host. Sousa’s son gave us the warmest welcome on our first day. He provided us with a fantastic manual for navigating the city with all the best food and tourist recommendations. The perfect apartment for your stay in Porto!

We had five amazing days at Paula's place. She was so attentive and although the place is in the mountains and a little difficult to reach (it's worth going anyways), she gave us all the informations that we needed about the zone. Moreover, the place had everything that you need to live and more (toys for kids, books, etc) so it was like being at home. Thanks for everything again.
Locals were great from nearby futbol match, to small and large grocery markets, numerous coffee gathering or grab and go, restaurants either typical foods and courtesy.

Amazing location and steps for the river cruise. Definitely dine at the restaurants next door A Grade (octopus starter, seafood rice, pork cheeks and lime pie) and Taberna dos Mercadores. Washer/dryer was so helpful after being on the road for a few weeks. Highly recc for first timers.

This stay and continuing on is the longest vacation I’ve ever taken completely on my own and in a foreign country. Eduardo and Elizabete were wonderful helping me with some initial things but after that and finding my way I was just giddy with excitement about the walkability from there and the comfortable sleep at night. I’m across the bridge now which has an even more historic feel (and older accommodation) Come visit, stay with EEE(-; you won’t regret it.

This is a great place to explore Porto from a local perspective. It’s located 15 minutes from Balhâo, Rua Santa Catarina and some other downtown attractions. Communication with Constantino was great at all times.

It was the 2nd time we rented from Christina (another apparment) and she was again super friendly and suggested nice places to go. The location is perfect to visit the city and the apartment is spacious. highly recommended!

It's really stylish apartment with a great location in the city center. The apartment has an amazing view. We enjoyed our small vacation there.  The only thing which can bother you that seagulls can be loud at night sometimes :)
It is a wonderful indoor and outdoor space.  Walkable distance to the beach, restaurant and transportation.  I highly recommend it.

Luís’ place was perfect for my time in Porto. It is thoughtfully designed, artful, spotlessly clean, and comfortable. It is located in a cool neighborhood that is accessible to all the sights and points of interest in Porto. I particularly enjoyed the peaceful patio. Luís greeted me warmly at check in and we chatted about Porto and the history of Portugal. Would recommend to anyone!

Beautiful apartment with a great location. The unit is very spacious and nicely decorated. The courtyard garden is a delightful bonus. Alice was incredibly responsive and wonderful to communicate with.  We are so happy we chose this for our Porto stay.

Had a wonderful stay! Carla was incredibly hospitable, and responsive. She provided great recommendations and the apartment itself was very clean and looked like the pictures. Comfy bed with a working kitchen. Wonderful location too, most places we wanted to go to were walking distance. Highly recommend!

I had a wonderful stay! The room was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made me feel very welcome. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Bernardo was very accommodating and the blue and white house was comfortable and clean. We arrived at night and he was there to greet us and show us all of the great places to visit and foods to eat. The beach is a short walk and the outdoor sitting area is sweet. It is located on his grandfather's former olive facility and it was interesting to see the big concrete vats they were stored in and the story of the process.

There was thorough communication prior to my arrival and throughout my stay. Unfortunately wasn't able to meet Tomas until the end of my stay (which I was informed of in advance, but he was easily contactable and quick to respond. The place was immaculate, photos don't do it justice! Very clean and spacious, will definitely recommend!
Place was great and the location was amazing! Catia also provided some wonderful suggestions which made the experience even better!

This place is very neat and has any facility you need! It has nice beds, a very clean kitchen and bathroom (with a nice bathtub/shower and even a very nice TV in the livingroom were you can watch your favorite netflix series or movies. Moreover, the location is very good. It was very close to the MRT and other spots in the city and a Lidl supermarket. It's maybe not 100% soundproof but for us that was not a big deal. We would really recommend the place. Thank you for staying!

Amazing place to stay at in Porto. Very spacious and clean. We were able to walk everywhere from here. Strongly recommend staying here.  I would stay here again. Sweet anime ramen location near by and Starbucks next door.  Maria is very kind and helped us have a very enjoyable stay. Nothing wrong with this spot.

The flat was exactly as expected and the welcome from Catarina was the absolute best. We would recommend this place to anyone coming to Porto!  The terrace was beautiful and the flat was super clean with everything you would need. Catarina was there to greet us and spent time to go through the best attractions and restaurants in the area, even helping to book a table at a great restaurant on our first night since we were a big group.
The apartment is spacious and spotlessly clean, it's in a quiet street but close to restaurants, shops and sights. And Pedro is an excellent host.

Very nice place to stay in Porto. Hugo was waiting for us in the studio and gave use some tips to do in Porto. As we were only staying for a few days we could not try them all ;-) Very well equipped room and really great bed. If we ever come back to Porto it will be in toc toc studio.
We had a great time in this apartment! Great location in central Porto, spacious, very clean... we could not ask for me! Thank you!
prompt response for anything, full of good tips for restaurants and visits, very kind and helpful, even though we didn't need any support since everything was perfect.

This is a beautiful flat, 3 very nice bedrooms, 2 beautiful and very modern bathrooms, a very stylish sitting room / dining-room / kitchen area. All the kitchen utensils we could need were all provided. The flat is opposite a shopping centre which has a good supermarket and is also near bus stops and a metro stop. The flat is also very close to Rua De Santa Caterina  which is full of shops and restaurants. Thank you Telmo, my family and I had a fantastic Christmas Break.
The place is outstanding. We will definitely be recommending it to friends and family. 5 star hospitality. P.S. they have a pinball machine, how cool is that!
We had a beautiful experience in Abel's home. I would highly reccomend this place. Position was perfect for moving around the city, a little bit noisy in the night because of the nightlife.
Nice stay and responsive host! Just keep in mind it is right by a road so can be a tad noisy :)
Olga's place is really beautiful and in very good location!!! Along with her husband they are amazing hosts and have been very helpful. I would definitely recommended this place!!
Great location. Clean, everything you need to have s great holiday in Porto. David was very helpful with maps, restaurant and things to see.  Worth a stay.

We thought the apartment was really lovely. Really spacious, amazing ceiling, beautiful windows throughout and a great garden with the bonus of the huge variety of craft beer on sale! So enjoyed our stay in Porto!

We loved staying at Eugenia and Luis' place apartment. They are well located and walking distance from all the historical sites and amazing restaurants. Our vacation timing was a little off as it rained the first two days of our three days stay but we were lucky to have been at this apartment and, despite the rain, left very satisfied with Porto.

Our hosts were very kind and communicative. Check in is very easy. The terrace was beautiful, lovely to enjoy in the morning and sunset. The location is great. We walked out the door and could explore the city easily! Great place to stay!

This is a fantastic place that deserves all the positive reviews. It is comfortable and relatively spacious in the cramped inner city, and its location is hard to beat. You have convenient stairway access down winding roads to the Ribeira area and are otherwise right next to the Clerigos tower adjacent to nightlife, shopping, etc. Check-in was convenient and communication was excellent. Really an amazing way for us to start our trip!

Great experience. Strongly recommend.  The place was super clean. Very conveniently located walking distance from tourist sites. 2 min from metro station. Plenty of parking around. Check-in/out was seamless. A+
really beautiful apartment. I enjoyed staying there and it is very comfortable. Only thing would be to include an iron!
It’s a great space with beautiful views in every direction. The space is comfortable and clean and the windows keep out the street sounds. We’d definitely stay again given its perfect location!

Clean, tidy and in a very quiet location. Our hosts could not have been more helpful, and were always available when we needed them. I would consider using them again, and would recommend the property as a good choice if you stay in the north of Portugal. We felt at home. Thank you so much Ana and Luis, we had a great time.

The Airbnb was perfect for our stay in Porto and we enjoyed staying there. It was clean and very well furnished. The apartment is located in the center of Porto (therefore it was a little bit noisy) and you can reach basically everything within walking distance. Supermarkets, bars, cafés and restaurants are  also nearby the accommodation. Carla welcomed us warmly and the communication with her was excellent. We can recommend this Airbnb and would always come back. Thank you very much for letting us stay at your apartment!

This was a fantastic airbnb that looked just like the photos and matched the description. It felt like home and was very spacious. The location was perfect too! The host, Pedro, was very friendly, helpful and easy/quick to communicate with. He kept our luggage secure before the check in time and brought it all up for us! He even welcomed us with two bottles of wine and gave us a list of recommendations for food, bars and sights.  Obrigado Pedro. We had the best time and can’t wait to come back!

Great apartment for 6 colleague who where in Porto for a conference. We each had our own room with bathroom and a lot of space. We liked our neighbourhood which was residential but had a few great bars and a supermarket within walking distance. Communication was quick and easy. We would definitely recommend!

Miguel’s place was simply amazing. Check-in was very convenient and the metro was just a 2 min walk from the apartment. The view from the living room window was spectacular. He had the basic amenities and his apartment felt homely and peaceful. What I really loved is that he was always quick with his responses with whatever questions we had. Would definitely recommend Miguel’s place. Thank you for a wonderful stay.

The apartment was perfect for a large group. The location is a quick uber to almost anywhere in Porto. We didn't spend much time in the apartment or the area but that apartment fulfilled all of our needs.
This apartment was just WOW!! Exactly as seen on pictures and very very close to everything you can think of. We were truly happy with our stay!

We loved our stay! The location cannot be beat - close to all the action and the Balhao Market and the rooftop balcony view was insanely beautiful. We really enjoyed having our breakfasts out there. There was AC which was great too. Recommend for an affordable stay in the heart of Porto!
The place is like a five star hotel in the middle of all actions. 100% would come back again.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The appartment was very clean when we arrived and complete with all items (towels, kitchen utensiles, etc.). The apperment is rather big, and we loved the terrace with a view of the city and the river. It was very quiet during our stay. The road to get there is quite steep, so be mindful if you have mobility issues. Overall, we highly recommend it.

Booked this property after I had had a nightmare at a nearby hotel. For a similar price to what I paid for the hotel, this accomodation was lightyears ahead in terms of quality, space, amenities, cleanliness, and finish. The property is central, bright, relatively quiet, and is a great space for solo travellers or couples. Cannot recommend this property enough for those thinking of travelling to Porto.

Myself and 2 friends stayed in the apartment for 2 days and it was perfect! On the top floor of the building so nice and quiet but still walkable to all the amenities of Porto.  Manuel was very helpful, allowing us to check in early and gave us full instructions on the place and Porto. He even arranged a taxi for us back to the airport. The apartment was very clean and airy, air con worked very well and the beds were very comfy. The kitchen and bathroom were very clean and had everything we needed for our stay. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Porto!

It is a great place to stay in Porto. Very convenient self check in was very important for us, as we came late at night. Thanks Miguel for the tip for the cheap parking!!! The apartment was very clean and we loved the stylish details, the bicycle at the wall, different pictures and stone walls give a special touch and made our stay very cosy and unforgettable.
Douro Garden was a great house in a good location next to a tram. Communication with the host was smooth and they were flexible throughout the stay. Highly recommend the place for a trip to Porto.

very nice apartment on 2 floors and very clean. friendly &  easy checkin. Checkout was flexible. Taxi was organised from and to airport (on our request). Perfect organised. Always quick answers and good recommendations! Perfect for 4 people. View to the DOURO. Everything was in walking distance. Apartment is on top floor -> no elevator! But no problem for us:-) the only thing we missed : towels in the kitchen. But it was ok. Dishwasher is there.

After making ourselves comfortable we got a call from joão that we are in the wrong appartement and that we have to move to another appartement at a different floor. We were not very amused since we all were supertired and the new app didn't have a balcony like it was said in the description. Besides that everything was really great. It was very clean and very well equipped (everything's there for cooking) the location can't be better and the host is supernice and provided us with helpful information. All in all a definite recommendation!

Sofia's place was so well decorated and had everything you need for one or two people! It was amazingly located and within walking distance to the main Porto train station, shops, and restaurants! 10/10 would recommend for anyone visiting Porto!

I felt like I was in the middle of the action, yet the neigborhood itself was so peaceful! I could get to anywhere in the Ribeira area within a 10 minute walk, and just a bit more to go downtown and to Bolhão. The accommodations were as advertised, super clean and tidy. Would recommend!

The location of the flat is great. Within a couple if minutes you are in the city centre. The communication with the owner was also very good. It was great that we could drop off our luggage on arrival earlier. Everything was really, really nice.

This was one of the best Airbnb that we have had the opportunity to stay. The apartment was immaculate, centrally located, quiet, and beautifully decorated and maintained. The apartment has such an attention to detail for travelers. The laundry facilities, extra converters, local recommendations, ac in bedrooms etc.  Do not hesitate to book this apartment, and to top it off Nuno is fabulous host. We would definitely return.
Sofia’s apartment is the perfect spot! Great location, comfortable and very quiet! Sophia thought of every detail. We loved our stay and will definitely return!
Apartment was very well located and check in was very easy. There are bit squeeky floors but thats to be expected from old buildings. Overall good stay.

Strong recomendation! Célia is very pleasent person. She helped me with everything. Good clean comfortable place to stay near airport. Delicious bajery is nearby. Colled Confeitaria São Marcos, Rua Guardeiras 313, Maia
Apartment was small but so cozy! Just a short walk from a lot of the city’s main attractions including the Luís I bridge.
Great place to stay. Large airy rooms  and a variety of private and shared outdoor spaces. The views from the top are magnificent. Alaina and Jimmy are fantastic hosts

Lovely, clean and modern home with great water views. The location is great, with a short walk to the busy part of town but is also quiet where it is located. Lisa was a communicative hosts and provided many great recommendations too!
fantastic location, nice large apartment and easy to find. would stay here again and recommend to anyone travelling to Porto

Luís was an incredibly welcoming host - so friendly and provided many great recommendations. His place was spotless and clean. We'll decorated and beautiful. it was about a 10 minute walk to the historic center.

We had a great stay at this wonderful penthouse in Porto. Nuno and Anita were great hosts, always there when needed but also respecting privacy big time. The weather was quite rainy during our stay, but this apartment made it quite comfortable to stay in and spread over the two floors... the terrace is great when its sunny. Recommended!

Beyond all important informations about the apartment Ritsuko shares to us with clarity, she allows us to bring the check-in earlier in the afternoon (2pm instead of 4pm), taking into account our situation with reactivity, flexibility and kindness.

Alvaro’s place is a really charming mid-size summer house/apartment. Perfect for the family trip. All things are well-equipped and maintained. You can view Douro river right from the living room, felt very relaxing! Most importantly, Alvaro is a super host and was extremely helpful while we stayed. We really appreciate his hospitality and great tips! Highly recommended!

An absolute stand out.  Teresa was a phenomenal host - from helping us easily locate her space to local recommendations to the delightful surprise of a cake and a cheeseboard upon our arrival.  (The latter of which especially thrilled our daughters!). The unit itself is well appointed and comfortable. You can tell Teresa considers all of her guests needs.  The beds were cozy and the showers great too. This was our first time in Porto and could not have been happier with our stay. If you happen to stumble upon this Airbnb - don’t hesitate to book it!  We certainly will on our next trip to Porto. ❤️

Great flat, just right for the four of us. Location is great, the flat very clean, just the right size, nothing too much or too little. Teodoro was a great host and we recommend staying with him. Private Parking Thanks Teodoro Sónia
Such a nice stay, they were super helpful and welcoming and the apartment is in such a good area. Would Definetly stay again :)

We had fantastic stay at Mouziho 134, the apartment is spacious and comfortable for 6 people, the location is very central, the view is great. It's in an old building tastefully restored with all the modern comfort and it is spotless clean when we checked in. I had the pleasure to meet Eugenia, she's professional, friendly and very helpful, gave us lots tips about the area. On the whole this is perfect stay and I highly recommend Mouzinho 134!

We had a great time in Porto. The apartment was exactly like in the photos, everything was neat and tidy. Situated within a walking distance to the centre and the metro station, the apartment felt close to everything while beating peaceful and quiet at the same time. The hosts are very friendly and always reply to questions in a timely manner. We would definitely choose to stay again at one of their properties in the future.
Great central location and nice private apartment. Very clean! Marco and Carla were very helpful. Highly recommend!
This place is great. It's roomy and nicely decorated. The neighborhood is very hip and has an abundance of nice bars and restaurants. Marco and his wife Carla were very accommodating.
Lovely apartment in the middle of everything! We loved the location and the apartment had everything we needed. The shower was large and had great water pressure. Great experience!
The place was great! It has a really nice sunny terrace. All communication with the host was great!
We enjoyed our stay at Marco’s place. It was very central and made getting places very easy.

Susanna was a great host for our two nights in Porto. The apartment is lovely. It had all the kitchen supplies we needed for coffee and breakfast in the morning. We especially appreciated the blackout curtains, which helped our jet lag immensely. The location was perfect, close to restaurants, city center, and the river. Highly recommended, would stay again!!
Pedro was an amazing host, amongst the top hosts I've ever stayed with. His apartment is so beautiful and centrally located. We loved the amount of space spread out across two floors too!

Susana and Pedro were very accurate and well organized hosts. Through their clean and very well-located property, we had an amazing experience and were able to thoroughly enjoy Porto. Highly recommend!

Ruan was a fantastic host with an amazing space. His place was very clean and stocked with everything that we needed (sheets, towels, toilet paper, etc). The place itself was beautiful and right in the middle of the city where everything is within walkable distance. Ruan was great with communication and was very nice and thorough when introducing us to the apartment. Would recommend to everyone!
Lovely and relaxing spot.  Bartolo is a great host, his house is lovely.  Spacious rooms, well decorated, everything matches the description.  Nice spot to unwind.
Amazing stay in Porto! The space and terrace were excellent, lovely host and welcome. Clean, spacious and nice location. Thank You so much! 5 stars from Estonian girls :)

Spotlessly clean modern studio very close to everything in central Porto. Not much floor space tbh. It's pretty compact. Perfect for just a few nights stay. Great bathroom & shower and comfy bed. We enjoyed our stay

The apartment was great for one for a few days, it’s as described. It’s in a quiet area, but the walls are quite thin so you can hear people in the other apartments. Luckily my neighbours were not too loud. Francisco was helpful and prompt with messages.

A tastefully furnished, Immaculately clean and quiet apartment in a great location to walk around Porto.  Joao and Andriea were great hosts - excellent communicators, helpful recommendations and maps, lovely welcome gifts of fruit, port and wine ; very responsive to our requests - all in all, an ideal place to stay in Porto; highly recommended!!
great place to stay. well located in downtown. very clean, spacious. great responsive hosts. would recommend others to stay. Will stay here next time we are in porto

The check-in and checkout were very easy! The space is super clean and feels like a hotel. We also enjoyed the lockers at the entrance of the building to store our luggages until our flight in the evening.  We just think that it would need a little bit more kitchen equipment if travelers want to cook (cooking pot, cutting board, drying rack, kitchen cloth).

Another stay, another great experience! I love Porto, I love Je T´Aime and I love this sweet guest house. The location is perfect, the hosts are even better and it's all I could wish for! My stays with you keep surprising me and the people I travel with are also very surprised and satisfied. Big thank you to your team to make me feel at home. Obrigado!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the apartment. It was clean, spacious and right around the corner from the beach. The bed was comfortable and the apartment had all the amenties you could think of. A slightly more comforrable couch is the only thing i would suggest, but this is being picky. The host was always responsibe and very helpful. Would love to come back!

A lovely converted distillery, with a good description. Very clean and check in was easy. Only downside is there is little in the way of amenity / attraction nearby and be prepared to walk. That said the walk to the main attractions (45 mins) is along the river and well laid out and easy. The view of the river from the apartment is superb. I would definitely recommend this apartment
The apartment has a great location but it is very limited with amenities. The apartment can be very noisy at night.

This stylish apartment is really central but quiet, and it is very clean. Heating is not part of the price but João offered heating for extra cost which was necessary in January and kept the apartment nice and warm. João made sure everything was okay throughout our stay. I would come back again if I come back to Porto! Thank you João :)

Beautiful home, welcoming hosts, location great. Perfect for our family of four. The upstairs bedroom is lovely, but I would say not suitable for very young children or anyone not happy with steep spiral stairs. We loved it though!

**Fantastic Stay!**   I had a wonderful stay at DA’HOME Premium! The home was clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything I needed, and the location was perfect. I’d definitely stay here again—highly recommend!

Carla is very nice and she helped us we everything that we needed to know about the city. The place is lovely even if it's quite dark as there is only one window. The apartment is very close to the center and you can do a lot of things just by walking. I recomend it!
Worth the price paid for. Very friendly host. Well located, you can explore the city by walk everything is close to the apartment.
