Sofia and Fatima’s Airbnb is beautiful and in the perfect location. The pedestrian street it’s on is lively and full of great cafes and shops, but does not interfere with a great night’s sleep. We loved the overlooking balcony and the thoughtful decor. Hosts responded very quickly and made us feel welcome. Would absolutely stay here again!
Great location, good value. We didn’t use the kitchen. Bed linens were nice and I loved the shower. Space is a little bit tight for 3 people.

Excellence at the turn of the key!  Quiet, clean, large space, easy to walk to town/downtown areas, near train station, high ceilings, breathtaking views, hot water works perfectly, great water pressure, felt like home, modern, perfect in everyday, look no further!

I stayed at the Airbnb with my little brother, we had a great time. Suzana was super welcoming, she was present all the time and you could always ask for anything. Bernardo took us to his surf school. They offer a lift to the airport which is super helpful.  The place is very close to the beautiful beach (watch the sunset!). We loved that we were nearly alone at the beach, it’s never crowded. The house has everything you need and the supermarket is close by.  It takes awhile to get to Porto by bus but by car it’s super fast.  We met lovely people and became friends with Suzana, Bernardo and also the other guests.  Would definitely come back and highly recommend the place espacially if yo want to surf and have a relaxed time! Thank you for everything, Suzana!
Lovely Airbnb, close to the main shopping area and restaurants. Apartment was clean, comfortable and a great choice. Highly recommend the combi coffee roasters for breakfast.

The apartment was perfect for staying in Porto few days. The location is the best to explore the city. Communication with the host was perfect and Paulo provided us all information to have the best experience in Porto. The room had anything necessary for a comfortable stay.
Great location on a quiet street, perfect place to stay in Porto with everything you need. Checkin and out was also super easy.

This Airbnb is ideally located near Sao Bento station, and a quick 10-15 minute walk from top locations like Clerigos Tower, Porto Cathedral, Livraria Lello, etc. It's also a quick 5-minute walk from a Minipreco where you can stock up on breakfast and snack items. The home itself is spacious, bright, and comfortable--with all the amenities you need. Most importantly, it has a dishwasher and clothes rack to do that load of dirty laundry you've been carrying around (!), and a sweet, cozy patio to enjoy the sunny outdoors. The only negative (as mentioned by others) is the relentless trampling and thudding from the upstairs unit. The insulation is so poor that you can hear every thud and creak, and if you have active neighbors, unfortunately the noise can be very disruptive.

We really enjoyed our stay at Luis's place. We arrived later than expected, and Luis was completely accommodating. He greeted us when we arrived in town and provided us with all the info we needed on the apartment, as well as a ton of recommendations on things to do in Porto. The apartment was clean, stylish and well-situated - a short walk both to the beautiful Jardins do Palácio de Cristal and to the city centre. The backyard terrace was particularly lovely - especially for bird watching! We would most certainly recommend Luis's place to anyone visiting Porto (especially if it's your first time in the city!)

We really appreciate the warm welcome and suggestions of visit when We arrived. The appartment is very well situated in a quiet and nice street. Many restaurants around!  The decoration is exactly as the photo descriptions and We enjoy the terrace. The appartment is also very well equiped. We will recommand this address for sure !

Maria is a fantastic host ! Super communicative and very flexible.  Great location so close to everything yet not on a busy street.  We loved it. Would definitely stay again and will recommend for sure
Great spot. V close to viewing spot for sunsets. All the sights were within walking distance. Set us up for a fantastic trip.
As described, maybe a bit on the pricier side for what it is but close to the beach and nice bars and restaurants nearby. The host was friendly and helpful. Free parking right outside the Airbnb.

A fantastic apartment in terms of comfort & location (less than 1 min from nearest metro station).  The apartment was as described and had everything we needed for our stay. Pedro was friendly, gave clear instructions for check in /out and responded promptly to all messages. Would highly recommend.
Lovely apartment in a very good location. It has a very nice classic look for whoever wants to see a bit of how old buildings in Porto looked like.

Great space and very well located. It's a short trip from the main spots in Porto, and you can either walk, take the subway or an Uber (super cheap). The space itself is very stylish and cozy, with self check-in available and some thoughtful touches as well such as cheese and a homemade cake :) I definitely recommend this space to whoever wants to visit Porto, specially solo or couple travellers.

Amazing apartment in the best location ever! In the Ribeira, but not in the noise. The apartment has 2 bedrooms, big dining room and kitchen. Well equipped. Cristina and Carlos were sooooo kind with us! 100% recommended!!

We had a very nice stay at this Apartment. The site of the Apartment is exellent. It´s placed in the City Center near to Restaurants and bars. The apartment is equiped with everything you need for a City trip and is very beautiful and clean. The host who welcomed us gave us good tips and informations about Porto. All in all a very good stay at a beautiful City.

We had a great stay in Bernardo's apartment!! It is located just a few steps away from the wonderful beach, really comfortable and nicely furnished and clean. Last but not least there is Bernardo's mum, who made our trip to Porto an unforgettable journey. She cared for us all the time - thank you again!! We love you - see you soon! :)

Had a good stay, nicely located apartment in Porto Old Town near river Douro. Aptmt was clean and cosy. Check-in flexible and very easy, no problems at all. Wifi could be faster. Would come here again.

We had a really great stay. Hosts were very welcoming and provided really good restaurant and entertainment options in the city. The location is amazing and close to everything. The decorations and furnishing of the apartment is top notch. The building smells amazing throughout. Bathrooms and kitchen area are all newly renovated.  We will definitely book again when visiting Porto and would recommend these apartments highly.  Thank you for your hospitality.  Regards,  Alex
Super beautiful Airbnb, loved the character and the check in was easy and the place was spotless. She leaves plenty of recommendations and I would 100% stay here again.
Pedro communicated with us explaining the locality.  The flat was fabulous and very modern. It added to our great stay in Pontevedra.
Very nice and cosy appartment. It is perfect for a short stay!  The apartment is not far from the center and is easy to reach from the airport. We really enjoyed Porto and the apartment!
The location was excellent and it was easy to walk to most of the major attractions of the city.  There were many nearby bars and restaurants.  The apartment is stylish and well equipped.
Great location and close to everything. Shower was broken, but a part from that we enjoyed our stay and would return.

Filipe’s place was amazing! It was very modern with a great view of the city. Everything you would need was included and he was very responsive. Would highly recommend him and this place for anyone looking to experience Porto!
The apartment is in a great location. There is so much to see and do around the property. Easy check in and check out.
Diogo is a perfect host, responsive and popped by to give us area recommendations which were really good.  The house is spacious and quirky and a good base close to the centre of Porto
We had a short stay, but was a great place in a super convenient location. Given the prime location, there is a bit of noise outside, but that’s to be expected.

We had a great time in Porto and Pedro's place was perfect for us. It was centric and clean, and Pedro is a great host, always responsive and flexible with the check-in time. I recommend Pedro's place to those looking to explore Porto and its surroundings.

We were two families with kids. We loved the apartment, it was walkable to almost all the attractions. She gave us a really check in and was very sweet to us. Everything went well. Bathrooms were clean, we used the laundry as well. Overall great experience.

Ahh, we spent a wonderful time in Porto! Great localization for discovering the secrets of the city! Andre and his brother Patricio are both truly kind and helping people. The apartment is unusual! Highly recommended, thanks guys!

This is a really great place to stay in Porto! In the Center of everything! So many bars, restaurants and shopping close by.  The place was very modern and the beds and pillows were comfortable.  You can hear a lot of street noise in the bedrooms so would recommend ear plugs if you are a light sleeper.

The location is perfect - couldn't ask for better!! The apartment was  extremely clean with all possible facilities. Caroline was a thoughtful and very communicative host, making sure we had a perfect check in and check out. Everything you'd like to see in Porto is less than a ten minute walk away. Every aspect was better than imagined, honestly. Absolutely no room for improvement - look no further you won't regret your stay in this home within a world unesco site - ribiera!
Wonderful stay in a bright sparkling clean apartment. Location great ( steps from metro, 15 min walk to the old city) . We enjoyed very much !

We had a very nice time in Porto thanks to Pedro and his apartment! It's very spacious and clean. There was a lot of different kitchen equipment available. The place looks exactly like the pictures. The apartment is very close to the city center. When meeting Pedro, he gave us a little sightseeiing and gave us helpfull information about the neighbourhood, tourist attractions and restaurants. The communication with Pedro went really well!

My stay at Priscilla's place was a real success. The price-quality ratio is excellent for Porto. The apartment is well located near the train/metro and the city center, yet peacefully apart. The neighborhood felt cozy.  The room was comfortable, with a big bed, quality sheets, four pillows (!), and a good cabinet. It's worth noting the city noise, the cars you can hear. If you're very sensitive, earplugs might be a good idea. I myself loved the bed and slept very well, except one night some neighbor woke me up with his voice for a moment. Portugal is just in general more noisy than my country.  The kitchen is well-equipped, and the bathroom is spacious and clean.  I also enjoyed meaningful conversations with other guests. I’d happily stay here again the next time I come to Porto.

Lovely, cosey little studio/flat near Trinidad. Really good location! Comfy bed and stay.  Great little cafe on the corner of the street. Nice and quiet! Had a lovey week in this flat and would love to visit again!
Super cute, great street with a lot of character but just enough off the main tourist area. Hugo was super responsive and helpful.

That’s a lovely apartment, beware that it looks a bit bigger and more impressive on photos though! The shower is quite old and the entry to bedrooms is from the living room - so not ideal if you travel with kids. The kitchen is well equipped. The location is ideal. I think this apartment is perfect for a group of friends or a couple but would not recommend to a family with young children.

Maria is an amazing host. Everything is clean, well prepared and she gave us a lot of information regarding Porto City. Honestly the best Airbnb which I stayed so far. Highly recommend it. Muito obrigado Maria!
Great apartment with an even better location. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to explore Gaia and Porto.

Susana was a wonderful host.  She was always quick to respond to any questions I had and offered lots of helpful information to help us navigate Porto.  Her place was spotless and thoroughly outfitted and beautifully designed.  There were plenty of coffee bars and good restaurants within a five minute walk of the apartment.  The apartment had a deck to relax on and a washing machine--both wonderful treats for weary travelers.  We would happily stay with Susana again!  And Porto, for those who have yet to visit, is a charming city.  You can't help but fall in love with it.

Sónia is such a wonderful host. She is extremely kind and helpful, really unique! You feel so welcome.  The house is very spacious, beautifully decorated and perfectly clean. All amenities you need. Walking distance to the old city and highlights.  There is a lovely garden with swimming pool. Great to relax and with kids. Also baby cot and high chair available. Definitely recommended!
The apartment was very comfortable and in a great location.  Fernando very kindly gave us lots of local information which was really helpful. We enjoyed our stay very much.
This is the perfect spot for an amazing view and also walkable to all great places in Porto. The apartment is cozy, and well equipped. The view is amazing. I recommend this stay.

This apartment had the most beautiful view anytime of day. We enjoyed having both the old town and the river view. Everything inside the apartment felt new. Bruno was so easy to reach and very accommodating. He sent a great list of restaurants and left us a bottle of wine, which we enjoyed with amazing views on the balcony. Don't hesitate to book this great spot.

A super apartment well located for the metro and the Port where we spent a lot of time.  Paula & Rafael kept us well informed throughout the trip. Will definitely be back. Top Top apartment and location.
Such a beautiful place to stay in Porto! Waking up to a stunning view of the river was amazing. The hosts were helpful and the location was great. Absolutely recommend!!
Miguel's place is very clean and stylish. Although we can only take a hot bath for every 1 hour, it is not a problem for me and my friends. Miguel is a helpful host and I recommend this place.
THE VIEW IS UNREAL. You look at the photos and think okay this will be nice but once you are there it is absolutely STUNNING. The street is also beautiful. I couldn't recommend enough.
Great, modern apartment less than 30 min to the old town by foot. Comfortable also for 3 people.
Perfect place to stay, we highly recommend. A lot of place to spend time together. Adriana was very helpful :)  The only thing is a nervous neighbor but it’s enough to don’t care about her :)

Sofia is a great host, very kind person, communicates perfectly. The appartment is in the middle of the downtown but not noisy. Perfect for 2 people, clean, tidy with a comfortable bed. Highly recommended.

Pedro met us at the apartment and gave us a walk through. He also took the time to answer our questions and gave us recommendations for good places to eat. The apartment is updated, clean and spacious. The balcony is a perfect place to enjoy some wine at night.  Great location. Lots to do within walking distance.
Great stay! Room and bathroom were very clean. The bed and pillows were very comfortable as well. Subway located 3 min walk from the apartment. Would stay here again!

We had an amazing stay at Inês' place! Inês was incredibly welcoming and made us feel at home in her beautiful flat. She provided lots of suggestions of excellent restaurants around the area, as well as places to see. The flat is very well located, with lots of nice restaurants and bars very close by; it is also just a few minutes walk away from a supermarket and Metro station. The flat was very comfortable, bright, clean and decorated with beautiful paintings by Inês' father.  It was easy for us to walk around the city, yet the street was quiet and safe. We had everything we needed and would definitely stay here again when we are back in Porto. Thank you so much for hosting us Inês!

Beautiful apartment and very accommodating host! Views are fantastic, location is ideal and peaceful.. Catarina was as helpful as can be! We were very grateful to have stayed over in Espinho :) Would highly recommend!
Super easy communication, very well located (15 min walk from the centre and around the corner from the main bus station) and a very comfortable room! We really enjoyed our stay here :)
A spotless, spacious apartment in the heart of old Porto.  I would definitely stay here again.

Maria is a very nice and friendly host. Though we only stayed one night, arrived late and left quite early in the morning - everything was perfect: the bed is quite comfy, the whole flat is clean & cozy!

Very convenient location for all there is to see in Porto. Diana and colleague were prompt in responding to our questions and helpful in getting us situated. Clean, airy apartment. Just right for 2 people.

A beautiful, well equipped apartment with a view at a great location. The apartment was well prepared and very clean. Communication with Lisa was easy and Tiago gave us a very warm welcome even though we arrived only around midnight. We had a great time at the location and will certainly return!

We really enjoyed our stay at Cláudio’s apartment - it is comfortable, spacious and very classy - and hosted by very helpful and responsive hosts! We had been looking at staying in Porto for a couple of days but are so pleased we stayed by the beach instead. The apartment is a lovely calm haven - walking distance to wonderful beaches with some great local restaurants. We day tripped into Porto via Uber to explore, but we’re so happy to get away from the busy summer crowds at the end of the day  and get back to beautiful sunsets over the Atlantic.  Travelling with our teenagers, we were delighted to have three bedrooms all with en-suites and comfortable, large living areas to relax after exploring the sites/beaches/nature reserve and marina. Thank you so much Cláudio - we’d love to stay again next time we’re in Porto!
Amazing place, great location, super clean and Mariana alway answered quick. I would recommend without a doubt !

Hospitality gets a new definition with Pedro. The house was very clean and detail-oriented, we didn't miss anything. It can be quite cool in November if you are not familiar with traditional old houses, but there are enough cozy warm blankets. Thank you, Pedro!

Very stylish and cosy appartment, great location and very friendly and punctual host. I loved every detail, shampoo bottles, design and small complements with cookies and coffee. Definitely recommend!

We had an excellent stay at this Airbnb, the room is very tidy and well-equipped, and  the whole Airbnb has a high standard and a tasteful interior. The hosts were very friendly and flexible concerning check-out time. The location of the Airbnb is well-connected with public transport and you’ll find typical Portuguese bakery and pastry shops nearby.

Mold smell!! It’s extremely pungent in the hallway but less bad in the property itself, but you can definitely still smell it in the walls.  That being said, we really enjoyed staying here. The apartment is GORGEOUS and has every amenity you would want. The hosts were very kind and responsive as well, the location is great.

Wonderful accomodation with very welcoming hosts. My Rooms was exactly like in the pictures and there were water and some little Snacks provided. It's also very near to the next Metro Station, so all in all it was just perfect, I would also recommend it for solo travelers :)

Pedro and his mother were one of the best hosts I’ve ever had, I felt very welcomed. The place is great, it’s close to one of the greatest bars areas but it’s location prevents noise to come in. I stayed for two months and would stay again if available.

We stayed at the airbnb of Ac in Porto and it was great! Pretty appartement with an amazing view, easily accesible and definitly worth the price. Ac responded quickly with clear and good instructions and responded very fast when you asked questions! Great host :)

Bruno’s place had even better views than the pictures! The host was very responsive in communication throughout our entire stay. They left a sweet welcome gift when we arrived and we felt very comfortable!
We had a great stay in Ana‘s & Joao‘s flat. The flat is very clean and has very central location where you can easily walk to all the main sights in Porto. Thank you very much, Ana & Joao!

Perfect spot for exploring Porto! Comfortable beds. We had trouble figuring out how the washing machine worked….instructions would have helped. The apartment is nicely decorated! The four of us had a great stay!!!
Good place to stay, close to bus and Metro routes. Very comfy bed. Enjoyable stay.

Very central and easy walks to old tram line and old town.   Several good resturants close by and Xau Laura was exceptional.    Hosts were very friendly and made helpful recommendations.    Very tasteful modern apartment that’s very well located.    Pool was small and often busy but clean and so nice after a day walking.     Wi-Fi was good after 1st day (had a fault).  …     Finding it was easy but wasn’t sure which door plus keypad  number didn’t. Work a couple of times.   All very minor and family quick to respond

perfect location. easy access to everything. a little noisy in ront bedrooms overnight but it is not an apartment problem this is screaming people in the middle of  night.we were confused how to use cooktop.
Everything was great! Henrique was always available to answer questions, and the place was clean and spacious.
Lovely apartment and well equipped.  The bedrooms were spacious and bright. Good location for transport and shops. We really enjoyed our stay! Thank you Claudia and Pedro.
Great host, great place, great stay, but what is beautiful ends soon.  I recommend this place in every respect - location, hospitality and of course the PEDRO host (he will always help and advise)
A very comfortable flat in the center of porto. The hosts are very friendly and always helped with great tips. High recommendation.
Thank you very much Teresa for a great stay. Teresa is a very responsive host and provide clear guidance and suggestions of great local places!! Thank you again!
Uncomplicated Check in and room like on the photos. Smelled weird sometimes but all in all good
We really loved our stay in this house! The location is perfect, as well as the view. You have a lot of privacy and the staff is really nice. Would definetely recommend!!!

The apartment was very centrally located and just about everything you could possibly want to do is within a 15-20 minute walk at the furthest. Many great sites, restaurants and shopping areas within a few blocks of the apartment. The host is very kind and provided many good recommendations!

Mariza was a very friendly and accommodating host, all of the communication and the check-in was swift and professional. Although the immediate surroundings (the busy street next to the apartment) aren't that interesting, you could easily walk to the relevant areas downtown. The aparment was nice, functional and very tidy, all in all a good place from which to explore Porto!
Very nice, spacious apartment with a lovely terrace. It has a good location with lots of nice restaurants nearby. The host was very welcoming and helpful. We would definitely go there again!

Absolutely one of the best Air BnB’s I’ve rented. Ricardo was a super responsive host.  He met us at check-in, provided recommendations for the area and was very responsive. The apartment was clean, central to all the major sites AND on a very quiet street.

Looking at the photo of the room with its balcony views of the River Douro, we were expecting a lot. And the thing is, it lived up to all our expectations, and then some! The view is every bit as good as the photo implies, and what you don't see until you walk onto the balcony is all the bustling life below and the incredible view of Eiffel's beautiful bridge. We fell in love with Porto, and when we come back, this will be the first place we choose. Thanks so much to Filipa and Moses

This super cute apartment is located steps outside of the Sao Bento train/metro station. Very lovely neighborhood with many choices for dining and entertainment. Marta was so helpful, she even made us reservations at one of her favorite restaurants. We had an amazing stay! Highly recommend!

Pedro and Joanna are amazing hosts. They’re attentive, responsive and you can see them working to keep the building clean. The apartment was clean, prepared for all the guests with towels and beds ready, and they even set a few coffee capsules and teas for when you wake up. Lovely stay, 100% would come back if I visit Porto again.

This was the perfect stay near the airport. There was a lot of private space to relax after our long flight.  Every request was responded to immediately. We loved it so much we have rebooked for our August trip back to Porto.
We had a great stay at BMyGuest’s place. They keep the apartment super clean and neat. If I come to Porto next time, then this will be my first choice.

Lovely new hotel, really attentive hosting- great breakfast! Fun design and architecture. Late at night the neighbourhood can feel a little unsafe if you're a woman alone, but I don't think there's any real risk- I was fine.
Fantastic stay - central location, gorgeous flats and great hosts! Patricia was extremely helpful in showing me where to go in Porto. Would recommend 100%!

What an amazing place right on the Douro River. A nice walk to the Luis I bridge with it’s restaurants and things to do.  Loved that it had a garage where we could safely park our rental car.  The hosts are super responsive and we felt right at home.
Wonderful stay! The apartment was beautiful and Irene was a great host.  Thank you for having us!

Had a great stay, clean, tidy and spacious for a one bedroom place. Mariana was proactive on late checkin instructions and was very responsive. The place itself was a great location in walking distance from the city and other landmarks. The only issues were the wifi wasn’t connecting to our phones and only had one toilet roll for our four days stay. Overall would stay again if those issues were resolved.
Fantastic location- although a little noisy at night. Great apartment- spacious and well appointed. Checking in was easy and our host was friendly and very helpful.
We've had a great time in Porto and enjoyed the City. The apartment was nice and good located. Thank's Marco and Carla for everything.

This was the perfect location! We could easily walk to the station  and also to all the main spots. Our host was super easy to communicate with and check in and check out were simple. Everything was clean. Would recommend!

The location is perfect. Right in-between the two city centres. The place is a little bit dark, it doesn’t get a lot of natural light but if you are not planning on staying in shouldn’t be a problem.  We got a free cleaning service in the middle of our stay which was highly appreciated. For some reason a little bit cold sometimes but could be managed with the AC.

Pedro is a delightful host, he collected us from the airport, waited patiently while we dealt with lost luggage. He spent the time to give us useful information on places to eat, metro and train stops, and mapped out a walking tour through the city. The apartment is spacious, and has all the necessary amenities, including a washing machine and dishwasher. Pedro arranged an extra bed and brought our luggage to the apartment, once the airline tracked it down and delivered it. Last, but not least: the view across the river to Porto is magnificent and let's one enjoy all the moods of the river, sunrise, sunset, mist rolling in and out. Porto is a beautiful city to visit.
Great Location, very modern and very close to the City Center. We could do everything by walking. Very friendly and fast Communication and Easy Check-in and Check-out. We would come back!
Ricardo’s place was in a prime location. His communication was great throughout our stay. Highly recommend.

Marco's place was great. Perfect location for everything one might want to do in Porto. His recommendations were spot on! And the check in and check out process was very easy. We arrived a little early and had a very early flight to catch. Our uber was super cheap to the airport. The apt was very clean. And the towels were awesome. Everything worked and our travels were easy because of how well the apt was located. It's on the 2nd floor. And faces the street. Lovely balcony to people watch from

Dino &Ines are very nice people, they prepared a homemade cake(very delicious) and a bottle of wine before we arrive. The apartment is the best I have ever met, beautiful, decorated with very decent furnitures and equipment, very modern and classic. The location of their apartment is very good as well, closed to 2 Metro station, 10 mins to São Bento station and city center, by walking, and also, there is a big supermarket called Froiz near the apartment. If you are Chinese, there is also a Chinese supermarket near the apartment. Most importantly,  Dino & Ines will give you very detailed tips about traveling in Porto, you will like here!

Luís is a fantastic host! We felt so welcomed by him when we arrived in Porto!  When we arrived, he spent time showing us around his apartment. He provided us with tips and recommendations, which were very helpful. Luís loves Porto and loves showing others why his city is so wonderful. The apartment was modern, clean and accessible. It had everything we needed!  His street - although more residential than the tourist areas - had excellent galleries, cafes and dining. It has its own unique artsy vibe, which we loved.  The location was a quick walk to the more downtown areas of the city.  Overall, we loved the experience of staying at LuÍs' home and would 100% recommend it to anyone looking for an enjoyable cultural experience in the beautiful city of Porto!  Obrigada Luís!!

Small apartment with tiny beds. Great location near Bilbao Market and half mile from river front. A very noticeable smell (a mix of mildew and cleaning products), we had the windows open all day to help air it out. Nice to have access to laundry which we used daily.

We had the 2nd and 3rd floors of this building, which was perfect for our 2 families.  It is spacious, tastefully decorated, and has plenty of beds for everyone.  It is conveniently located next to a little shop for staples and close to a bakery.  It's 5-minute walk to the train station (and a good pizza/beer/wine restaurant) for a direct ride into Porto and a 5-minute walk to the beach for beautiful, long walks in either direction on the boardwalk.  Rui gave us many ideas for activities and restaurants before we arrived to help with our planning, he met us at the house upon our arrival, and kept in contact throughout our stay.  This is a great house for a big group of friends and family!
Everything was great, Hosts were very responsive, and place was really nice. Close to everything in the city, very centric location
We stayed a week in this lovely apartment. It's very well located. Tomàs is a wonderful host, he took time to suggest place to visit, eat and go out. We really suggest this apartment.
Very helpful hosts, convenient location and nice to have a refreshing dip in the small pool in the garden, especially for the children .
Great deal for a simple place. The location was quiet but central, communicating with the host was easy, and there was helpful information about Porto included in the check in messages.

Nice roomy apartment away from the bustle of the city center with a great view over the Douro river - perfect for visitors who want to stay away from the commotion of the city center and don’t mind walking about 15 minutes to the nearest metro stop. The apartment fit 4 people very well and was clean and furnished with everything needed for our stay. Álvaro is a very friendly and proactive host who made sure that we felt at home. We had a wonderful stay and take home great memories from our Porto visit.
We had a lovely stay in Porto! Sofia was easy to communicate with and the apartment was fully updated and comfortable. Just minutes walk to great restaurants and sightseeing.

The apartment was exactly as advertised.  Convenient to walk to Porto or hop on the train practically right outside. Spotless, clean, and fashionably furnished. I found it perfect for my wife, daughter, and me.  Good value for money spent.
Great location near a market. Incredibly clean. Nice hot shower. Beautiful Airbnb just like the pictures.

Chris is a great host. Very welcoming and someone who knows a lot about Porto city - we still go to places like Casinha and Labirintho, which he showed us. About the apartament, it is in a great location and very equiped. We loved our stay! Thanks a lot, Chris! :)
Great place. Fantastic location  Would highly recommend . Ricardo was a great host.
We had a great time in Porto. The apartment was beautiful and had everything we needed for a few days. It was just like in the pictures. The contact was very easy. Thank you!
Attractive appartment and very clean.  Location was excellent allowing easy access to restaurants and main attractions but yet peaceful. Would rent again.

Great stay. Host was really responsive and flexible around check in which was helpful with a delayed flight! Great location and perfect sized apartment for a couple of nights. Right next to Mercado de Bolhão which is worth a visit. Everything is up and down hills in Porto so it is an uphill walk back from Gaia / Ribeira but there are tram options if needed.

The apartment was clean and location was great with metro and supermarkets. The apartment was quiet and cozy. The appliances were appeared all new and host offered apartment cleaning and new towels and linen within our 10 days stay. It was walkable to many places and very convenience with metro. Ms. Anna whom helped us check-in was very friendly. We would visit again.

We really enjoyed our seven night stay in the apartment.  It is located close to all of  the historic sights in Porto and you can travel most places by foot if you are able to walk  hills (and they are never ending).  The Sao Bento train station is a 10 min walk and from there you can catch the regional trains to the historic towns nearby.  Carla and Marco were very accommodating with our check in and check out times and provided great advice to help us with our stay.  This apartment is urban so you should expect the “sounds of a city”, but we did not find them bad. If we return to Porto in the future we will try to book here again.

Very nice apartment - and very well located in the middle of the city. Only draw back was that the key was not in place when we arrived - and the cleaning was not done. However both things were solved quickly, so all in all we can recommend the apartment.
Beautiful space, great view and most importantly, the host was very helpful and immediately responded when questions were asked. Highly recommended!

Very bright and clean apartment. Location is great 5-7 min to metro station. Tones of restaurants and cafes with in couples of blocks. You don’t have to meet anyone to check it which is a big plus in my opinion.
The apartment was just adorable!  Very clean and nicely done.  Access to the building and the apartment was also very easy.  We would certainly stay again.
We had a very good stay in Porto, the place is very conviennent to get around. The recommendations that Lisa gave us were great!
Lovely stylish apartment, very central. Would really recommend staying here. We were given plenty of local tips for during our stay. Thoroughly enjoyed our time in Porto

Pedros place was amazing. I love the style and look of the two-story place. The bedroom kind of hangs about the living room like a stilt bungalow. Classy modern decor and a it gets lots of sun in the daytime. Just two blocks to action, and three blocks to the big beautiful bridge. Wonderful location. Pedro himself is super attentive and very responsive to needs. Has paid parking in a garage downstairs, which is important in an old town like Porto if you're driving. Couldn't have asked for a better stay.  Very clean.

I would highly recommend spending your time in Porto with Pedro. The unit was absolutely amazing and frankly the photos don’t even do it justice: super clean, very spacious and everything that you need. Pedro is a thoughtful host and provided a little welcome gift, great tips and a helpful tour of the unit. There is also optional parking which is really handy to have at such a superb location in the middle of the city where parking is had to come by. Again, it was a wonderful stay !

This was such a great trip from start to finish. Pedro was quick to respond and offer suggestions as soon as I contacted him. He picked us up at the airport despite our plane being delayed and the apartments at My Riverplace are the perfect base to explore Porto. Pedro took us on a guided tour the next day and included a fantastic lunch in a lovely restaurant that had people queuing to get in. He showed us the best Port shop in Porto and gave some excellent recommendations for dinner. I can’t recommend Pedro and his apartments enough for a short city break.
Cute nice apartment close to the city center. You’ll find pretty much everything you need. It was a lovely stay. Thank you

Cute little apartment that is exactly as described and shown in the photos.  Great location and near to lots of eating and drinking spots.  Nice to be able to relax in a comfortable space after a hard day walking up and down the Porto hills. Really comfortable bed, pillows and bed linen. Will definitely be back.

The apartment is light throughout the day, functional and has a cozy and nice vibe. I liked the layout - bedroom faces the inner yard and is very quiet during the night (also keeps slightly cooler than the living room). I had no need to use AC so can't comment on that - the temperature inside was perfect during my stay (23-24 degrees...yes, I travel with a tiny thermometer/hygrometer) :D The only downsides are the squeaky floors (depends on the routine of the people upstairs) and the fact that the house next door is under full renovation (deadline Oct ´26) so there can be pounding and drilling going on during the usual working hours (except Sunday)...occasionally it can be quite loud. Also be mindful if you're airing the bedroom that the other guests are not smoking in the inner yard (another Airbnb with a little inner yard/balcony).
Perfect location for anyone looking to stay in the centre of Porto.  Beautiful apartment that looks exactly like the pictures.  Check in was seamless and would definitely stay again!
Jerónimo was a friendly and welcoming host and his studio apartment was ideally located and perfect for 2 for a long weekend. Thank you!
Really enjoyed our stay , wonderful property, great location , would definitely stay again ! Kevin Wise  Aaren Powell

We loved the place of João! The apartment is located in a nice area next to shops and restaurants. 15-20 minutes walk to the touristic hotspot but also nice restaurants (non tourist). Subway is 3 min walk & shoppingstreet too.  Apartment was spacious enough for 2couples with everything you need. We woud def come here again.

A large communal house is ideal for bigger groups. The unheated pool was still enjoyable, and the terrace view and BBQ were lovely extras. It's about a 30-minute walk or a 10-minute taxi ride to the city centre. Would recommend.  .
Great location in between city and beach, both easily reachable with public transport. Tina gave lots of helpful local tips regarding food and places to see as well as walking routes within Porto.

This apartment was very cozy, clean, and pleasant. Susana is a tremendous host and she goes above and beyond to ensure a great stay, including communication with the guest from the original booking date all the way through the check-out. The location is convenient to all of Porto and the private terrace is a nice addition to the apartment. Truly a fantastic stay overall.
had a lovely stay here! the location was very ideal with stunning views and the apartment was just what we needed!! would definitely recommend
The apartment was spacious, clean, and very centrally located. Joana checked us in and had great recommendations on restaurants and bars in Porto. Would recommend staying here to anyone.

This apartment is perfectly located in Porto. We were able to walk everywhere. The flat was immaculately clean and equipped with all comforts needed. Vitor, our host, was responsive, attentive and very helpful. We highly recommend this Airbnb.

Diogo’s place is beautiful, clean and tidy. Has all the amenities that is required. The pool spot is also a sun trap during the day!  Benedita’s communication was great, she was so helpful as our flight was delayed and she still helped us check in after 10pm.  She was only a message  away and gave us lots of recommendations on things to do!  Will definitely stay here again if there was a group of us
Overall great experience and great value. The towels great but the mattress was a bit rough for those with delicate backs and shoulders.
I just spent 8 nights. Good location, walking distance to just about everything. Room was clean, well appointed and everything worked out great. Overall, very satisfied. 👍🏻

The appartement is well located and comfy You can hear the church bells every morning around 10AM, but it's pretty calm appart from this The cleanliness could be improved Overall we had a great time Thanks !
This was a great location.  Communication was clear and timely.  The place was as listed and we enjoyed the little balcony.  Very nice place to stay in Porto.

Eduardo's team was flexible with accommodating our early dropped baggage.  The apartment was extremely clean and pleasant to stay in with an incredible location central to everything in Porto- we greatly enjoyed it! Beautiful set up, furniture and high ceilings. Super beautiful

This place met and exceeded our family of four's expectations.  Very spacious and modern with all the amenities you'd want.  Washer/dryer unit was key as it allowed us to pack lighter.  The view....wow.  You can see the southern side of the Douro with Gaia in the background, and in the foreground an inspiring view of Igreja de Sao Joao Novo cathedral.  It's an easy walk to many attractions or just for getting lost in an enchanting city.  Alexandra was very responsive and straightforward.  Highly recommended.

A lovely house on the outskirts of downtown Porto - beautifully decorated and designed . We enjoyed the peace after taking the 10 min tram back home, out of the busy tourist areas (easy 25 min walk). Restaurants and bars still around in this area, on the river front, which was great and the area felt a lot more local rather than touristy. Diogo was really helpful with his recommendations and tips. We have had a fantastic week.

This is a very lovely place. Very close to everything. Simple and modern interior! Huge recommendation to everyone who wants to stay in Porto. Rafael was also very accommodating with my check in and check out
Amazing apartment. House is beautifully renovated. The beer garden below has cool events with live jazz music on Sundays. Everything you need is available.
Great apartment, helpful host.  There were no problems and we enjoyed our stay. Thank you!

This was a lovely apartment.  Everything was very nicely decorated and very well appointed.   The washing machine was an excellent addition.  We loved sitting out on the balcony in the morning and the evening.    Comfortable and classy!!
Thank you for a great welcome and stay at your place. Although we stayed there for one night, we enjoyed it very much. The place was big enough for our family. All in all, everything was great.

We were very pleased with the stay. Beautiful apartment and welcoming hosts. We had to change the dates during our trip, due to the sickness of our son, there were no problems with the hosts. Definitely would come back.
Such a wonderful experience, great location, high ceilings, very spacious. It’s even better than the photos. Marianna was very helpful, thank you! We’d love to come again

Luis apartment is beautifully situated to explore Porto. Wonderful restaurants, bakery and grocery stores are handy. The balcony overlooking gardens and pools makes for a perfect place for morning coffee and evening drinks. The apartment is smallish but great for two people. Hot water needs to be well timed for showers and dishes. Luis is a lovely host and the area was a perfect to explore Porto. Highly recommend Capela Incomum wine bar and delicious bread at Masseira bakery around the corner from the apartment.  A little farther but worth the walk is Bilha Nova restaurant.
Absolutely wonderful studio right in the centre of Porto easy access to all sights. Very very comfortable bed and room spotless!!  I’d defo stay again. Highly recommend!

I had a pleasant stay at Mord’s. The room is very nice and there is a lot of space. Chairs are small but artistic. Living room table is made from the cross section of a tree which is very cool.  Check-in and out were pleasant.
A very elegant and clean studio! César was really kind with us and we had a great communication. Central location!  5 *!

The apartment was perfect for 5 adults - location, amenities and living space were all fabulous. The bedrooms were plenty large enough, and the views from most every room were spectacular. We were able to easily walk to every place on our agenda - the Tower, Cathedral, Lello bookstore, Crystal Palace gardens, the riverfront etc. - with local restaurants right around the corner.  Alexandra and Oedro were wonderful hosts, offering guidance and suggestions at every turn. All together, it was an experience and accommodation my friends and I enthusiastically recommend!
The most lovely, calming view in the middle of Porto, allowing you to relax and revive after busy days out. The sound of seagulls and a rooster added to that feeling of an oasis in the city.

We had such a good time at Isabel's cozy appartment in Porto. Clean and comfy all allround and fully stocked with Isabels travelling recommendations. The location is splendid in a nice and quiet neighbourhood close to the city center. A great place to stay,  a welcoming and entusiastic host as well as all the advice we could ever have wished for. 10/10 - we would come again!

I can definitely recommend staying at this apartment to anyone. The location was great, it was pretty close to all of the city's main points. The apartment was clean, well-equiped and had a nice common space where we could all spend time together on comfortable couch. Our hosts communicated with us on a timely basis, they agreed for us to leave our baggage earlier which was really helpful. Moreover the person who welcomed us gave us a lot of useful tips on what to see in the city, where to eat and so on. Nothing to complain about :)

The place is ok.  We had issues with finding the place as the proper address was not provided to us.  We were lucky to find local people to help us .  After about one hour of wondering we finally found the place.  The place itself is close to public transportation and good for the value.

If you need somewhere to stay need the airport but still close enough to the metro to get to Porto, this place is PERFECT. I had a very early flight and instead of worrying about finding a taxi, I was able to walk 20 minutes right to the terminal. The space is comfortable and private, everything you may need. Thank you Célia!

We had a wonderful stay in João and Andreia’s place. It is located easy walking to all the sites in old town. Being located in a courtyard like location made it very quiet at night. Would gladly stay again and recommend to family and friends.
Great place and amazing location! Local restaurants within a short walk!! My wife wants to live there. 😁
Great location within easy walking distance of everything! Parking close by. Seagulls are very noisy at night!!! Comfortable apartment.

Teresa’s place was wonderful for our group. We were welcomed with a glass of port and ice cream.  The outdoor terrace is a great feature to sit and have coffee or a drink. Teresa was very helpful in recommending a wonderful place to eat just up the street.  Authentic Portuguese meal in a family atmosphere.  We had a wonderful stay.
We were so lucky to have stayed at this lovely apartment! The view was absolutely stunning and the location could not have been better. Definitely try the tapas place that Florinda recommends!

We stayed 3 nights in the Amalia room. Tiago and Catia are wonderful hosts. Communication was excellent, and they even arranged a airport transfer for us at a very reasonable rate.  They were very warm and welcoming. The room was more than we expected, newly renovated and beautifully laid out and perfect for two people. It is extremely comfortable and has everything we needed for our stay. There is a separate bedroom with double bed, an excellent bathroom, and well equipped kitchen. The apartment is in an excellent location in Old O'Porto, directly opposite the splendid Sao Bento train station. You can walk everywhere, and are surrounded by cafe's and many attractions. Old O'Porto is a beautiful town, and if you want to visit, you could not stay in a better location or a better apartment than the Sendme2Portugal apartments. Muito Obrigado Tiago and Catia

This was a phenomenal Airbnb! It is very beautifully designed and well-equipped. The location is awesome and the value was great! The hosts were very friendly and easy to communicate with, and they allowed us to check in early. A+ experience!

We had a great stay, Sousa was very helpful and responsive. The apartment is in a great location, can walk to most of the main attractions <15 mins. The building has an elevator and the apartment has air conditioning that works well. We had a very pleasant stay and would recommend!

Wow! It’s even prettier than the pictures. We had a lovely time, the location is perfect, the host is super responsive and the value for money is outstanding. Can highly recommend. There are a few stairs, so take in account when you have large pieces of luggage. Will be perfect for a family with children.
We were only there for a night but the apartment was cute and as described. Spaces are not completely private but are separate. Location is great!

This place was amazing and everything was perfect. Super modern, clean, cozy, great location and everything you might need inside. The host was great too, always attentive to anything we need and even gave us great tips about places to visit or to eat around the city. I will definitely stay here again when I comeback and will recommend it to all my friends.
Great location, safe building with some great suggestions for sightseeing, eats and drinks. Try Portugues de Gema just up the road but make a booking if you can as limited space.

We had a great time in Porto staying at Cool house! The apartment is nice and clean and was spacious for a group of six friends. The location is great, quiet and nice and close to everything. Thank you for some lovely days in Porto. Would absolutely recommend!
Joana’s place is superbly located, it is luminous, nicely decorated, super clean, a great place to stay in Porto!  Ram
Great location in Porto - very close to all the tourist action. Quiet inside the apartment building and very secure.
Very comfortable apartment and it was great to have the lockup garage with our rental car. Supermarket and bakery nearby. No problem to walk down the hill into town.

Great place to stay in Porto in a central location and walkable to tourist sights, shops, restaurants, cafes, bars etc. We were met at the unit by the host who was very communicative and friendly who helped us with our luggage when checking in. He was quick to respond to any other issues we had and also checked up on us periodically which was nice.  The flat was actually more spacious than we thought and has lot of place for storage as well as a full kitchen which came in handy. The small balconies were nice and the windows shut out all sound despite being on a busier street. I could forsee the flat being a little hot in summer but there was a great box fan provided which helped. The flat could maybe use an ironing board and once or twice the hot water in the shower ran out quite quickly but otherwise a comfortable place to stay in Porto. Thanks!
Right in the heart of old town, stylish space, very clean and comfortable.  Highly recommend.

Cristina is quick at responding and has wonderful suggestions to offer. We had a fantastic time in Porto all thanks to her and her delightful Airbnb! Be sure to check out their lovely shop as well :) thank you for everything, Cristina!

Excellent place for our family get together for a birthday celebration. Benita our host went above and beyond with recommendations for restaurants, sites to see etc. Including a surprise birthday & wine !! The house was perfect, well supplied kitchen and super clean. Overall would highly recommend.

Great stay at Tiago’s. Very communicative host, great location, and easy access with all needed items in unit. Elevator was appreciated! The location was central and close to restaurants and the water- overall great stay.

Really enjoyed staying at Pedro’s place - amazing location, very easy to get to with the metro close by and a short walk to bars/restaurants. We loved having the balcony and it felt very private. I would absolutely stay again if visiting Porto in the future!

We had a wonderful stay in this apartment, Lucia is a great host, the communication was very easy and fast, she also gave us a lot of tips what to do in Porto. The apartment was super clean and comfortable, it had everything what’s needed :) I will recommend this apartment to others :)
Would definitely recommend. Location was great. A room was small but cozy, everything was clean including shared spaces. Spacious kitchen and cozy terrace.

Very nice place in Porto. The living room is very big, clean and has many facilities. The room was pleasant and tidy. The airbnb is easiliy accessible. Furthermore, António was helpfull and responded to my questions quickly.

A really lovely house with stunning views, full of amenities, in a quiet village setting. Paula is always contactable and always helpful. She provides a lot of information about the local area. If she’s not around her friend Maria is also super helpful. The house was amazingly clean. Had a really nice stay here.
lovely place to stay, everything was spotless clean. everything was working as it should, lovely shower. few restaurants and shops around, but mostly cash only.  definitely will stay again.
Tom’s place was fantastic! A jewel in the heart of Porto, with a good amount of space and a fabulous balcony. The check-in/check-out process couldn’t have been easier and Tom was very responsive.
Great location, very central. Good alue for money, however, very very noisy. You can hear everyone in the other apartments walking and talking.

Todo muito bem :)) We had a perfect stay. The apartment is really well located. We slept well. The neighborhood is really cool and close to many bars and restaurants. It would have been a pleasure to stay longer in Porto, a beautiful city !

Beautiful apartment very central. Everything can be reached by foot. Beds are really comfortable, we were welcomed with a few thoughtful details. Joao and Andreia were super accommodating and always available, would definitely recommend their place when in Porto.

Carla's place is unique! The location is so central and in a very beautiful neighborhood. The apartment itself is unique and tastefully decorated. It is very cleaned and spacious. On our arrival Carla warmly greeted us at the apartment and gave us many useful tips about the city, and recommended some restaurants, museum and bars to explore. Thank you Carla for this great getaway!

Perfectly located in the center of Porto, an easy walk from sao bento train station. Beautiful private terrace to sit outside and enjoy coffee/breakfast.  We stocked up on fruit, yogurt, bread, and coffee and made our own breakfast every morning.  Porto is a lovely city, and this was the perfect place to use as a homebase!
Great studio in a good location. Hugo was friendly and gave us lots of helpful advice. It was a quiet place to stay and the bed was super comfy. Thanks Hugo!

Perfect stay: the room was clean, comfortable and well equiped, the pool and jacuzzi were both perfect and we were warmly greeted by Susana who gave us really handy information about the city and what to visit nearby.  Absolutely recommend.

Great Airbnb in a quiet neighbourhood of Porto! We used bolt to get around which was very convenient. Great restaurants a 10 minute walk away down to the river and the space was beautiful and clean! Hosts were super responsive and attentive and surprised us with a welcoming gift! Best part was the view

Cesar's airbnb was a wonderful experience. From the very start, Cesar was an attentive host; reaching out to us a couple of days before our stay to confirm our arrival. When we arrived, Cesar welcomed us and showed us around the airbnb as well as given us a few tips to explore Portom The stay itself was top tier - very clean, comfortable and well thought out. There were even fire extinguishers and first aid kit available (Which really demonstrated host's attentiveness). I would definitely come back as well as recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto.

We loved the stay and Judite and her team was so proactively reaching out that helped so much for finding and getting into the place. The place is exactly as shown in the pictures. We loved the location as we had our car to go around and they provide really good parking space that connects to the house. Will definitely look for their properties next time.
Everything from first contact via mail to our arrival was handled very good. The room was nice & clean, nothing to note.  definitely recommended! We had a great time.

We had a great time staying at this Airbnb. The apartment is great value for money, clean, and the location is excellent. Pedro was quick to reply and check in was straightforward. We would definitely recommend staying here.

Wonderful apartment, tastefully furnished, and there is  a good large bed. We would highly recommend staying here. Miguel is a wonderful host. Very communicative, responsive and accommodating. We felt right at home. Thank you for your hospitality.

Pedro was the best Airbnb host we’ve ever stayed with.  Super friendly and attentive with great communication! He welcomed us in person which we really appreciated.  He gave us a lot of recommendations for the area too. The port and pasteis Pedro left as a welcome, were delicious.  We were close to lots of restaurants, grocery stores and walkable to every spot we wanted to see.  The kitchen was also set up nicely for cooking meals.   We really enjoyed our time there.  Thanks Pedro
Great location- close to restaurants and bars. Walkable. The only issue if you are a light sleeper the noise from the bars and restaurants might bother you.

The apartment is as lovely as it looks in the photos. As other reviews say, the view is fabulous, and the location is great. The downsides for us were: the bed - we are okay with a bed on the floor but this one is actually sunken and the mattress is a bit soft - it is very awkward getting out;  also, although there is a small closet with hangers and shelves, there is no place for suitcases except the floor of the dining area and no place to unpack small items except the dining table. A tip:  we had a rental car and parked in the closest garage mentioned in the listing. It cost 166 euros to park for 3 nights.

Enjoyed staying at this apartment. It was close to good restaurants and a good base for sight seeing around Porto. We had a baby travelling with us and the hosts organised a cot and high chair to be available.

We enjoyed Eugenia and Luis’ hospitality very much. Minor details were settled quickly and communication was excellent. We loved our stay in Porto. Lucky for us the museum of Contemporary Art featured an exhibition of Kusama. Very worthwhile. We certainly recommend this place.

The Apartment stands apart from many other places. The recreation of a wonderful 40’s stylish place has  been painstakingly carried out. All the bathrooms felt period while having all the modern amenities and the quality of furniture, Linen etc was 1st class. We were all genuinely amazed by what our hosts had done and will definitely be coming back with other members of our family.
Very nice and friendly host  Rui was extremely helpful and care  It made our stay even better 😉
Great location and good value. If you stay here I'd recommend closing the shutters at night time to keep the street noise out.

The place is amazing for a short trip, cosy and so close to the city center that you will feel amazing after getting to know the city. There was even a complementary olive oil for us to cook, just truly amazing.
The location, apartment and communication with Mariana was perfect. We would definitely recommend this beautiful apartment for everyone especially for people who love interior.

We couldn’t find fault with anything about this beautiful house or about our host Diogo.  The house is stunning, so bright and beautiful. Minimalist yet has everything you could possibly need.  Diogo was more than helpful. When he met us he went through the whole map of Porto showing us all we needed to know. He emailed us later with suggestions for vegan restaurants, having gone to trouble to research this for us.  I would go back in a heartbeat

Wow. Daniel's AirBNB is nothing short of amazing. It's situated in a very convenient area (walking distance to Bolhão station, Chapel of Souls and a variety of shops and restaurants). The unit itself is very clean, has a beautiful view of the Porto skyline and has everything you would need for your stay. 10/10 I would highly recommend for anyone vactioning in Porto.
We had a great stay at Joaquim's place. I would highly recommend it. Very clean accomodation, great location, and excellent communication with the host.

We really enjoyed our stay here! The first thing we did when we arrived was walk out onto the patio and marvel in the view. Is it the best view it Porto??!! It certainly felt like it. The location was ideal— within 5-10 min walking distance to the riverfront, bridge, and Jardim do Moro where you can catch the sunset. Sometimes after long travels the little things matter— being able to checkin a couple of hours early without hassle, good working AC during one of Porto’s hottest weeks, blackout shades, and good water pressure. This apartment offered it all. We would definitely stay here again!

Exceptionally quiet, great bed linens and terrific location with responsive hosts. Most of what you’d need. Quite small, and lacking enough table space for spreading out your bags/suitcase or for putting out your bathroom items when there are two of you. Arrival was stressful with a rental car since streets  surrounding the apartment are extremely narrow, steep and choked with people, and there is really no street parking. Expect to pay for the parking garage at about 30 euros  per day. Our hosts were fairly responsive regarding things we needed like more toilet paper or a bath mat.

Looking for a place in the middle of all the action? Then This studio is for you. The design is a combination of old and new. Stone walls and stone seating area by the window. Modern kitchen and bathroom. With in walking distance to many of the sites on your list , cafes and bars. Area can be a little noisy if you want to go to sleep early or want piece and quiet. Not handicap accessible.

Pedro's property is located in a terrific spot for walking to so many sights.  People watching was fantastic as there are parks, restaurants and coffee shops nearby - perfect for when we needed time to give our feet a rest!  There is also a yoga center and massage therapy just a 2 min walk from the apartment which were convenient. The apartment is lovely, comfortable,  relaxing space in the bustling city. The port wine Pedro shared was such an excellent extra touch. Yum!
This place was great! The space was clean and looked just like the photos. It was in a great location to explore Porto. The hosts were very friendly and made it a great stay!
Great place. Amazing location. You can literally go everywhere by walking. Shops, pubs and supermarkets are nearby.

The apartment is beautiful,  very stylish. Olga Maria was very helpful and her instructions were clear. It is very central for everything.  We loved exploring the immediate area then branching out. The beautiful river is a great place within reasonable walking distance. We would love to go again next year

We thoroughly enjoyed our week-long stay at Pedro's place. The location was ideal, within walking distance to restaurants and bars, the place was clean and stylish, and Pedro was a warm and welcoming host. He even greeted us with pastries and port from his family's winery. Truly a delightful stay!

I had an awesome time in Porto and a great stay in Anabela’s place. The place was very clean and tidy. The room was pretty good size with its own bathroom. The common area is stylish and the kitchen is well-equipped with cooking utensils. Although I haven’t met him, Antonio is very quick to respond and very very helpful. He took the time to follow up if I was okay during my stay. The location was awesome, very accessible by the Metro after a short walk. I love that I was able to do my laundry after being on the road for many days. The only thing  is just to be prepared for climbing upstairs (I was on the top floor). Other than that, I would definitely highly recommend this place.

I loved my stay here- right on the river. Easy check in and check out. It was a nice peaceful location to go across the river or up into downtown. The apartment was immaculate and the kitchen was well equipped. The breakfast was an amazing bonus- loved the fresh pastries and coffee! I would definitely stay here again!

Super cute place in a great location.  Everywhere is walkable if you fancy it.  Super quick response time with any questions you may have. Would recommend to anyone who would be making a trip to Porto   5/5

Luis was such a friendly and thoughtful host. he made my husband and me feel welcome and provided us with very helpful recommendations for Porto that made our stay even more enjoyable.  The place was clean and had everything we could have wished for. The only issue we had was low water pressure but it was manageable and didn’t bother us much. The bed was comfortable and the small terrace was a great feature that we used every day.
Great stay lovely host, gorgeous apartment and would def stay here again. Top location. Obrigada!

The place is beautiful, clean, and in the best location possible. The host was extremely responsive whenever I had a question or needed anything. We had a blast and I would definitely stay here again.

We had a nice stay at Marta & JP’s. Great communication, ideal location, and it had everything we need. Aside from some stained towels/sheets and the space being a bit damp (could use an extra air purifier) we had a good stay. Thank you!

Great location! Everything you need is walking distance. Communication was also great, we received everything we needed to know ahead and also videos of how to use the bed on the wall and other Stuff, which was really helpful. Thank you!  The Apartment is equipped with the basics, but was missing some small things you don‘t want to buy while travelling like salt & pepper, oil, a scissor etc. Talked to the owner and they said they would provide it for the next guests though :) Check-in is 4 pm and check-out is 10 am, which I find a little early, when you are on vacation. The Place is really small so I don‘t think it takes that long to clean and prepare for the next guests. Upon request we were allowed to check-out half an hour later though. All in all we really enjoyed our stay in Porto, which is a lovely city and we would Book the Apartment again :)

Rafael and his husband were extremely kind and made us feel very welcome into their beautiful home. However, we had expected that we would be able to enjoy the view a bit more by sitting on the balcony, making ourselves a coffee in the kitchen etc., but since our hosts were using the common area every night and morning/midday, we didn’t feel like spending time anywhere else than in our small (but lovely) room.  So, this place is lovely and unique if you’re looking for kind and personal hosts and a bed to sleep in after a day in Porto.

Ana Cristina’s was a nice place to stay with easy walking distance within Porto & Gaia Apartment was great, had everything we needed & suited the two of us Would recommend it to anyone wanting to stay in Porto
Daniel was a fantastic host. He provided clear, detailed instructions that made for a smooth checkin. The location is great, with so much close by and walkable. We would love to return.

We had a good time in Porto and enjoyed mostly the great and central location of the accommodation.  The communication went very well and easy.  We were 3 people, so it was fine, but 6 people would probably be more an issue with only 1 small bathroom and the open bedrooms on top.  As other guests already said, it is very noisy, mostly from the neighbours upstairs. During normal hours it wouldn't be a problem, but it's noisy until after midnight.
the appartment is really well located. very good handbook to get to the place and around. clean place. thank you Claudia & the team
Spacious apartment right next to the river, easy access to the main water front area. Filipe was very communicative and helpful too!
Luis and his place were both fantastic! Luis was very welcoming and helpful on recommendations in the city. His place was very clean and perfect location. We would love to stay there again!
This is just a nice gem in the city!  The apartment is conveniently arranged and has everything for a fine stay!

The apartment is recently renovated and very comfy! The furniture is bright and friendly.  We had some problems with the electricity, but Paulo was very easy to reach so he fixed the problem very fast. It was a great stay. Thank you!

Words cannot describe the treatment we received from Bruno and his staff.  They were very proactive in communicating and anticipating our needs .  The apartment is in a great, safe location with a fantastic view.

We had a great stay at Sven’s apartment. The apartment is spacious and has a good location near the centre and public transport. The beds were comfortable and the kitchen was well equipped. The apartment was good value of money.
A great place to stay! A few stations with the subway to the center of Porto, and also a very quiet area to sleep.  Thank you Alexandre!

Absolutely lovely apartment in the heart Porto! The check in is very smooth due to codes provided for the front and apartment door. We really liked the helpful and detailed recommendations and descriptions of Porto, especially for the food! The apartment was very clean with a well equipped kitchen. Definitely recommended, would have loved to stay longer!! Thanks! Porto is definitely worth the visit.

Pedro’s apartment was perfect for a few days stay in Porto - location was ideal,  walking distance to main areas, apartment was very clean, very comfortable, well equipped and Pedro couldn’t have been more helpful. We very much enjoyed our stay - thank you Pedro!
Excellent accommodations. Comfortable, well decorated and ideal location near Douro river. Very secure entry and exit. Enjoyed the balcony!
Absolutely excellent room and location however during our stay we struggled to sleep due to street noise from neighbouring bars.

Amazing apartment right in the thick of Porto’s buzzing heart. The view from the apartment is absolutely incredible and you can enjoy all day sunshine with the doors open. Worked remotely here for 2 weeks and was the perfect place with a decent internet connection.
Wondeful location and easy check in procedure. The flat is large but a bit damp and smelly.
Miguel’s place is clean, renovated and easily accessible. Perhaps it is because of the rain in the city, this place smelled & felt damp when we stayed.
Clean, new and good location with a lot or restaurants nearby. If you have the chance to book this studio, then do it! Would definitely recommend.
Comfortable stay, good location and appreciated Filipe’s extra efforts to make our stay with comfortable, especially for the baby - crib, milk in the fridge, baby wipes, etc.!

Nice flat,near airport ,I was travelling to Germany back my work and it's very close airport,why I'm taking this flat, also not so far 800 mtr intermarche where can buy food,also Aldi near, perfect place rest before travel
Excellent  location, had all I needed, too bad I couldn’t extend my stay at this place

It was a wonderful stay, Alexandre put so much effort in making the guests feel welcome. Everything was neat, clean and in gorgeous design. Even though there where other guests we felt completely private and it was a great atmosphere! I can highly recommend the loft!
The apartment is nice and  has a central location. The view is amazing. It was easy to communicate with Brigite. Highly recommended!

The apartment is wonderful, even better than the pictures. It is so warmly decorated with so much care that we immediately felt at home. Paulo welcomed us very kindly and provided us with all the necessary information. He and Olga are great hosts, flexible and easy in communication. We really hope to come back some time!
It is a great Appatment. Ana is very friendly, helpfull and always responsive. It was a very nice stay!
Nice place in the center. As others have mentioned the stairs can be a lot, but overall a good stay.

Paulo’s place was exactly as pictured and then even better! Very clean, really easy to get there via the airport and very close to everything! His mother checked us in and they were very accommodating! Couldn’t recommend this place enough :)
Nice classic room with private toilet on the floor . Seaview is modest but an extra . Mario and Dulce are very kind people , I can recommend the stay

The apartment is new, very clean and comfortable, you have everything that you need. It is also close to the sea, with surf schools and rentals, the metro and nice fish restaurants. Jose has been really helpful. We have a wonderful stay.
Amazing stay, everything was as described. Location was extremely accessible to the center and other attractions. Will recommend this place to others :)

We really enjoyed our stay.  Well situated.  Traffic is quite something - very busy.  Parking lot was about a 4/5 minute walk away.  Top floor so make sure you can do stairs.  Quiet.  Lots of great restaurants and coffee shops close by.  Communication was awesome with the host.

Daniel’s place in Porto is in such a great position - so close to the Douro River, restaurants, cafes, and the many beautiful sites of Porto. The apartment is clean, well laid out for its size, and is better than the photos - it’s highly recommended

Highly recommend this stay if you are in Porto! Pictures matched the stay perfectly and location was amazing (Central to everything). Apartment was cozy and view from the window was outstanding. Also owner was very responsive and accommodating. If I ever come back to Porto I will definitely rebook and highly recommend to anyone going to the area!

It was great staying over at this cozy apartment in Porto and the host has been so welcoming and accommodating, even though we arrived very late! Thank you so much and definitely recommend! Great locations, close to everything and great host. 😊

We loved our stay at Ana's house! You can explore the beaches and visit Porto but also spend some time at "home". Great rooms, good internet and a very welcoming atmosphere. Two grocery stores just around the corner. The hosts are also very nice and helpful. I would totally recommend the house!

We loved staying in this attractive bright apartment right in the heart of Porto. It was handy for the sights and transport and had fabulous views. The seagulls were really noisy at night but this was not a problem as the double-glazing & shutters block out the sound completely, plus their is air conditioning. It is top floor so a bit of a climb but well worth it for the view, light & privacy. We would definitely recommend.

The flat is beautiful and has everything you need (towels, hair dryer, plates, ....) it's just a short walk to the city center and a supermarket is close near by. Porto is a lovely city with so much to explore. Unfortunately we couldn't meet Helena in person but the lovely lady who welcomed us was very helpful and friendly. Communication before our stay was easy. Definitely good value for money!
Teresa is a great host really nice and welcoming! The place is big with lot of bathroom we were nine and had a great time!

A lovely apartment, very well equipped and comfortable with some charming decor, very hot shower, comfortable bed (with spare bed as well),  in a friendly residential location but just a step away from Porto's attractions.  Marco let me check in early which was a tremendous help after a very early flight.  The pop up restaurant next door had a late  lively night on Saturday, but this is I believe only on Saturdays and looked like a lot of fun. The neighbourhood is very calm, with some lovely (very cheap!!!)  cafes and restaurants with great views just round the corner, and only about  ten minute walk to to the centre of town and ten minutes to the river.  I really enjoyed staying here. Thank you Marco.
The place is a very charming house, it was so convenient to be so close to bus stops and a supermarket. The host is very friendly, good with communication and very helpful!

Everything was so great! Isabel was so kind and nice woman. We felt there really like at home. We had private room and bathroom and we could use her kitchen for cooking. I really recoment this acommodation for everybody. The place is close to market, beach and many caffees. Thank you for all Isabel 💙

Ricardo is a great host. Top tips. Very quick to reply to messages. Made our stay really convenient by providing some stuff for our baby. The apartment is better than the images. Sonia was also great with the later check-in, explaining everything clearly and giving us a detailed map. We will return.

This is a very nice place to stay, close to the harbour, lots of nice fish restaurants, the huge surfer’s beach and easy to go to the old city center of Porto, and also easy by bus from the airport. Price/quality is 200%.  Thank you Gonçalo
Excellent location, super central with incredible views of the city. Lovely, spacious and modern. Exactly what we were looking for.
