Great stay- the apartment was really nice and clean when we arrived. The area itself is kind of quiet but it’s not too far away from the city centre. You can hop on the train or get a cab and you can get to the beach or the river in no time!

We are a family of five, and this is definitely our favorite place in Portugal. Affordable price, clean, close to everything, great kitchen, comfortable beds, warm enough heater during the winter, and elevator! We are impressed! Everything is almost perfect, so we highly recommend any family of four or five consider here when they visit Porto!

A great host, a very authentic old Portuguese house, awesome location. Unfortunately, it was freezing inside, basically the same temperature that was outside. I had to work with my head under blankets. Better book only in warm months.
Great apartment in a superb location. The views are even better than the photographs! A friendly welcome to our friends that checked in first. Plus great eating tips. Thank you!
We booked it very late because our other accommodation was cancelled on the same day. The team helped us very quickly and got us this perfect room in no time!
We really enjoyed staying here. It's private and cute. It's in a great location- 15 minute walk to Avenida dos Aliados. The breakfast was well served. Iron was provided on request. Pleasant stay.

A very lovely, comfortable apartment which had everything we needed. Convenient for going out and exploring the city with a scenic walk alongside the river. A great host who was very helpful and attentive.
Fresh, secure, impeccably clean, new furnishings and appliances, central to everything, and very quiet at night. Quant setup inside with clever space saving stairs to cosy loft bedroom.
Loved the location, everything was within walking distance. They provided some local preferences for things to see and do which was really helpful as well. Very clean and comfy space :)

My friend and I loved staying here and having o our own bathroom! The apartment is very cute and spacious. Beds were comfortable. Great location. Definitely would stay here again, and Pedro was super nice!

Great apartment, looks exactly like in photos. Very clean and functional. There are 2 bathrooms and 2 separate rooms, each on different floor.  The location is perfect - 2 minutes walk from the beach and 3 minutes to the Porto Metro station, which goes directly to the Porto city center.
This is a fabulous apartment. Modern, clean and beautiful. It has a fantastic terrace and wonderful views. The location is ideal.  Very highly recommended on all counts!

Perfect stay close to everything in the historic area! The Airbnb was so spacious and had s nice view of the cathedral from the balcony! Hosts were extremely responsive and beds were comfortable! Was wonderful to have the outdoor space to hang and our toddler loved the bunk bed! Would definitely recommend for your Porto stay!!!
Really nice person that want you to feel like you are at home. He will also provide everything you need to go around porto if it is your first time in the city
Everything was perfect! Very good flat with all necessary things. I would recommand it. Well placed, very cute and good for 4 people.

Sofia’s apartment is beautiful, amazing amenities, such as a/c that works great, excellent location, safe entry and easy check in/out. The apartment is very clean and it is on the Main Street, great restaurants and  stores.  I would definitely stay there again. Best location in Porto.
Paulo and his mother are very hospitality. The apartment is clean, comfortable and cozy, all was good. And it is very good location. I recommend this apartment.

The view alone makes this location well worth a stay. Alexandre was a fantastic host and provides us with very useful tips and suggestions for things to do and where to eat while in Porto. Overall a charming, beautiful, spacious place to stay while in Porto. I can't recommend this enough!

Pedro and Ines have such a beautiful space, the apartment is light and peaceful and we immediately felt relaxed during our time in Porto. The design is gorgeous and the location is great. We will definitely be back.
A lovely comfortable modern apartment well situated in Porto near plenty of cafes and restaurants and within easy reach of the river. The hosts were very informative and responsive. Highly recommend.
Carlos & Christina's place was perfect! Great location and newly renovated. They were very helpful with recommendations of restaurants/things to do. Would definitely stay again.

Such a nice and cozy traditional house to stay in. Paula was a great host and quick to respond. Even though we got some rainy days, the chance to use the pizza oven made us all feel so warm and welcomed. Thank you so much Paula!
We had a wonderful stay in Carla's beautiful apartment - it was conveniently located near the best bits of Porto and was very comfortable - highly recommended!

We stayed for 3 nights in Fernando's centrally located apartment.  Extremely close to everything you could possibly want to do and see in Porto and the plus was that it comes with a parking space right in the centre of Porto which wasn't easy to find.  The apartment was immaculately clean (couldn't even find dust inside) and kitchen was well stocked, with both wine AND beer.  Although we didn't manage to use it, it set us up for our stay.  Fernando was kind and thoughtful and waited for us to show us the parking.  His restaurant recommendation for us which he also booked for us given our limited Portuguese was easily the best meal we had in Porto!   Many thanks Fernando for a great time in Porto

This studio is a great choice to stay in Porto! It is really nice and quite spacious for a studio. Between the decor, windows, and building it is truly a unique stay. The location is really the highlight though, you are walking distance to many of the main sites of Porto but on a side street that was quite and local. Hugo provided some excellent recommendations of places to eat nearby. Definitely would stay again at this location!
It was amazing !! Definetly would stay there again , location is great , everything worked in the apartment , great WiFi , it’s perfect

The location of the apartment is perfect, everything close by, and a bit away from the crowds in Ribeira. Communication was very easy. The apartment has everything you might need. We really enjoyed our stay.

This home was amazing! It was very spacious and very close to the Metro. Daniel was always available and looking to help. He made sure our safety was always first. The beds were very comfortable and overall, he did a great job at making us feel at home. I had a perfect time here!

Highly recommend! Wow! Where to start!  The room itself is absolutely stunning, comfortable and very spacious. Waking up to the sunrise outside the window was something to look forward to everyday as well as the view over the river just amazing!  The kitchen is well equipped and the bathroom just beautiful  Everything about our stay was perfect! As for our host the BEAUTIFUL TINA, she took us under her wing as though we were her family from the very beginning. She really made us feel at home. Her kind and caring nature as well as extreme generosity made us really feel like we were in a "home away from home." Dont think twice just book and Tina will welcome you with open arms.
Nice stay at Ana's place situated in the heart of the Porto, everything was easily accessible from the apartment and Ana's son was very helpful. Thanks for everything.
The apartment was nice and clean. Location was good - easy walking distance to the river and sightseeings. Communication with host was quick and friendly. Everything was perfect.

Lovely and big appartment in the heart of Porto. Very close to the river but also close to the northern part of the center, actually perfecly situated.  I loved the laundry service for a very reasonnable price

We were made very welcome and given helpful suggestions and advice when we arrived. The apartment is spacious and full of character with a great and convenient location behind the cathedral - and the panoramic view is fabulous. The kitchen is well equipped. Unfortunately, the weather (at the beginning of Feb) was too cold to enjoy sitting in the garden. If we visited Porto again we would come a bit later in the year!

Our Trip to Porto was very nice, thanks to this Appartment. The Rooms are very clean and modern, everything we needed was included, inclusive the Parking Space. The View from the Balcony was excellent. The Hosts were very friendly and informative. We would stay again here, if we return to Porto or Villa da Nova Gaia.
Great location! Jose was very responsive & we got the extras we asked for. Highly recommend this place.
overall a very good stay - a few issues with cleanliness of the property unfortunately but great location and very quiet.
Every thing was perfect, clean, good advices and nice touches in the room, I love it, thou it’s central it was pretty quiet :) I recommend it totally:)
Very good location, near to city center, very responsive host, easy check in, I will stay again!
We had a lovey stay! The location was perfect and the apartment was in great shape. Comfortable and safe. I would absolutely stay here again.

Marina is an excellent host. She took the time to meet us and explain everything about the apartment even when we arrived much later than expected. The apartment was really cozy with everything we needed. The area is nice, well serviced by supermarkets and really close to Espinho if you want a bit move movement.
Pedro was super helpful, responsive, and the place was great - cool view of the river.
Lovely place with even lovelier surroundings. So peaceful and tranquil. It feels like a Portuguese small town right next to Porto.

Maria's place is a well-centered location. All the amenities were in place, spacious apartments, solid spacious rooms, with airco—outstanding living room for families and a good balcony.  The check-in was smooth, and I can't provide more details because despite booking 4 nights we only spent 1 at the apartment due to a variety of reasons. Nonetheless, the apartment matched the description, only remark for the building in general is that the balcony has a low height, which isn't super comfortable when you've toddlers around.
Thanks for havingus, we loved your place. We were a short uber drive away from the beach and downtown. Porto was a great place a d indeed we wish to come back.
Beautiful villa in a stunning location wasn’t to far to Porto city. The host was very helpful before and while staying at property. Would highly recommend. Definitely worth the money
Very enjoyable stay, great location, perfect room, just a bit loud in the morning due to roadworks, otherwise perfect place

We had a wonderful stay at Susana’s  apartment . Perfect location allowing easy access to all Porto has to offer.  We loved the road the apartment is located on with great places to eat and drink on our doorstep. The apartment is light and spotlessly clean. It is well equipped and comfortable.The terrace is an absolute bonus.  Communication throughout from booking to departure was outstanding. Thoroughly recommend Susana’s place.
Firstly I loved Porto, Portuguese, Matosinhos :) it was a lovely trip. The host and his/ her team was very helpful. So thank you for everything :)

Perfect location in Porto. Great for a family or group of friends. Fantastic if you have a car as there is a parking garage and Luis was very helpful to be sure we got access and in person instructions. Nice to feel at home after a long day with the option to climb stairs or take the elevator.
Very good place for a short break in Porto. Good localization , near some delicious restaurants and historic center. Very spaceous. With airco if you need. I recommend

We loved everything about our stay the apartment was exactly as described. Great location close to everything with a great view of the river. Thierry & Nastia were always easy to contact and gave a lots of great ideas for places to visit  Thank you we will stay again
A wonderful stay in Lisbon. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to visit the city. The Airbnb is in a great location and the host is very responsive to any needs.

Carlos and Cristina have the most fabulous apartment. We had such a great experience here. Check in was easy and Cristina showed us where to park and gave some great tips and advice. The location is absolutely amazing, we couldn't ask for better! we recommend trying the restaurants of Puro 4050 for some amazing food and music on the patio, and Portu's with great service and food. You can't go wrong with either and you will love this apartment!
This house is big and clean. It's quite cozy, and the host are thoughtful. It's easy to catch the metro and the host provide me much useful info.
Nice  cosy spacious place to explore Porto! Very light with 5 big windows giving you the feeling of the old city even when you are inside. Would gladly stay here again!

We did not meet Carla, her friend Sonia waited for us at the apartment. Sonia was very nice and helpful. The apartment is very modern, clean and very well located, many places are at a walking distance and the metro is at the corner. We would highly recommand the apartment to all travelers
Ed was a fantastic host, glong put of his way to help us with parking and local knowledge. we would recommend this amazing host to everyone x

The communication with the host was really easy even though they were away. The flat although not in the centre, it was very close to metro stop and local shops. The place had a character to it,quirky, in very cool vintage style, clean and cosy, really loved it. There was nice balcony where we had tea in the mornings. The wifi was good. In general we had a lovely stay and would definitely recommend it.

Both Andre and his brother Patricio were very friendly and helpful. They were quick to respond to questions and were very knowledgeable about the area. If we ever return to Porto, we will definitely stay here again!
I loved my stay in Porto! This apartment is super cute and it’s in an awesome location. Sebastien was an excellent host! I’d definitely stay here again.
Great location, beautiful nice and clean unit close to shops and restaurants. However the home did not have the essentials like dishwashing soap, shampoo,etc.
We had a good time in a friendly apartment close to the center. The check-in, the apartment and the check out was perfect.

What a great stay we had here. Super easy for our taxi to find and very clear check in instructions. The apartment was finished beautifully and the host even left some port samples and some biscuits for us to enjoy on arrival. The location is extremely central, with many landmarks, shops, bars and restaurants within 5 minutes walking distance. The apartment has a fantastic view of the city and we couldn't recommend more.  Great shower, very comfy bed and all finished very nicely
Maria was a great host. Her place was centrally located near everything. We loved our stay!!! Thank you!!

We loved everything about this apartment!  It was modern,clean and spacious - in a great location, walking to everything.  If i had a question they responded immediately with great information.  Loved, loved... Oh and you have outside area which was fantastic to have as well!!!  The porto and fruit was a very nice touch too :)
Sofia, thank you for all your help and advice during our stay. Your apartment is beautiful and is a great location to view the city!

Very friendly welcome. They left us a bottle of wine and provided us with loads of information about the city. Amazing location in the centre of town next to night life as well historic sites and railway station. Flat has a balcony too. Stay here!
Very nice and comfortable place, his family so sweet.we've a wonderful trip, thank you for everything.
Our stay was just perfect: situation in the city, quality of the apartment, interaction with the host … definitely one of the best spot we had in the city in many years

Stayed 4 nights. Alexandra is a super host, excellent instructions on how to find and access the apartment and very responsive. The listing and photos are accurate, it was modern, clean, comfortable and a well equipped and located place to stay. What more can you ask for! Highly recommended, I would stay here again should I visit Porto again. Thanks Alexandra :)

Good location, nice, clean, spacious and bright apartment. Communication was easy. The only drawback was that cooking was a little difficult, as basic tools like chopping board, knives and other kitchen utensils were missing.

We had a fantastic stay in Porto in this Air BnB. It was clean and near all major sights in Porto. The appartment had everything we needed. The second bedroom and terrace were only accesible by a narrow spiral staircase. Which was fine for us, but maybe good to know beforehand if you're not easy with stairs. Thank you for Hastings us.

Excellent apartment, fully equipped and very spacious. Close to the centre of everything, near to great places to eat and with easy access to the metro. Bernardo was very helpful at check-in; we are already planning a second visit.

This apartment and Porto were amazing. When we come back, we will be looking for this home to stay in. AMAZING views, sweet and thoughtful touches, everything was perfect. Book this place, you’ll be glad you did. Super close to everything by foot and next door to a gorgeous cathedral and museum.

Joana‘s house was super clean and very well designed. The whole vibe of the house was welcoming and the love for details was amazing. We felt totally at home! Joana helped us out with great food suggestions and also let us check in early. The house is not far away from the water and is situated in a quiet neighbourhood. We can really recommend staying at her place and are looking forward to coming back some day as Porto is such a beautiful city. Muito obrigado Joana!
The room was clean and comfortable. The perfect location for our start on Camino Way. We recommend it to everyone who wants a private room for their Camino adventure.
Very nice and cosy apartment, located in a center of the city in walkable distance to all amenities. Highly recommended!!!

The apartment is on a great location, on walking distance to some of the main attractions and the train station. Clean and spacious apartment, and the communication with the hosts was very easy and fast
Great place, very well located  Quick response by Adriano.  Very friendly and helpful.  We even got  fresh fruits at our arrival. It’s a historical building, very charming but not well isolated.

Nuno's place is highly recommended. It is in an easily reachable location with great public transport, shopping and dining options. Being on the 5th floor of the building it is far away from street noises, has a nice sunny terrace and view. Nuno is a wonderful host, very friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.

Priscilla is a wonderful host that goes above and beyond to ensure a comfortable stay. She is responsive and communication was easy. Location is great - super close to metro, supermarkets and only 20 min walk to the bridge. Lovely place for those who want to stay away from the crowds. Price+host+location is unbeatable. Definitely recommend
The house is fine, communication was quick but we never saw anyone. There is a lot of noise from the street.
Very nice apartment for a weekend trip. Simple apartment but everything you need for a short stay. Clean. Close to everything. Very helpful and accommodating. Recommend!

The apartment is very well located and close to most places. It was as described and the stay was very comfortable. The hosts were responsive and accommodating. Recommend Ana and Joao’s place to anyone looking to stay in the heart of Porto.

The accommodation was clean, thoughtfully furnished with comfortable beds. The location was great, right next to the metro and walkable for shops, restaurants, etc. Parking was convenient and the garden was lovely.

We had a great time in Porto staying at Marco’s apartment. The communication in advance and during our stay was easy and fast, the apartment is located directly in center town and the provided amenities were good. We can highly recommend the place and Marco as local hosts! :)

Had the best stay at Mariana’s apartment! The apartment is beautiful and spacious. We loved sitting on the balcony. Mariana was a great host and accommodating to our early check in which we really appreciated. I’d recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto.

The City Double View apartment is highly recommended. The place itself is clean, bright, nice details and has indeed wonderful views. The welcome gift was great and delicious. Location is good, everything in walking distance. Communication was almost instant, lots of tips on where to go and what to eat (Sandes de Pernil at Casa Guedes!). Next time we'll try to book it again!

Daniel’s place was exactly as described and perfect for our time in Porto! It’s in a great location that’s walkable to everything. The apartment was easy to find and Daniel’s helpful instructions made getting in a breeze for both the apartment and garage. We’d recommend it to anyone visiting Porto!
The only problem was noisy people outside, homeless drunk people have spot under the window but i think its not depend on you
Nice Reception, everything was there and I never felt alone. The apartment was clean and with complete equipment. Everything in Sto. Tirso was close to reach.

This is a really good spot to stay and exactly like the photos. It is on the third floor and I'd say with 4 people if we were staying any longer than 2 nights we'd definitely need to grab more toilet paper. Super easy to get into once you have the key, lots of great restaurants around and just an all round good landing spot.

We loved our stay here. The apartment was impeccably clean and stylishly decorated. The location was fabulous and our host was easy to communicate with and met our every need. We highly recommend this place.
this flat is great for a couple on a city break. the terrace is amazing. the location is excellently placed near nice dinner restaurant and few mins walk from city heart

This Airbnb was nice, spacious, and centrally located to downtown Porto. During the periods of construction it is very loud and difficult to sleep. The construction also makes it difficult to get around town at times, but once the construction is finished this will be a wonderful place to stay when visiting Porto
Good stay and very nice host and cleaning lady! Worth the stay for 1 month! 😄
Amazing location and host!  They provided helpful information to help navigate our first visit to Porto. We hope to stay with them again!
The place was just perfect! Clean, in the heart of the city, spacious. Highly recommendable.

This place is great for downtown Porto, walking distance from sights and restaurants, the space is super comfortable for up to 6 people and is filled equipped, functioning TV, dish washer, hot water, etc. We had a wonderful stay here and Telmo was welcoming and prompt to comunícate! This is not the place to stay if you want a view of the sea, since it is the heart of the city.

The apartment was exactly as we expected looking at the photos and description. The location is so central, walking distance to the city, transport and local amenities. The hosts were extremely friendly and responsive, communicating with us before, throughout and after our stay

We stayed for four nights. The hostess is very helpful in accommodating our early arrival by letting us check in before noon instead of the normal 3PM check-in time. The apartment is very nice and roomy, overlooking the Douro river from the living/dining area.  Our apartment is on the third floor. There is no elevator.  Carrying large and heavy luggage can be a challenge. The kitchen is fully functional with adequate utensils, plates, glasses, cooking spices, etc... Outside noises from the street below can be noticeable with the windows opened. The area is safe for walking. The location is within walking distance to many places. Porto is a city on the hill. Walking uphill and downhill is expected... We enjoyed the apartment and the city very much. The hostess is very responsive and very nice. Thank you.
Absolutely great location, close to most things! Pedro was very kind and made my stay very easy! Would stay here again

This Airbnb is a good location. It’s close to the bus station and metro so it’s easy to get around the city and to other cities in Portugal. It’s about a 15-20 min walk to the city center which is great. The place is also close to many shops, grocery stores and pharmacies. The hosts were nice and one greeted me at the door, explained the facilities and was helpful in assisting me in finding the place. It was great for my two friends and me and it’s a good value. Would definitely recommend this place.

We had a great time at the apartment.  There was a lot of attention to detail. Great amenities - everything you could want and more and spotlessly clean. Lisa was really responsive and flexible.  As others have said, it is Porto so there are lots of hills,  but the apartment was well placed for heading down to the river or up into the old town.  Great views from the outdoor spaces down to the river. Would thoroughly recommend.
Clean, easy to locate with great check in instructions. Host was over communicative but provided good recommendations for local restaurants. We enjoyed our stay in Porto and would stay here again.

Perfect, let me repeat, Perfect location. Wonderful view of Porto. Right at the end  of Gaia. The bridge is one step away. The apartment is small and minimal but well done. A great Porto vibe. Glad we stayed there
We stayed here for 5 days with our toddler. We had a great stay. Communication with the host was very easy. Location was excellent. Would recommend
The cottage was clean and comfy and yet very stylish. The mattress was very soft and the bed big enough to sleep two people. We enjoyed our stay and would have loved to stay a bit longer.

A very well equipped room with shared spaces as kitchen and living room. The best was the cleaning lady, Paula, extremely kind and friendly. The place is quite far from the city center but we’ll connected. The neighbourhood where it is located has nothing special and it’s a bit sad at nights, where no shops or restaurant are opened.

We had a great stay, perfect for our family trip with 3 generations. Babycot and chair was provided at request. Marta was very easy and quick to communicate with, really appreciate that. Location is good close to Trindade station, be sure to walk left out of the station to avoid the stairs that someone had mentioned here earlier. Minimarket just across the street, big supermarket a few hundred metres walk away. Porto is lovely, thanks Marta!

Luís is a great host, friendly and helpful, he did his best to make our stay as pleasant as possible. He shared some useful tips of places to see, food, wine etc. Luís was also flexible with check out and responsive at all times!  His cozy and stylish apartment in the centre of Porto definitely made us feel at home!

Helena and Eduardo were fantastic hosts. Eduardo was friendly, welcoming and assisted us every step of the way. The flat was wonderful. The location is perfect, walking distance to the centre. Porto, we fell in love! We will come back. Thanks for everything!

The location was around 10 minutes walk from the main center, so very practical. The shop below has all the items that you may need like breakfast, fruit, fresh bread, etc. The seagulls outside are a little noisy first thing in the morning, however earplugs are supplied and you get used to this quickly. The room itself is very spacious and well decorated.
Had a wonderful few days at Anisalbel’s, the apartment is super nice and had everything we needed and more, also walkable distance to a lot of places. I’d Totally recommend staying here
The apartement is really nice, clean, with large beds and useful kitchen. Miguel is so nice, he gives you lot of tips to visit the city and enjoy your stay. I highly recommand this place !
We had a great stay in this beautiful apartment. The contact before was informative and helpful and the apartment well-equipped.
We had an amazing experience staying in these apartments. Renovated building, new elevator, fresh and minimalist decor, spacious apartments and great location. Highly recommend!

This place was right in the middle of the action. Definitely noisy but I was ready for that and very worth it with the location and price! Victor was so responsive and had great recommendations for the area and excellent hospitality. Quick to help when a small issue came up. Would definitely stay again!
perfect stay. location is perfect city of porto is very nice and small you can walk it all. definitely would come back
Comfortable bed, great views. Had some trouble with the electricity (not their fault), they were very prompt in fixing it.

Our stay was great. The apartment was very clean, tastefully decorated and in a prime location. I highly recommend for anyone visiting Porto. Easy check in and out. Parking down the block. Great place.

Great apartment in the heart of Porto!  3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms as described with a nice large living area with windows to the street.  This apartment is within walking distance (within 10 minutes) to nearly every attraction in Porto.  Even walking to Guia on the other side of the river is a quick 15 minutes! The apartment was clean, updated, and modern.  Communication with the hosts was fantastic, and they were able to accommodate our schedule for check-in.  Our family would recommend staying here for a nice trip to Porto.   One comment for future guests.  Check into parking garage rates nearby, the closest and most convenient one does not offer discounts for full-day parking, which can get quite expensive.
Great location very central. Very clean and spacious! Big bathroom and comfy bedroom - great value for money

Carlos and Helena were very kind and accommodating hosts. The flat was extremely clean, stylish, and comfortable. We stayed with a total of four guests and the flat never felt too crowded. The flat is only 10 minutes away from the center of town, but there are great cafes and restaurants even closer to the flat. Would definitely stay here again if we ever find ourselves back in Porto.

Completely renovated house using the old materials with quite some taste.  Fantastic and flexible host in a very small village in the surroundings of Arouca.  Even a (non heated) pool and a magnificent view.  For us the mattresses were far too hard and we have informed the host.  We were unlucky that dogs in the close neighbourhood did not stop to bark…really long time.  So if you like calm, quite and forest this is the place to be.

We had an amazing stay at the apartment. The communication and checking in was great and clear. The apartment was very clean and looked very good. The location is superb and within a few minutes of walking you are in the city center. Overal an amazing stay!

Susana's very clean apartment was a wonderful place to stay.  The location was ideal for walking to everything--sights, restaurants, shops and transportation.   The apartment was decorated very tastefully and designed for easy use.  It was very  quiet for sleeping,  and the terrace was the icing on the cake.  Susana was very easy to communicate with and responsive to all our needs and questions.  Highly recommended.
Really good stay. Flat was clean and as advertised, and the location was fantastic. The in-person check in was appreciated as well, a nice touch.
It was absolutely perfect. Very nice people, caring and attentive care and the location was wonderful for me this morning.

Joana's place was perfect! It was spotless, comfortable and ideal for exploring the area. Close to Porto and within easy reach of everything. We enjoyed our stay and would certainly recommend it. Thankyou😊😊
Susana’s place was fantastic! It has all you need and is great walking distance from anything you’d want to visit!

The perfect AirBnB, very clean and tidy. You can tell it’s the culture of the home. I was in the house with the host and I think his family but the place is setup such that it feels like they are in a different apartment, it’s like having the best of both worlds; a home and a hotel all in one. I also liked the furnishings in my room, nice wood polished furniture and nice flooring. Fine bathroom, fine kitchen. As for the location it’s a good location as long as you can get to the city attractions without a fuss. I booked the AirBnB partly because of its proximity to the metro but I ended up not using the metro because of how cheap ride-sharing services are (when you pay between €1-€5 for a 3km ride to the city attractions, and pay just over €7 for a 16km ride to the airport, you really don’t care about the metro haha)
Great place to stay and a short walk to the river front and area of Ribeira and easy to commute to Sao Bento. very peaceful stay and would highly recommend.

Lovely flat and ideal location. The outdoor space was fantastic. The Home Me team quickly responded to us in all inquiries and gave helpful advice on Porto. Would recommend this place to anyone visiting this wonderful city.

Euclides’ apartment was exactly what we needed to explore the city and be walkable to most things we wanted to see.  Very clean, well furnished, and if this is as important to you as it is to my wife (the shower has crazy water pressure!).
Marcos was very friendly and we had a lovely time in their place. Short distance to great spots in Porto! Thanks for everything!

We really enjoyed our stay at Carla’s place in Porto. Carla and her family were very nice and helpful, and the room was super comfortable and with great views from the windows. The earplugs were a very nice touch and definitely helped get a good nights sleep, even with the seagulls :-)

I loved this little spot. Really cute view and very walkable. Only a 10 minute walk from the city center but far enough to get away from all the tourists and craziness after a long day of exploring. The apartment was extremely clean and had everything it needed. Felipe is very responsive and gives very clear instructions on how to enter the building. I'd definitely book this again :)

Location, location, location! This place is not only stylish, comfortable, spacious, and modern, this is centrally located and on the first floor with an elevator for your luggage! My two gal friends and I had plenty of space to do our hair, makeup, and lounge without incident lol. Oh, and the nespresso machine is such an added bonus. Thank you Fernando for hosting us!
A great little gem - perfect location, the view of the church from the apartment was a lovely surprise, and the host has excellent communication and attention to detail. Would definitely stay again.
Comfortable, well located in a busy area. Easy to stroll to the main sights, river front and other side. Pedro and Paula make it easy for you and with a couple of creature comforts too.
We had a great time in this apartment, close to the city centre and other amenities such as supermarket and metro.  A lovely spacious living space, very stylish and attractive.

The place is really roomy and beautiful! We enjoyed every minute of it.  The courtesy of the host to let us check in earlier was very appreciated.  Probably this place is the best you can find in Porto. We will certainly be back soon! Thank you so so much!

We loved the location and sea view of Richardo’s apartment. The location has plenty of restaurants, shopping, and activities. The apartment was as described and offered a nice space for me and my family with ample closet space and comfortable couch. I would stay there again. That said, we could hear the people the floor above us and the rooms did not have a fan. So if you want to close the windows for a quieter sleep the room became a little warm. Overall, I found the apartment offered us a great stay by the beach.

Very clean apartment, and high end. Embroidered linens, nice scents and soaps, truly boutique experience!  To top it all off, extremely accommodating with check in and check out, able to help with luggage storage! Beautiful outdoor terrace, lots of sunlight!  Location is excellent, close to Via Catarina shopping street! Highly recommend, and would stay here again in the future!

Fantastic apartment in a great location. Easy access to the beach and Porto, and if you have a car, easy access to the surrounding area. Joana and Valentim are excellent hosts who gave us a whole list of places to visit and restaurant recommendations.  Highly recommend the apartment and the hosts.

We really enjoyed our stay at the apartment. We were 2 friends travelling and the 2 bedrooms were both a good size. There was plenty of space in the living room kitchen area. The hosts were great. So quick to respond to any questions we had. Overall a great stay- I would happily stay here again.
maja is a very nice host, the place was very nice clean quite and close to the amenities .

The space was efficient and super clean. Location was perfect, quiet but still close to everything and in a nice active neighborhood. Christina was very communicative and quick in responding. I very much enjoyed my stay.
The appartment is absolutely beautiful!! We loved the rooftopview and the location is just perfect in the middle of the old town but without the noise. Highly recommended!

Please note, picking up keys from lockbox is NOT on property as incorrectly indicated in communication with Guest Ready, which was a very unwelcome surprise after a long travel day. Otherwise the place was clean and comfortable. The towels could use replacing as they’re very thin and worn and we were only provided one bath & hand towel each for a 5 night stay. The washer is also a dryer, which was a delightful surprise as we needed to do laundry. There is also a bonus office room in addition to the two bedrooms. The location could have been better but it was close to metro & Mercado (great vegetarian restaurant on 2nd floor ‘Casa Vegetariana’). Note that the walk to the apartment from the metro is up a steep hill but manageable for us with small carry on luggage. We enjoyed our stay in Porto.

Well appointed apartment with a wonderful host! Comfortable beds (special attention to pillows -they were wonderful). Good showers and hot water supplies. Close to shopping but a few blocks away allowed for quiet evenings. I highly recommend this listing- thanks again for a great stay!

Perfect Perfect Perfect. Pedro and his house made our travel more wonderful.  5 starts are not enough! I would like to give 10 stars haha ^^  This room was clean and offered everything we need.  Interior, decoration, and kitchen utility were amazing.  I already miss the morning coffee time in dining room.  Near to hot spot - Lello library, Sao Bento and nice cafe / restaurant that I looked for.  Pedro was frienly and helped for anything we need.  “Thank you so much, Pedro! ” Best, Jimin Lee

Had a wonderful stay at the flat! It’s in a great location, and the bed and pull out bed were very comfortable. The terrace was amazing. I will def. stay here again and recommend to any friend staying. Bernard was great, easy to get in touch with.
The bathroom gets a little bit of water on the floor regardless of how careful you are in the shower. Other than that, a very good place to stay.

Sofia's studio is a perfect home base for exploring Porto! The location is fantastic - we could walk to everything. We especially enjoyed sitting on the balcony, taking in the sights and sounds of Rua das Flores!  The studio is decorated beautifully and is very comfortable. You can't go wrong staying here!
The apartment was very nice and we had a lovely stay. Even though the water didn’t work in the beginning but it was fixed very fast. The communication with Nuno went smoothly.

Beautiful apartment overlooking the river. Teresa was great when checking in, giving great advice on local places to eat and things to see and do. The apartment is next to a church, and the bells are fairly noisy, but the apartment itself is well located and very well kept. I would heartily recommend.

LuÍs was a fantastic host - he provided several great local recommendations and his apartment was very nice. Located close enough to the tourist attractions but far enough where the neighborhood felt local and unique. I highly recommend staying here!

It is very central and located in the nice area. Easy to reach everywhere.  Room description fits to actual room condition. Very satisfied, except for the towels / Dishwasher. We stayed here for 5 days but they gave us only one towel. I asked to get more, but they didn’t reply :/
Comfortable, clean stylish and spacious in a perfect location to explore the city.  also a very good price too! thanks

Luís is a kind and attentive host who had many wonderful recommendations to help you feel like a local. The apartment is comfortable and thoughtfully decorated – it is clear how much time and care Luís has put into making sure guests enjoy their stay. The neighbourhood is fun and lively and with amenities within a short walking distance. Thank you for a lovely stay in Porto, Luís!
Thank you Carla for your welcoming. Our journey to Porto was awesome thank to you. Your apartment is very well located and near Rio Douro and Ponte Luis. I really recommend this place
Cozy studio at a really good spot, close to everything you need, Paula responded quickly and was very helpfull, would go again!

This apartment is very well located, peaceful, and cosy. With its terrace, you'll be surprised to be in the heart of Porto. Marcia is a nice host, that take care of her visitors and with whom the communication is fast and easy. I definitely recommend her! :)

The best Airbnb we’ve stayed in. Nuno and Anita were super friendly and had loads of great recommendations for us. They were very accommodating of our arrival and departure times. The flat is beautiful, furniture looks great and it has three wonderful terraces. We particularly loved the honesty bar with some of their favourite wines and beers. They even had Netflix and Prime! They really did think of everything. We will be back!
We had a wonderful stay in Porto! It was a very safe, clean, and well decorated apartment. Pedro was quick to respond to questions and offered his help for anything we needed.

We loved staying at the apartment! It was super clean/pleasant and very close to lots of cool stuff! As a wheelchair user, I especially appreciated the elevator access, however the ramp in the front was quite steep, so if you’re a wheelchair user, make sure to stay there with a buddy who can help push you up! Overall, awesome place, awesome location. Would definitely recommend staying there!
It was great stay, very clean flat, small but has everything needed for long or short stay  Would highly recommend!

This apartment is nice hotel style and has everything we needed. Neighborhood is quiet and very safe and it takes 15 min to get to metro station 24 Augusta if needed. Since most of our interests were in Historic part of Porto we  walk every day and sometimes used Uber to get back when we were returning to apartment late. Grocery stores in the neighborhood close earlier.  We loved it and would come back again.

The place is really beautiful. It's located next to São Bento station which is a really in the heart and center of Porto. If you are sensitive to noise take some earplugs with you as it can get quite loud especially on the weekends. You get kissed by the morning sun if you want to. It's a really beautiful minimalistic apartment where you find everything you need. I highly recommend this place!

Great location. There's a steep ladder to the upstairs bedroom so no good if you have mobility issues.  No TV either but lots of bars nearby all of whom have televisions. Good for exploring a really nice city.  Easy check in.

Perfect location to Stay in Porto, Apartment is everything as described,  even though we didn't get to meet the hosts communication was excellent and check in/out process was flawless. Would definitely recommend to everybody and stay here without hesitation! Muito obrigado!
We had an amazing time in Porto thanks to Nuno!  The apartment was spacious and the beds comfortable.  It was nice having an outdoor terrace.  A great find in a fabulous city.

Pedro and Paula are very warm and kind hosts. The place itself is located in the city centre, just a minute away from town hall and the metro station. It is clean, well equipped and quiet if you take the fact into account that you live directly in the city centre. They provide a small pamphlet with good tips for supermarkets, bars and restaurants. If I re-visit Porto (which I will) I will definitely take Pedro and Paulas place into consideration again. Total recommendation!

We had a nice stay at Pedro’s. The place itself looks just like the pictures. Perfect for 2 people. Clean, nicely decorated and comfortable. Walkable to all the sights around the city. He was very helpful and gave a lot of recommendations for Porto. Would recommend!

The location is perfect and the house too. Perhaps the wifi is a little slow, so keep it in mind if you’re working. But apart from that everything is good and there are tons of appliances if you need/want to cook
We had a great stay in Ruis apartment.  It is located very central, so everything is in walking distance. Great rooftop terrace :-)

Fantastic apartment in a great location. Everything we wanted was in walking distance, and the apartment was very quiet overnight. It’s well equipped and very comfortable. It more than met all our expectations, as did Porto overall. Will stay again if/when we come back.   Thanks for a great city break!
Elson was a great & responsive host. The apartment is very centrally located making it easy to walk everywhere.
An utterly fantastic location, right in the heart of the old town. A very charming apartment, spacious, clean and fully fitted for a very comfortable stay. Highly, highly recommend!

Great Location. Perfect place to roam around the city. Very hospitable host and very prompt  in replying our queries. Got excellent tips from Diogo. Check in and check out are so smooth. A big thumbs up
I can only recommend! Place was super clean very good equipped and communication was very nice with very useful info about location but also Porto in general.
We had a lovely stay at Luìs’ place, which was very cosy and warm. The balcony was very pleasant during the day and at night. 100% would recommend!
Looks exactly like the photos! Extremely clean space and the bath towels smelled amazing. Great location, too. I had a wonderful stay.

A beautiful piece of paradise in Northern Portugal. Ana and Lucia looked after us very well, nothing was too much trouble even getting a log delivery in a thunderstorm. Ana is a proactive host without being intrusive and is always on hand to help. Saberamar is set in a beautiful woodland, not easy to find and an interesting drive but Ana gave clear concise instructions. Those who like us enjoy being in the middle of nowhere will love this property and never want to leave.

Everything was perfect, the apartment is very comfortable and has everything you need.  Great towels and linens, comfortable bed.  Anna is a very hospitable owner, we were able to check in ahead of time and after the trip it was very helpful.  Thanks for the treats also, it was very nice. Would definitely like to come back.

I cannot imagine a better introduction to Porto. This studio was very easy to get to and only a short walk from the train station. The studio was quiet, comfortable and clean. Not only that, but it is centrally located which made it very easy to walk around the town and never be far from this "home away from home". We chose to do check in with one of the cohosts and I am so glad we did. Daniel was an absolute rock star and I cannot say enough good things about him. He gave us a breakdown of the city and put together an itinerary for our day right on the spot. It was amazing! Porto is an amazing place and when we come back, this studio is where we want to be.

We absolutely loved this apartment! So close to the River, and so many restaurants and things to do. Lively area, but the windows were great for soundproofing at night. We felt right at home…. Thank you Eugenia and Luis!

The place was in a perfect location for our stay in Porto. Communication was excellent and there were no problems with check in or anything else. The apartment itself had everything we needed and was in great condition. I would highly recommend it.
Very clean and airy apartment - inside the unit and the building as a whole. Maria was very responsive and kind to our needs. Would love to stay here again!

Lovely spacious apartment with two bathrooms. Good location. Host was very prompt with his response to issues that arose. We were able to drop our luggage whilst waiting for check in. Unfortunately noise from bar downstairs is loud at the weekend so families may find this a problem
The apartment was nice and  very clean and we had a nice time there. Can truly recommend trying it out if you go to Porto.
Very nice place and well located. The host was very helpful and left us a bottle of wine to enjoy during our stay. Very recomended
It's perfect. Comfortable house , cozy bedroom It was nice because the house was warm. Everything was perfect If we come back to Porto, we will stay here again.

The place was very clean, modern, had everything we needed to feel at home, and was an easy walk to all the sites we wanted to see Also steps to dozens of restaurants and cafes. Communication was great too. Felt right at home. We would highly recommend this wonderful apartment.

We loved this apartment. It was relight beside the time out food market and in such a good location. The balcony was enjoyable to sit outside in the mornings. The bed was really comfy and we liked the air conditioning.

We enjoyed our stay in Porto:) very clean and comfortable apt on 6 th floor ..elevator right by entrance. Bathroom with nice rain head shower. Easy pick up for Ubers. Nice pastry shop just few doors down. City sight seeing hop on bus pick up area conveniently  located right down street. Thank you Daniel for the bottle of Vino Verde and cookies:)
This was a great place to stay! Great location and clean and well maintained .  The loft bedroom is fun (but watch your head!)!

We had a really nice stay at the apartment. The place is perfectly located in the city, was clean, tidy and most important, looks exactly like the pictures promised. Although we arrived late at 11.30 pm, Sharron the owner gave us a really warm welcome. To be recommend without any hesitations.  Friedrich Braumann

Great location in Bonfim neighbourhood. Some really good restaurants and cafes/bakery nearby. 10-15 min walk to historical centre. Perfectly clean and looks just like the photos. Claudia’s place is in an apartment complex of airbnb apartments (which is quite common in Lisbon it seems) and professionally managed. Co-host Ana was proactive with instructions etc and always very responsive to any queries. Thank you Claudia and Ana for a great stay.
We had a great stay. The apartement was very clean and has everything you need. It is located in a residential area though that looks a bit deprived.  It takes about 30 minutes to walk to the city.

The hosts were very helpful and communicative. The flat suited my needs perfectly and I had a comfortable and enjoyable two weeks in Porto! The location was ideal for getting about the city, and the flat was clean, cozy and felt secure. Thanks to Ana and Mateus!

we had a fab stay in this appartment! just the right size for me and my mum mum. Absolulety superb location. Just round the corner from fab restaurants and from the river front. And about 10 mins walk to the train station. Highly recommended!

We absolutely loved our stay! Diogo was fantastic, he had so many recommendations. He was happy for us to message him at any time asking for help or suggestions. And he was always quick to reply. Honestly could not recommend them enough! Loved this stay!

Beautiful Villa, so spacious, well kept and great facilities! Hugo was very responsive and nothing was too much trouble. Had an amazing stay here as a group of 10. Ubers are easy to get into Porto city centre. You will need a hire car in order to get to a big supermarket.
My 3 friends and I stayed at this airbnb and loved it! Location is very central to anywhere you’d want to go in Porto!

we had a lovely stay at the apartment! we had to prolong our stay, and the host was super responsive we even managed to stay there for extra days.  the apartment is clean and welcoming, with a comfy bed. Thank you very much !

What a lovely place! The location is great, it offers everything you need and was sparkling clean. The loads of tourist information provided was also nice!  The best part about the apartment for us was coming home after a long, hot day and feeling the coolness of the apartment. We stayed here during a few extra hot days and this was great!  We did not meet Rute in person but kept in contact through WhatsApp and chats, she was very helpful and quick to respond. Would absolutely go back here again!
Everything was good, easy to check in, the host let us check in earlier which was appreciated . Easy check out.
We had a very good stay. The apartment was in the middle of the city center which was very nice. We’d definitely book again.
Very nice apartment. Only problem for senior adults are the four floors to climb. The rest is perfect.

Beautiful and stylish place in the heart of famous Ribeira - can’t ask for more central location. Margarida’s place is very thoughtfully set out and we felt very welcome and at ease in her beautiful apartment. Very recommended!
Best value in Porto. The spot was so cool - you felt like a local.  Maria was very responsive.  Highly recommended!

Nuno and Anita could not be better hosts. The apartment is lovely, clean, and beautifully fitted with lovely furniture and fittings. Everything you could need and more was in the apartment. The apartment block was situated near everything but far enough away to be quiet and restful, which is important after a busy day sightseeing.

We really enjoyed our stay at Miquel E Rita’s apartment. It was so easy to hop on a bus or walk to surrounding sights to see. Miquel met us on arrival and gave us some great advice on sights to see and places to eat and on how to get there. Whenever we needed any advice we just needed to send a message and always got an immediate reply.

The place itself is nice, looks great. Amenities are OK, however some things could use a little eye for detail. The smell is noticable, in case of breathing conditions one should reconsider booking. Overall nice, but the humid air was bothering.

Staff were really welcoming and friendly. Uporto House is definitely a great experience and I’d recommend.  It’s not the closest location from the center but there’s bus stops and subway stations. Besides that, it is a little noisy but nothing disturbing. I really enjoyed my stay. Place is big, very clean (there’s staff to clean weekly) - some people do not respect cleaning rules but that’s on their own, I don’t blame Uporto House for that - overall great experience. I would come back. Thank you.
Nice apartment with very nice location. The communication with the host was very great as well. Thank you!
Ana is a great host, of a great and clean apartment near the city center of porto. you can walk to the most POI's in a few minutes. we would highly recommend a stay in this apartment!

This is a stellar place to stay when visiting Porto or the surrounding areas. It has fantastic views and wonderful location to the waterfront. The host was very communicative and accomplished. Would highly recommend for 2 people to stay.

Couldn’t have asked for a better location!The bathroom was slightly dated and had a bit of a moldy smell but not unexpected considering the older building. Host were so accommodating and even set out a crib for our toddler. Great stay!

Marco's apartment is very well located in Porto, close to all amenities, very clean and well equipped. We were greeted by Marco's wife, were very attentive hosts and available either before or during our stay. I recommend this apartment.
Very nice place, and also very nice hosts. The location and the site was amazing. Totally recommended

The communication with the host was good and they left some snacks and several towels for us in the room which was nice. The house was really beautiful and clean and there are a balcony and a terrace where you can sit down and eat. But the beds were not really comfortable and our room was darker and smaller than we expected. Our room was right next to the common bathroom so we woke up several times in the morning because people were shutting the door really loudly. The area is a bit remote but quiet during the night. All in all, it was a good accomodation for our short trip.
maria is a very kind landlady, had a late evening arrival and checkin was no problem. overall well equipped, clean apartment with top location

We loved our stay at Ines place. It was sparkly clean and spacious. Her father gave us a detailed explanation of the neighborhood and what to expect. They even left us a big wheel of cheese and local wine, which we devoured with glee. Next time I'm in Porto, I will definitely stay here.
Great location.  The flat was very comfortable, charming and welcoming.  Great for a solo traveller or a couple.

What a wonderful way to begin our vacation in Portugal! After making our reservation, Sonia was a very responsive host, answering questions and providing recommendations for our trip. Upon arrival, Sonia met us at the door and showed us around her beautiful space. She also spent some time sharing places to go as well as places to eat. So helpful! The house is so clean and very well appointed with everything needed during our stay. We had a large group of 8 of us and we had all the space we needed. The garden area and pool was a lovely place to relax at the end of the day with a glass of port or a beer or in the morning with some espresso. The house centrally located to local transit but is also just as easy to walk places or pick up a Bolt. We all wish we would have spent more time in Porto at Sonia's home.  Sonia is a wonderful host who truly felt like family and made us feel right at home in Porto.

Good apartment. Clean and comfortable. Some traffic noise from street (tolerable) and no blinds. Check in process required getting the key in an hostel, far from the apartment (15min). But the experience was positive!

Ana’s apartment is exactly as described: clean, placed in a central location and with a lot of natural light. Ana was very responsive to our requests while all communication was very effective and straightforward. We travelled by car and we could conveniently and safely park our car in front of the apartment, at no cost. We highly recommend Ana’s apartment.

Fantastic location very near many of Porto’s attractions, restaurants and shopping. The apartment is actually more spacious than the photos appear. Spotlessly clean. Nice linens and comfortable beds. The street is a busy one, but quieted down after midnight. Lovely place, would stay again for sure.
Very nice Airbnb. Excellent position in the city. Everything we needed was there and easily found  great attention to detail

Spacious apartment in a very good location, includes parking inside the building as well which was amazing. Daniel was very proactive with making sure you have a smooth check in and comfortable stay. Just note the apartment does not have very good sound insulation, so it's a bit noisy at night/early in the morning.
Antonio was very kind and helpful and gave us good suggestions. Apartment is very good, perfectly located, recommended.

Pedro was a great host.  Very helpful and responds quickly to messages. Had lots of tips and advice about transportation to and from the air bnb. Location was great and within walking distance to downtown Porto. Place was very clean.
Nice flat, not that easy to find the door, clean and comfortable when inside. We'd repeat!

What an amazing way to start our journey! This place has everything you need! Walking distance to city sights, perfect location, parking available, well decorated, sparkling clean, well equipped, beautiful balcony, great view and Neil has been the best host, always responsive, friendly, accessible and he also wait for is to show the parking lot since we had a rented car. One of our bast stays so far! Definitely recommended!!!

Dino and Ines' apartment was perfect for our long weekend in Porto - very stylishly done up, spotless, and they've thought of all the amenities you could need. The kitchen is very well equipped, all the appliances are modern and they've used the space really cleverly. They were incredibly welcoming hosts and were always easy to contact when we had questions, they also offered us loads of tips about where to visit and what to do in the city.
The place was exactly as expected; centric, clean, cozy and with charm. I stayed for two days and the location was just perfect!

Hugo was an excellent host and the apartment was perfect for our stay. Hugo picked us up at the metro station (even though we were an hour late!) and also provided maps and other travel information. The apartment is furnished with modern furniture and appliances and was very comfortable.   A great host.

We were a group of 3 females visiting the city, the apartment was in such a fantastic location. It’s just outside the hustle and bustle but so accessible to so many great bars and restaurants. There is a supermarket nearby for breakfast items. The air con was much appreciated on the hotter days. We were so happy with our stay.

This apartment is in a central square of Porto. It is at the top of the historic center making it easy - albeit hilly - walk into the town to see the sights and the waterfront. There is some renovation of a building shell that made it noisy but only during day hours when mostly we were away from the apartment. There was a small grocery store next door. The apartment was clean and comfortable for my family of two adults and two teenagers.  Alexandra the host was at the door waiting for us when I rang the bell and assisted us in entering the garage with our car. She was very warm and friendly and took the time to show us the apartment and describe the city, the main sights, and places to eat. She was a good host. There is an elevator up to the apartment.

João and Susanna are very nice people, easy to be with and arrange things. Everything was working in the house. The beds are good quality for a relaxing night of deep sleep. Toilettes and the shower are spacious and top notch condition. It's a great neighbourhood. If you don't want to cook in the well equipped kitchen of the house, there are plenty of nice restaurants with fresh fish around. A lot of parking places for free makes it easy if you arrive by car. The walk to the city centre is beautiful and not too long. And if you want to go towards north-east coast there is a boat every 30 minutes right around the corner.
Apartment on 7th floor was clean, secure and basically a great space to stay in Porto

We enjoyed our stay at Miguel’s apartment. Comfortable beds. Great kitchen amenities. Proximity to Jardim do Morro is an asset—we enjoyed a Sunday afternoon there watching the sun set with great music and vibrant social scene. We parked our rental car nearby easily. Easy and prompt communication with our host.
As described in the description, my only concern was the back door did not have a lock and was continuously open.

Nice place - clean & comfortable bed with A/C. Easy to find and do self check in. Host was responsive on messages. Good value for money. They even left a little chocolate on pillows and some bottles of water. 5 stars.

I stayed Sousa’s place over a week and enjoyed it very much. The place is clean and neat with all amenities needed. The location is good within walking distance to main attractions. Sousa is always friendly and very responsive. Highly recommended Sousa’s place!!

We had a great stay here. Esmael was quick to respond and very friendly and flexible about meeting us when we were late arriving. The apartment is in a lovely street and easily walkable to the old town. The apartment had everything we needed for a 4 night stay and was very comfortable.

Great place for a stay in Porto, away from the super-heavy tourist area (which is only a 5 minute walk). Super location, modern suite, very clean. The patio gets full sun during the day, and it gets quite hot during summer-type weather (the unit itself has excellent air conditioning as well as motorized blinds in each room) but if you expect to spend a lot of time on the patio, you probably won't, unless it's early morning or evening. Super-convenient grocery shopping, excellent restaurants. Would definitely stay again.

I loved Sofia’s place so much that I kept recommending it to anyone I see in front of me for the rest of my trip!!! Beautiful, clean, cozy but most importantly safe studio and location. Sofia and Fatima were VERY responsive and very sweet and helpful and it came to any questions I had. I will definitely be back again!!

This is a well appointed flat in the heart of downtown. The hosts are some of the best I've encountered and will give you great information. Nothing is too much trouble. I had no issue with noise either from the rest of the building or the street and the little extras: wine, nespresso machine and smart TV with Netflix etc made it a more homely experience than you're likely to get in a hotel. Recommended.

Carla's apartment is the best-ever apartment I've stayed from airbnb in the past years. It's truly in the very center of the old town of Porto, with the view of São Bento train station from the bedroom's balcony 200 meters away. Almost every sightseeing place is walkable - taking a stroll in Porto is very pleasant, no matter what the weather is. Carla is very responsive and helpful - she provides very detailed travel info for guests with maps, restaurants and bars recommendation and sights nearby. The apartment itself is quite modern and in simplicity style which is just where my taste falls. It has three sides of windows, which means you can have an almost panoramic view.  Put all in a nutshell, the four-day stay at Carla's apt is simply perfect.
Nice and walkable place to stay near Ribeira. Extra points for the great bed & breakfast :)

Fabulous stay in Matosinhos. The flat was ideal for us and three teenagers - spacious, very close to the beach and some fantastic fish restaurants, and for the bus or tram into Porto. Ana was a great host with good recommendations for places to eat.
Loved my stay here. Centrally located, and a clean, air conditioned apartment. Would definitely stay again.

Outstanding location! An easy walk to everything. The place is clean, organized, and stocked, and I loved the decor. Cool House was easy to communicate with and friendly. It was smaller than expected with very little floor space around the beds and no doors on bedrooms but overall a good value. We enjoyed our two night stay.

We had a lovely 2 night stay at Marta's airbnb. Well located apartment with parking always available just outside. Kitchen is a bit small but has everything you need for a short stay. Marta was very nice and always responsive. Would recommend!
Susana’s flat was fantastic in every way. Perfect location. Gorgeous unit.  Expansive private deck. Quiet. So many amenities. Looking forward to coming back soon!

We had a wonderful stay at this property! Check in was very easy and communication was great. The property itself was decorated very well and was very clean! It was in a great location and would definitely recommend it to anyone thinking of visiting Porto!
The host is very friendly and kind, the location is good behind the sea.. really raccomended!!
Tina is great lady and the place is perfect for trips both on the beach and to the centre. Porto is beautifull even in bad weather and I warmly recommend you to see it.

YourOPO is an extremely professional host in both service and the appartement standard! Only reason for not granting 5 stars is the outside noice. There is a new underground metro line being build in front if the building and it will probably take a few more months (summer 2023) to finish. Nonetheless I recommend the place.

We enjoyed the apartment very much! It is great for a group of four people to hang out. We especially enjoyed the view towards the river Douro from the big windows in living room. The city is easy to reach with a 5 - 10 minutes food walk. In the morning we used the two little café shops right and left just one building away to start our day with a galao coffee and a pasteis de nata.

Beautiful place with good atmosphere, nice to have breakfast outside, close to the beach, nice bike rides to Porto and most of all: great hosts! Thank you Bernardo, it was wonderful. We hope to come back one day.

This place was fantastic. It is beautifully remodeled. Beds are comfortable, bathrooms are clean, AC works well, and kitchen is beautiful. It is also located next to a lot of hip restaurants and hang out spots. Loved it here and would definitely stay here again. Claudia was also very responsive and available for any needs that came up.
Really nice flat in the old city centre of  Porto. The location is perfect to visit the city, although really noisy. Sebastian and the Lovely Stay team were nice and available.
Great apartment and location. Oporto is a great place to visit, if you can cope with the hills! The old town is fantastic and the riverside well worth a visit
We had a great stay at Jorge’s place. Spacious apartment in a central location. A little loud at night time but otherwise excellent. Highly recommend!
Beautiful place in a beautiful city:) Dinner and breakfast on the balcony will make your stay in Porto perfect.  And the communication is awesome which is always a gift when travelling.
A very neat and organized apartment. Very close to the mall, which all that was needed throughout the stay.

Great apartment very close to public transit and the Bolhão market. Parking was a little tough, we had to back in from a busy road, but thanks to the location we only had to do that once since we were able to walk everywhere!
Sonia was a great host, nothing was too much trouble and gave great advice so that we could enjoy Porto to the full.
Very pleasant accommodation in a quiet location near the historic center of Porto, I highly recommend. Zuzana

Marco’s place was perfect for us - a 10 minute walk to the station and a 5 minute walk down to the riverfront and the centre of the Old Town.  Carla was kind enough to let us drop off our luggage a little earlier than their 3pm check-in time, which was very helpful as it allowed us time to explore the city.  Carla’s communication was excellent and she always responded quickly to my enquiries.  Recommended.

We had a lovely stay at Paula’s. It was clean and looked just like the photos. Paula was excellent at responding to our enquiries.  The house is located right on the beach and is within walking distance to some lovely local restaurants and beach bars.  We even found a great Indian restaurant on the last night. We will definitely be back.
Pedro's place is perfect for your stay in Porto. Very well located near the bridge and with a beautifull terrace. He gave us some good recommendations and it was very easy to communicatie with him!
This apartment is in a great location in Porto a close walk to The Douro river.  It’s close to restaurants, bars, shops just below the apartment.  The bed and air conditioning were excellent.

We really enjoyed our stay at this flat! It was very well equipped with everything we could have needed, the bed was comfortable, and the location couldn’t get any better! It’s right next to loads of cafes and restaurants, and walking distance to anything else you might want to check out :) Rui gave us a warm and friendly welcome, along with some excellent tips of places to go. I highly recommend staying here :)
Amazing view of Porto and in a great location. Spacious apartment with  three bathrooms however we faced issues with the plumbing but host was responsive. Would recommend!

Very clean and comfortable home. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The hosts were very warm and hospitable. Thank you Ana & Jorge. Your recommendations for visiting Porto were superb. Cafe Cila next to the house provided a wholesome breakfast. Bus 906 takes you directly to Porto - lovely night life. We will definitely recommend to our friends

lovely flat, clean and well equipped. walking distance to key sightseeing. It was very good for us (family with two children aged 5 and 3). Ruis and collaborators were helpful and communicated well. Recommended stay.

Great little spot in the heart of Porto, easily walkable to everything we wanted to do. Lots of restaurants right at your doorstep. There was even pasteis de nata and a glass of port waiting for us when we arrived.  Thanks Margarida!
Artur made us feel very welcome and gave us a lot of helpful information. Thank you. The apartment was ideally situated and had a pleasant outlook.

Joao and Andreia's place was a wonderful and cozy home away from home. Their beautiful apartment exceeded all of our expectations with beautiful furniture and decor and very comfortable beds. They even left us a delicious bottle of port and yummy fruits. We stayed with our 3 yr old and 4 month old daughter and it was perfect family hideaway for us as it was so nice and quiet but central to all the great sights. We had a wonderful time and would highly recommend staying here. Muito obrigado!

A brilliant accommodation, very cosy and great access to the Swimming pool and Gym. Close to local amenities. Will be back when the football season recommences  as Estádio do Dragão is seen from the swimming pool.
We had a really nice stay in this accommodation. The Apartment is really comfortable. Have had some problems with the power, but it was solved at once.  Would stay there again.
Marion was perfect to deal with and the private room was great. Nice room and very central. We loved it. Highly recommend  :)

Our stay in Porto was great from every aspect. From the moment we booked the reservation and received great and timely information about our upcoming stay; to having a very courteous driver meet us at the airport and remove any concerns about finding the location; to the warm welcome and introduction we received from Pedro - who provided us further local guidance about where to eat, and what to do. The location was superb; close enough to the action (walking distance), but far enough from the busier tourist section of Porto. The accommodations, were modern, bright, cozy, well appointed, and very clean. The outside deck was a great place to spend a quiet evening, with a nice bottle of wine. Ruis recommended a Port house, and of the 5 we visited the one Ruis recommended was the best - Real Compania (great find). Pedro organized our transportation back to the airport - with a pickup at 3:30AM - We appreciated the early morning pickup!!

The place is a really nice decorated and cosy house, we loved it very much. Porto is at walking distance and you can park the car in the street for free. We would certainly recommend this place if you want to visit the city with your kids and love to stay at a quiet place nearby the city center.

Porto’s place is in a great location for exploring the historical  City with plenty of restaurants, cafes bars nearby. The accommodation is secure and comfortable with a rooftop pool which is great at the end of a busy day

Great experience and location. Spacious and new apartment good for 2 or 3 people. Great cleaning service and communication/ information from the host. As a note I would suggest it mainly for young and active people for the absence of elevator and presence of stairs in the flat.

My family group of five enjoyed staying at this property. There was plenty of room for everyone. The detailing of the apartment was amazing. High ceilings and understated decor with loads of unique character. The location is 1 block from the metro and very central with loads of great restaurants and shopping right around the corner. This was a fantastic place to stay in a incredible city. I would recommend staying here to anyone without hesitation.

First time in Portugal and we couldn’t have hoped for better hosts. Wow the kindness and support from Dino & Ines was unmatched! They kept in contact with us well before and after our stay. And the apartment was probably the nicest home we ever did have the pleasure of staying in. The space was just right, clean, cosy and very comfortable. Every amenity you could possibly need and want was available in the apartment. Thank you again for your warm welcome, next time we come to Porto we hope we have the opportunity to stay with you again. David & Phoebe
An excellent apartment in a very convenient location. The manual for operating things in the flat was very useful. Providing some coffee and tea bags etc was a very nice touch.
Carla was a pleasure to deal with. My room was beautiful and very clean. The location was perfect and looking forward to coming back.

Carla’s place was really lovely! It was an excellent location and a short walk to the main areas where we wanted to go. We loved the authentic neighborhood. There is a church right across the street and the bells do ring, which we enjoyed. This is one of our favourite airbnb experiences that we have had in our travels! Highly recommend!
Great place to stay in the city centre of Porto! Very spacious, modern and cosy room design, clean; everything you need is provided by Era. I highly recommend this loft!
We had a wonderful stay at Mariana‘s apartment. It‘s well located and equipped and tastefully furnished. Mariana is a kind and helpful host. One of the best airbnbs we‘ve been so far.

Tina was such a great host. She welcomed me right from my arrival and gave me a list of recommendations for Porto. The room was clean, the view was incredible, and the overall stay was very comfortable. I highly recommend staying with Tina.
We were here only for three days. Host is very kind. Apartment is well equipped and very clean. We got all promised and the space is exactly what is in the photos.

everything was perfect, the location is great and Carla was so polite and friendly through messages. We checked in remotely and check out also. Porto was very beautiful and we will sure come again. Thank you Carla.
One of the best airbnb experiences I’ve had. Check-in was seamless. Clean and comfortable apartment. Location is unbeatable. 10/10
Nuno was super helpful and very friendly and welcoming! Had an awesome time in Porto and would definitely recommend his place to anyone who wants to stay in Porto! :)
