awesome! the Lady is really nice and helps with all the questions one can have. she pickend us up from the airport for free. it‘s also possible to Walk to the Airport (20min) and the Metro  Is very close to Drive to the Beach.

Cristina's  home was one of the best places we've ever stayed in. It was spotlessly clean, comfortable and very spacious.  It was a few minutes walk to the beach, bus stop and tram to Porto. It was close to all amenities e.g. shops restaraunts, pharmacy and cafes. Cristina was an excellent host and responded quickly to all our queries.  She organised an Uber to and from the airport and as we were flying out very late, she allowed us to use the accommodation on the day of our flight. She was extremely helpful and kind and we are very grateful to  her. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would love to go back to Cozy Home. Thank you Cristina.

We loved this apartment, spacious, modern, light and close to everything yet quiet and secluded. We were met by George who was very helpful with a map and tips on what to visit, restaurants, coffee etc.  many thanks, we absolutely loved Porto and if back will definately stay here again

We enjoyed very much our stay in Porto and in Helena's flat. Eduardo expected us at arrival, the flat is very well situated and clean. Although in the center, with the windows closed the sleeping room was calm and we slept well. Everything is like described. We can recommend the flat to everyone, especially if u look for a place from where u can explore the beautiful city by foot. Thank you!
Fantastic apartment for a group. Very rare to find a 5 double bedroom 4 bathroom place, very comfortable for a group. We all had a bit of privacy and plenty of space.
Thanks lovely stay! It would have been nice if they communicated some lock related issues on beforehand, but all in all great stay!
Nicely located apartment, with all amenities and a supermarket not far (convenient!). Within walking distance from most touristy spots.  Hosts are very responsive! Overall a good experience in Porto
Tomas was great!  Loved Porto and the apartment There is construction of the new metro right down the street - which takes the magic out of the location
This is a nice place to stay and spacious. The balcony is great in the afternoon because you can enjoy the sun! Supermarkets are near and a nice walk to the center.

We loved staying & visiting in Porto. The location was great- right in the old town with all the cobblestone streets. Lots of cafes tucked in the back streets. We walked all over & was very close to the Guggenheim. The apartment was a great mix of old and modern.
The flat was perfect in a great location. The host made us feel very welcome and even left snacks and drink for arrival! Lovely convenient and clean flat. Would highly recommend.

We had a really nice stay at Casa Maya, everything was clean and tidy and the owners were very friendly. The apartment had everything we needed, we got a really good recommendation for a breakfast spot close by.  We would happily recommend to stay here for anyone. :)

Joaquim’s  apartment is one of the best place we spent our vacation. The apartment is perfect location, extremely comfortable, beautiful design. You have whatever you need in his place. You feel unique atmosphere in the apartment. He is responsibly, friendly. You can find the place easily and close to attractive and famous place in Porto. I recommend at you spent your holiday in Joaquim’s apartment when you come to Porto.
Perfect apartment located near the river in beautiful Porto! Check in and check out were easy and our group enjoyed our stay. Walking distance to historic Porto and the river.
We had a lovely stay at Porto White. The location is good and the hosts are great!
Great place, but a little bit noisy at night. Host was friendly, gave us a map of the city and gave recommendations with sightseeings

We had a wonderful time! Sofia is really kind and helpful and responds very fast to messages. The apartment was clean and nice and well located. Supermarkets are nearby as well as nice restaurants and bars. Big recommendation!
The location of the house was very good. However, it faces the back street, and since it is very close to the building across, we didn’t feel completely comfortable. Overall, it met our needs.

We had an amazing and comfortable stay here! Bruno is so nice and gave us so many useful recommendations.  The apartment is very well located and close to a lot of tourist attractions. Definitely recommended!

We were surprised because the place was a lot larger than what we saw in the pictures! It has a perfect location and we had all the amenities we needed. I am happy that we chose this place for our stay in Porto!
Truly an oasis in the heart of Porto. I highly recommend this stay for anyone looking to recharge in comfort.

It was our first time in Porto. The location of the apartment is really good, easy to get there with metro, bus or simply walk 10 minutes to the train station. There are a lot of possibilities for shopping, nice restaurants and all the tourist spots are close. The apartment is great, and has everything one needs for a tourist staying, we could cook, sleep well, and even use Nerflix... I would recommend the place!

In the listing it says there is street parking, but there are only a few spaces available. Beware two of the spaces are unclearly marked as privately owned spots! Our car was towed from one of these spots and impounded, costing us 200 euros plus the hassle of a 1/2 day to recover. Many of the cars park on the sidewalk area but the police told us that was illegal also.
Very nice place to stay in Porto! We loved the fact there was a washing machine for our clothes since we were traveling long term.

Take note of the many, steep stairs if you have a large suitcase - quite the struggle. The parking garage is in the building and is a tight squeeze but much appreciated in this bustling city. The apartment is cute, if spartan. Location is good - lots of rigorous walking up and down hills. No extras so be prepared to go out for coffee, etc (which you'll want to do anyway!)

The apartment is situated brilliantly near Trindade metro station with great links to the train stations and airport. Comfortable walking distance to the centre and all the sites. Apartment is so clean and modern with a wonderful terrace to enjoy breakfast in the morning! Very comfortable, would definitely stay again.
Well equipped and so centrally located!  Easy walking to all the sites. Apartment is just as described, we enjoyed our stay.
Ana Paula’s house is in a great location close to the beach and local food shops. The apartment was better then expected from the photos. We really enjoyed our stay.
We had a great time in Porto and this was a lovely apartment.  I would highly recommend to anyone visiting Porto.
Great location with easy walk to the beachside restaurants, also well-connected with the city of Porto. We enjoyed the space. Lovely garden and pool
Great location. Really nice apartment. A little bit noisy outside as you can expect in the city center
Such a lovely place! Would stay there again! Great communication and very easy. Everything was very clean.
Great location, exactly as published, very clean and well maintained.  Be sure you are fit…third floor with no lift, but that was fine for us.  We really enjoyed our stay.

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would stay again. Unit is spotless and I am picky!  I wanted a location where I could walk to anything and this was perfect. Train station around the corner, river area very close. So much to see and do.  They always responded quickly and had suggestions for tours.  First time to Porto and it was an amazing experience. Thank you very much!
we had a wonderful stay at Adriana's place. Everyday there is something new and peculiar to find in the house. I would always recommend it.

Nice apartment in the center of Porto. The spaces may not be as wide as you expect from the photos if you are in more than 5 people, but still enough to enjoy the stay and all the comfort you need for an holiday in Porto.
The apartment was lovely, clean, and comfortable. Super easy to find and get inside, great location with a great local bakery right around the corner.  Would gladly stay here again.

Wow, found a gem in Porto:)  Lovely apartment walking distance to restaurants, tours, shopping, metro and train station:). Luis was so friendly and made me feel welcome from the moment I arrived.  I couldn’t of asked for anymore.   Obrigada again Luis for a fabulous stay in Porto:)

The apartment is beautifully decorated and set in a very charming building. The balcony overlooking the garden offers a lovely view and a peaceful spot to relax. The neighbourhood is quiet and perfect for a restful stay and plenty of great restaurants nearby and easy access to central Porto. We especially appreciated the shutters, which could be closed at night to make the room completely dark—ideal for a good night's sleep. Overall, our experience was excellent. Joao was incredibly helpful and always quick to respond.

Ana Cristina's place was perfect for our visit to Porto! The apartment is in an amazing location right on one of the main pedestrian streets, and is close to all of the sights we were hoping to see. The apartment itself was also very spacious and had everything we needed for our stay. The highlight was the balcony overlooking the lively street below where there was often live music being played (a double set of doors made the apartment absolutely silent at night though, which gave us the best of both worlds). The hosts were super helpful during check-in, provided a number of recommendations, and were quick to reply when we had questions. Would absolutely recommend staying here if you're planning to visit the city, and hopefully may be back ourselves!
A lovely room with complete privacy and in an amazing location . The hosts were always there when needed and were very kind . Would definitely recommend this place . Thank you for the lovely stay
Lovely apartment with character Fabulous location  Comfy bed with loads of storage

Super apartment great location Metro close by. Super market short walk away. Fabulous view. Very quiet at night. Everything as advertised or better .  Take advantage of the transfer service from airport or train station. We would definitely stay here again.

The mattress and pillows were so stiff that my neck and back hurt for 8 out of 10 days that I stayed there. When I asked for softer pillows, I received pillows with almost no stuffing and they were entirely flat. Some nights I even had difficulty sleeping. I asked for a third roll toilet paper and ran out by the 8th day. I was told to buy my own toilet paper.  The water pressure of the shower wasn't very strong, and I had to take longer showers as a result of this. My recommendation: give your guests what they need (such as an extra roll of toilet paper), check the plumbing and faucets for the water pressure, and please get more comfortable pillows and a mattress. I have a difficult time recommending this room if you have specific comforts. But it is near the bridge and the city centre.

If you want to time in Porto make more comfortable and nicer then this apartment is the right choice. The four of us stayed for 3 days and we had a phenomenal time.Apartmant is in the center of the city, 5 to 10 minutes from everything you wanted to visite. Excellent atmosphere, comfortable and quiet and the host is always there for any assistance for you. we enjoyed so much,and we hope that we will be back very soon.Thanks and enjoy Porto Goran

The Airbnb was amazing (location is as good as it could be), however Florinda really was the best of hosts and made the whole trip that much more enjoyable. Her recommendations were spot on. We are staying in Portugal for a while and we even changed our plans so we could come back and stay here again before leaving for the US. Could not recommend more!

Great apartment in great location. Loved the little balcony which is a sun trap in the morning. Everything we needed for our stay in Porto. Great restaurant recommendations from the host which we managed to visit a couple.

We had an incredible stay at Irene’s! It was the perfect location to explore Porto - walkable from major sights and restaurants. The apartment itself was exactly as the pictures depicted - very clean, tasteful and accommodating. Others have mentioned noise at night and from construction- we were not bothered at all by either (ear plugs were offered). We would definitely stay here again!

We found João to be one of the best - very quick to respond and help, he's in Porto, so you are dealing with him, not an agent. The location is perfectly placed on the steep hill of Porto, being a short wander down to the river, and not to far into the town - you'd get a better view from the window on the river front, but we've been there before, and were happier having a shorter walk up the hill, whilst still being in a great location. Can't speak highly enough of Porto, we'll be back.

Telmo was extremely friendly and was flexible with check in. The apartment was very clean and close to city centre. The apartment was on a busy street so there was noise at night, otherwise was a great stay. Thank you Telmo!

Wonderful few days in Porto.  Really great location close to everything but quiet enough to get some sleep.  The apartment is brand new and super clean. And we benefited from an early check in which was very much appreciated 👏.
Clean, centrally located location across from the beautiful train station.  Felipe was a great host, and provided local knowledge and quick responses answering all questions.

Maria is an amazing host. Since we came, I felt like I am at home.. The house was super clean and tidy, there were snacks and even Portuguese wine she bought for us!  House is in a good location and has parking space in front of the apartment. Highly recommend this place!
Our family is very grateful for the rest and the impressions! The facilities are comfortable, pleasant, and very conveniently located! The view is stunning!
The whole team of hosts were great and accomodating. Smooth check-in. Everything was easy. Great view. Excellent workspace, as we had to do some work calls. We would stay here again.
Thank you for welcoming us and letting us visit this amazing town ! We had a wonderful stay in Porto ! The apartment was comfy and pretty easy to find. We're already looking forward to come back !
Great team with prompt communication. Even on New Year’s Day, there was someone to text for a minor issue we were having.

Apartment is well located, invaded by a beautiful morning light through its large windows and has good amenities including washing machine. Supermarkets and cafes are at a short walking distance. In 15 to 20 min walking one is in the main St Catarina area.

This lovely 2 bedroom garden apartment is located near the Praça Republica in Porto about 10-15 minutes walk to bars and restaurants of the downtown area The apartment is large well equipped and both bedrooms are a good size with excellent bathrooms  Parking is provided for one car, although we had some issues with a car wrongly parked still managed to squeeze in next to it! Would definitely recommend this apartment

Nicely updated space and very centrally  located. The host’s office is in the same building as the unit which proved to be convenient as questions arose: they went above and beyond to respond, take action and ensure our stay was great. Impressed by the level of service offered.
Highly recommend staying here! This is a lovely, stylish and clean apartment. Pedro is also an excellent host and he made us feel very welcome in Porto. Thank you.

The place was on a quiet street yet central, only a stone’s throw to the Clerigos Tower. Lots of shops and restaurants nearby. They provided local recommendations and were very responsive to our queries. Space was clean. Would appreciate if they provided shower gel/ shampoo. Overall, very pleasant stay.

The best Airbnb I’ve ever been to!! Very clean, equipped with everything you need and more, comfortable bed, designed, very central location, but yet a very quiet place, easy check in and out. Telmo was an amazing host that was available all the time and answered all our tough questions ;) Highly recommended!!!
Worth the money. Ideal location. Perfect distance from anything worth seeing in porto. Looked like pictures advertised.
The accommodation and hosts were great.  There are a lot of stairs. Probably not for the elderly or unfit.

Beautiful apartment that looks just like the pictures, lots of space and was very clean. they also provided a bottle of wine to welcome us. The bed is comfortable and the room bright and spacious good location - not too far from the tourist area but close enough to walk. Really good value for money!
Daniel was such a wonderful host. Very flexible and responsive!!! Would definitely recommend his place to anyone visiting Porto. It’s so close to the city center!!

We had a great stay in Helena and Eduardo's apartment. The location is ideal for exploring Porto, with lots of nice breakfast and dinner places within walking distance. The apartment was as described, very spacious, comfortable and clean. Our hosts were always responsive and available to us if needed. We would highly recommend!

Nice clean place in a great location at a reasonable price. My only disappointment was the wifi which was very intermittent and the garage which was very difficult to get your car into as it meant reversing into from a busy road through narrow gates into a very confined space. Fortunately there was ample on street parking beneath the big concrete bridge.

We had such a great time staying at this apartment in Porto! The location is perfect, just a short walk to the ocean which made morning walks and sunsets super special. There are also some great little cafes and restaurants nearby, and it was really easy to get into the city when we wanted to explore more.  The apartment itself was super clean, comfy, and had everything we needed and the ocean view from the window is magnificent. The two bedrooms were a good size and having 1.5 bathrooms was a big plus especially when getting ready in the mornings. The kitchen was well stocked, and we even had some local snacks and coffee waiting for us, which was a nice touch. Wi-Fi worked great, check-in was easy, and the host was super friendly and helpful. Overall, it felt like a home away from home. Would definitely stay here again next time we’re in Porto!
Everything perfect! Close to the main train station, there is a metro stop close by and the area is quiet. I would recommend it, enough space for larger groups.
Well located in the center of Porto, ideal for a couple. We were there with 2 small kids announced upfront, they made it work perfectly.
Absolutely beautiful property!  Patio furniture needs attention, and shower doors were extremely difficult to open. We didn’t realize there were so many stairs and no lift, and no dishwasher.

The shared garden and view are what really make this rental special. Watching the sunset and the bridge lit up at night was really enjoyable for my family. The space was clean and comfortable. We had a small hiccup with checkin, but Alex was very responsive and got us in as soon as possible. Be aware that the location of the house behind the cathedral is in a very busy area. Convenient to walk a lot of places, but very crowded with tourists. If you follow the directions and photos, you will easily locate the house. The only thing that wasn't great was the cobblestone walk from where an Uber can drop you off to the house with all the luggage. The wheels don't tend to work on the cobblestones well and you have to carry all of your bags. Other than that, we really enjoyed this space and Porto.

We stayed in the villa for a week and everything was absolutely perfect! The house is more beautiful then on the pictures, the pool and garden are an amazingly serene oasis and overall it’s a wonderful place to relax, disconnect and enjoy the Portuguese weather. The house is located in a small town with everything you need close by (small supermarket, bakery) and Porto is also easily reachable by car. A huge thank you to our host! Super helpful with everything we needed during the week! We had a wonderful time and are looking forward to being back again soon
We had a very comfortable stay at the apartment. We found that it had everything we needed. I would recommend the location.

We had a really enjoyable and fabulous stay in Porto. It’s a very nice, private and quiet place, we love it very much. Pedro is a super nice and helpful host, he made us feel like home with warm welcome :)

The flat is great - fully equipped, clean and located in the city center with the nice balcony. Cristina was very responsive, accommodation without any problems.  Highly recommended but mind there is a noise at night during the weekend :)

I definitely recommend this Airbnb! I stayed here while visiting Porto with 3 other friends and we had the best time!!! We had to find last minute accommodations, and Pedro was a lifesaver and was able to take us in. He is such a gracious and kind host, and we appreciated his professionalism and hospitality. The place is absolutely gorgeous, so beautifully decorated and there are such new amenities. The water pressure in the shower is fantastic, and the beds were so comfortable. The location is central and walking distance to many of Porto’s attractions.
The apartment is lovely; modern, clean and very centrally located. The communication was great and really helpful, will definitely recommend!

Tomas was great - exceedingly responsive, polite and a pleasure to deal with in every respect. The flat is a great location at the edge of the old town, wonderful cafes right outside and everything within a short walk. It's a little quirky - up several flights of stairs would be challenging with a lot of luggage and it's not the quietest but very clean, comfortable and welcoming and with two full bedrooms and bathrooms is great value. Highly recommended as a base for visits in Porto.
A very nice flat in a very strategic position to visit the city. clean and with everithing you need. Lisa is a very nice host. It has been a great stay in Porto.

Certainly! Here’s a more professional and polished review: "We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and within walking distance of everything in Porto. The host was very responsive and ensured a smooth experience. The only improvements we would suggest are adding a TV in the bedroom and providing small blankets in the living area for added comfort. Overall, a highly recommended stay."
Great spot near train station and nightlife. Amazing little food spots nearby and a cool bar with cheap yum wine 30 seconds away! Great find in Porto.
What a great place!  A very creative remodel of an old town space. We walked everywhere and enjoyed Porto.

Best airbnb experience in all of my airbnbs ive been to so far!  Alvaro helped me so much, from getting around in Porto to everything about this house. We felt so welcomed and the house was clean and we were provided with EVEYTHING a person could possibly need. Alvaro also speaks very good English and is willing to help all. The neighbourhood was quiet and clean, I do admit that it isnt located in the city centre but I liked the atmosphere too.

The flat was lovely and clean with huge windows and great natural light.  Everything seemed new and well maintained. The location is perfect, and within walking distance of any major site. It was quite hot during our stay but the flat has a well-functioning aircon which is barely audible. The check-in process was easy as the host greeted us and responded quickly to any queries we had. The only slight draw-back was that there were few cooking utensils.  The little craft beer/wine shop a few doors down is great too and its' possible to leave  luggage there for a day if need be.
Unbelievably fantastic place with a view that is incredible. We were so happy staying at Oporto top view. It had everything we needed it was so clean and comfortable. I want to return for sure
